phrases.en: Every day the priests would remove the ashes from the altar and place them on the east side of the ramp at the crow of the rooster or adjacent to it, whether before it or after it,

phrases.he: בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מֵחֲצוֹת, וּבָרְגָלִים מֵאַשְׁמוּרָה הָרִאשׁוֹנָה,
phrases.en: And on Yom Kippur they would remove the ashes earlier, from midnight onward. And on the Festivals, the ashes were removed even earlier, at the end of the first watch.

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיְתָה קְרִיאַת הַגֶּבֶר מַגַּעַת עַד שֶׁהָיְתָה עֲזָרָה מְלֵאָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל:
phrases.en: And the call of the rooster would not arrive until the Temple courtyard was full with the Jewish people

phrases.he: בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה כָּל מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לִתְרֹם אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ, תּוֹרֵם.
phrases.en: Initially, the practice among the priests was that whoever wishes to remove the ashes from the altar removes them.

phrases.he: וּבִזְמַן שֶׁהֵן מְרֻבִּין, רָצִין וְעוֹלִין בַּכֶּבֶשׁ,
phrases.en: And when there are many priests who wish to perform that task, the privilege to do so is determined by a race: The priests run and ascend on the ramp leading to the top of the altar.

phrases.he: וְכָל הַקּוֹדֵם אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ בְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת זָכָה.
phrases.en: Any priest who precedes another and reaches within four cubits of the top of the altar first is privileged to remove the ashes.

phrases.he: וְאִם הָיוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם שָׁוִין, הַמְמֻנֶּה אוֹמֵר לָהֶם הַצְבִּיעוּ.
phrases.en: And if both of them were equal and neither preceded the other, the appointed priest says to all the priests: Extend your fingers, and a lottery was performed, as will be explained.

phrases.he: וּמָה הֵן מוֹצִיאִין, אַחַת אוֹ שְׁתַּיִם,
phrases.en: And what fingers do they extend for the lottery? They may extend one or two fingers,

phrases.he: וְאֵין מוֹצִיאִין אֲגֻדָּל בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ:
phrases.en: and the priests do not extend a thumb in the Temple.

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁהָיוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם שָׁוִין וְרָצִין וְעוֹלִין בַּכֶּבֶשׁ, וְדָחַף אֶחָד מֵהֶן אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ, וְנָפַל וְנִשְׁבְּרָה רַגְלוֹ.
phrases.en: an incident occurred where both of them were equal as they were running and ascending on the ramp, and one of them shoved another and he fell and his leg was broken.

phrases.he: וְכֵיוָן שֶׁרָאוּ בֵית דִּין שֶׁבָּאִין לִידֵי סַכָּנָה, הִתְקִינוּ שֶׁלֹּא יְהוּ תוֹרְמִין אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶלָּא בְפַיִס.
phrases.en: And once the court saw that people were coming to potential danger, they instituted that priests would remove ashes from the altar only by means of a lottery.

phrases.he: אַרְבָּעָה פְיָסוֹת הָיוּ שָׁם, וְזֶה הַפַּיִס הָרִאשׁוֹן:
phrases.en: There were four lotteries there, and this, determining which priest would remove the ashes, was the first lottery.

phrases.he: הַפַּיִס הַשֵּׁנִי,
phrases.en: The second lottery

phrases.he: מִי שׁוֹחֵט,
phrases.en: Who slaughters

phrases.he: מִי זוֹרֵק,
phrases.en: who sprinkles

phrases.he: וּמִי מְדַשֵּׁן מִזְבֵּחַ הַפְּנִימִי,
phrases.en: who removes the ashes from the inner altar

phrases.he: וּמִי מְדַשֵּׁן אֶת הַמְּנוֹרָה,
phrases.en: and who removes the ashes from the candelabrum

phrases.he: וּמִי מַעֲלֶה אֵבָרִים לַכֶּבֶשׁ,
phrases.en: and who takes the limbs up to the ramp

phrases.he: הָרֹאשׁ וְהָרֶגֶל,
phrases.en: The head and the right leg

phrases.he: וּשְׁתֵּי הַיָּדַיִם,
phrases.en: and the two forelegs

phrases.he: הָעֹקֶץ וְהָרֶגֶל,
phrases.en: The tail, and the left leg

phrases.he: הֶחָזֶה וְהַגֵּרָה,
phrases.en: And the breast and the throat

phrases.he: וּשְׁתֵּי הַדְּפָנוֹת,
phrases.en: And the two flanks

phrases.he: וְהַקְּרָבַיִם,
phrases.en: and the intestines

phrases.he: וְהַסֹּלֶת,
phrases.en: And the fine flour

phrases.he: וְהַחֲבִתִּין,
phrases.en: and the griddle-cake offering

phrases.he: וְהַיָּיִן.
phrases.en: and the wine

phrases.he: שְׁלשָׁה עָשָׂר כֹּהֲנִים זָכוּ בוֹ.
phrases.en: Altogether thirteen priests prevailed in this lottery

phrases.he: אָמַר בֶּן עַזַּאי לִפְנֵי רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ,
phrases.en: Ben Azzai said before Rabbi Akiva in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua:

phrases.he: דֶּרֶךְ הִלּוּכוֹ הָיָה קָרֵב:
phrases.en: the way it walks was the order in which it was sacrificed

phrases.he: הַפַּיִס הַשְּׁלִישִׁי,
phrases.en: The third lottery,

phrases.he: חֲדָשִׁים לַקְּטֹרֶת בֹּאוּ וְהָפִיסוּ.
phrases.en: the appointee declared: Let only those priests who are new to offering the incense come and participate in the lottery for the incense.

phrases.he: וְהָרְבִיעִי,
phrases.en: The fourth

phrases.he: חֲדָשִׁים עִם יְשָׁנִים,
phrases.en: lottery was open to those new to the service along with those old hands who had already performed it,

phrases.he: מִי מַעֲלֶה אֵבָרִים מִן הַכֶּבֶשׁ וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ:
phrases.en: to determine who would take the limbs up from the ramp, where they had been placed earlier, to the altar.

phrases.he: תָּמִיד קָרֵב בְּתִשְׁעָה, בַּעֲשָׂרָה, בְּאַחַד עָשָׂר, בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר, לֹא פָחוֹת וְלֹא יוֹתֵר.
phrases.en: The daily offering is sacrificed by nine priests, occasionally by ten priests, occasionally by eleven, and sometimes by twelve priests; no fewer than nine and no more than twelve.

phrases.he: כֵּיצַד.
phrases.en: How so?

phrases.he: עַצְמוֹ בְּתִשְׁעָה.
phrases.en: The daily offering itself is sacrificed by nine priests.

phrases.he: בֶּחָג, בְּיַד אֶחָד צְלוֹחִית שֶׁל מַיִם, הֲרֵי כָאן עֲשָׂרָה.
phrases.en: On the festival a priest in whose hand is a jug of water for the water libation is added, and there are ten priests.

phrases.he: בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם, בְּאַחַד עָשָׂר, הוּא עַצְמוֹ בְּתִשְׁעָה, וּשְׁנַיִם בְּיָדָם שְׁנֵי גְזִירֵי עֵצִים.
phrases.en: In the afternoon offering, eleven priests participate in the service. How so? The daily offering itself is performed by nine, and there are an additional two priests in whose hands are two logs.

phrases.he: וּבְשַׁבָּת בְּאַחַד עָשָׂר, הוּא עַצְמוֹ בְּתִשְׁעָה, וּשְׁנַיִם בְּיָדָם שְׁנֵי בְזִיכֵי לְבוֹנָה שֶׁל לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים.
phrases.en: On Shabbat, eleven priests participate. How so? The daily morning offering itself is performed by nine, and there are an additional two priests in whose hands are two vessels of frankincense that accompany the shewbread.

phrases.he: וּבְשַׁבָּת שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ הֶחָג, בְּיַד אֶחָד צְלוֹחִית שֶׁל מָיִם:
phrases.en: And on Shabbat that occurs within the festival there is an additional priest in whose hand is a jug of water for the water libation.

phrases.he: אַיִל קָרֵב בְּאַחַד עָשָׂר
phrases.en: A ram that is brought for a communal burnt-offering is sacrificed by eleven priests

phrases.he: הַבָּשָׂר בַּחֲמִשָּׁה
phrases.en: The flesh by five priests

phrases.he: הַקְּרָבַיִם וְהַסֹּלֶת וְהַיַּיִן בִּשְׁנַיִם שְׁנָיִם
phrases.en: The intestines, and the fine flour and the wine are carried by two priests each

phrases.he: פַּר קָרֵב בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה.
phrases.en: A bull is sacrificed by twenty-four priests.

phrases.he: הָרֹאשׁ וְהָרֶגֶל, הָרֹאשׁ בְּאֶחָד, וְהָרֶגֶל בִּשְׁנַיִם.
phrases.en: The head and the right leg are sacrificed first, but due to its size the head is carried by one priest and the leg by two.

phrases.he: הָעֹקֶץ וְהָרֶגֶל, הָעֹקֶץ בִּשְׁנַיִם, וְהָרֶגֶל בִּשְׁנַיִם.
phrases.en: The tail and the left leg are carried as follows: The tail is sacrificed by two and the leg by two.

phrases.he: הֶחָזֶה וְהַגֵּרָה, הֶחָזֶה בְּאֶחָד, וְהַגֵּרָה בִּשְׁלשָׁה.
phrases.en: The breast and the neck are carried as follows: The breast is offered by one and the neck by three priests.

phrases.he: שְׁתֵּי יָדַיִם בִּשְׁנַיִם.
phrases.en: The two forelegs are carried by two priests,

phrases.he: שְׁתֵּי דְפָנּוֹת בִּשְׁנַיִם.
phrases.en: and the two flanks are carried by two.

phrases.he: הַקְּרָבַיִם וְהַסֹּלֶת וְהַיַּיִן בִּשְׁלשָׁה שְׁלשָׁה.
phrases.en: The intestines and the fine flour and the wine are carried by three each,

phrases.he: בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בְּקָרְבְּנוֹת צִבּוּר.
phrases.en: In what case is this statement said, that this is the sequence followed? It is in the case of communal offerings.

phrases.he: אֲבָל בְּקָרְבַּן יָחִיד, אִם רָצָה לְהַקְרִיב, מַקְרִיב.
phrases.en: However, in the case of an individual offering brought to fulfill a vow or an obligation, if a single priest wishes to sacrifice it alone he may sacrifice it alone, or if he chooses he may include other priests in the service.

phrases.he: הֶפְשֵׁטָן וְנִתּוּחָן שֶׁל אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ שָׁוִין:
phrases.en: With regard to the flaying and the cutting of both these, individual offerings, and those, communal offerings, they are equal,

phrases.he: אָמַר לָהֶם הַמְמֻנֶּה, צְאוּ וּרְאוּ אִם הִגִּיעַ זְמַן הַשְּׁחִיטָה.
phrases.en: The appointed priest said to the other priests: Go out and observe if the time for slaughter has arrived.

phrases.he: אִם הִגִּיעַ, הָרוֹאֶה אוֹמֵר, בַּרְקַאי.
phrases.en: If the time has arrived, the observer says: There is light [barkai].

phrases.he: מַתִּתְיָא בֶּן שְׁמוּאֵל אוֹמֵר, הֵאִיר פְּנֵי כָל הַמִּזְרָח עַד שֶׁבְּחֶבְרוֹן.
phrases.en: Matya ben Shmuel says that the appointed priest phrased his question differently: Is the entire eastern sky illuminated even to Hebron?

phrases.he: וְהוּא אוֹמֵר הֵן:
phrases.en: And the observer says: Yes.

phrases.he: וְלָמָה הֻצְרְכוּ לְכָךְ,
שֶׁפַּעַם אַחַת עָלָה מְאוֹר הַלְּבָנָה וְדִמּוּ שֶׁהֵאִיר מִזְרָח,
phrases.en: as once, the light of the moon rose, and they imagined that the eastern sky was illuminated

phrases.he: וְשָׁחֲטוּ אֶת הַתָּמִיד,
phrases.en: and they slaughtered the daily offering

phrases.he: וְהוֹצִיאוּהוּ לְבֵית הַשְּׂרֵפָה.
phrases.en: taken out to the place designated for burning

phrases.he: הוֹרִידוּ כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל לְבֵית הַטְּבִילָה.
phrases.en: they led the High Priest down to the Hall of Immersion.

phrases.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל הָיָה בַמִּקְדָּשׁ, כָּל הַמֵּסֵךְ אֶת רַגְלָיו טָעוּן טְבִילָה,
phrases.en: This was the principle in the Temple: Anyone who covers his legs, requires immersion

phrases.he: וְכָל הַמַּטִּיל מַיִם טָעוּן קִדּוּשׁ יָדַיִם וְרַגְלָיִם:
phrases.en: and anyone who urinates requires sanctification of the hands and feet with water

phrases.he: אֵין אָדָם נִכְנָס לָעֲזָרָה לָעֲבוֹדָה, אֲפִלּוּ טָהוֹר, עַד שֶׁיִּטְבֹּל.
phrases.en: A person does not enter the Temple courtyard for the Temple service, even if he is pure, until he immerses.

phrases.he: חָמֵשׁ טְבִילוֹת וַעֲשָׂרָה קִדּוּשִׁין טוֹבֵל כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל וּמְקַדֵּשׁ בּוֹ בַיּוֹם.
phrases.en: Five immersions and ten sanctifications the High Priest immerses and sanctifies his hands and feet, respectively, on the day of Yom Kippur.

phrases.he: וְכֻלָּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ עַל בֵּית הַפַּרְוָה, חוּץ מִזּוֹ בִלְבָד:
phrases.en: And all of these immersions and sanctifications take place in the sacred area, the Temple courtyard, on the roof of the Hall of Parva, except for this first immersion alone.

phrases.he: פֵּרְסוּ סָדִין שֶׁל בּוּץ בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין הָעָם.
phrases.en: They spread a sheet of fine linen between him and the people

phrases.he: פָּשַׁט, יָרַד וְטָבַל, עָלָה וְנִסְתַּפֵּג.
phrases.en: removed descended to the ritual bath, and immersed. He ascended and dried himself

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ בִגְדֵי זָהָב, וְלָבַשׁ וְקִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו.
phrases.en: they brought him the golden garments of the High Priest, and he dressed in the garments, and he sanctified his hands and his feet.

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ אֶת הַתָּמִיד.
phrases.en: They brought him the sheep for the daily morning offering

phrases.he: קְרָצוֹ, וּמֵרַק אַחֵר שְׁחִיטָה עַל יָדוֹ.
phrases.en: which he slaughtered by cutting most of the way through the gullet and the windpipe. And a different priest completed the slaughter on his behalf

phrases.he: קִבֵּל אֶת הַדָּם וּזְרָקוֹ.
phrases.en: received the blood in a vessel and sprinkled it

phrases.he: נִכְנַס לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת שֶׁל שַׁחַר, וּלְהֵטִיב אֶת הַנֵּרוֹת, וּלְהַקְרִיב אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הָאֵבָרִים וְאֶת הַחֲבִתִּין וְאֶת הַיָּיִן:
phrases.en: He entered the Sanctuary to burn the morning incense and to remove the ashes from the lamps of the candelabrum; and he left the Sanctuary and returned to the courtyard to sacrifice the head and the limbs and the High Priest's daily griddle-cake offering, and the wine libation of the daily offering.

phrases.he: קְטֹרֶת שֶׁל שַׁחַר הָיְתָה קְרֵבָה בֵּין דָּם לָאֵבָרִים.
phrases.en: The morning incense was burned between the receiving and sprinkling of the blood and the burning of the limbs;

phrases.he: שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם, בֵּין אֵבָרִים לַנְּסָכִים.
phrases.en: and the afternoon incense was burned between the taking of the limbs up to the altar and the pouring of the libations that accompanied the offering.

phrases.he: אִם הָיָה כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל זָקֵן אוֹ אִסְטְנִיס, מְחַמִּין לוֹ חַמִּין וּמְטִילִין לְתוֹךְ הַצּוֹנֵן, כְּדֵי שֶׁתָּפוּג צִנָּתָן:
phrases.en: If the High Priest was old or if he was delicate, they would heat hot water for him and place it into the cold water of the ritual bath in order to temper its chill.

phrases.he: הֱבִיאוּהוּ לְבֵית הַפַּרְוָה, וּבַקֹּדֶשׁ הָיְתָה.
phrases.en: They brought the High Priest to immerse a second time in the Hall of Parva, which was in the sacred area, the Temple courtyard.

phrases.he: פָּרְסוּ סָדִין שֶׁל בּוּץ בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין הָעָם, קִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו וּפָשַׁט.
phrases.en: They spread a sheet of fine linen between him and the people in the interest of modesty. And he sanctified his hands and his feet and removed his garments.

phrases.he: רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר, פָּשַׁט, קִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו.
phrases.en: Rabbi Meir says that this was the sequence: He first removed his garments and then he sanctified his hands and his feet.

phrases.he: יָרַד וְטָבַל, עָלָה וְנִסְתַּפֵּג.
phrases.en: He descended and immersed a second time. He ascended and dried himself.

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ בִגְדֵי לָבָן, לָבַשׁ וְקִדֵּeshׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו:
phrases.en: They brought him the white garments, in which he dressed, and he sanctified his hands and his feet.

phrases.he: בַּשַּׁחַר הָיָה לוֹבֵשׁ פִּלּוּסִין שֶׁל שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מָנֶה,
phrases.en: In the morning he would wear linen garments from Pelusium worth twelve maneh,

phrases.he: וּבֵין הָעַרְבַּיִם הִנְדְּוִין שֶׁל שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת זוּז,
phrases.en: and in the afternoon he wore linen garments from India, which were slightly less expensive, worth eight hundred zuz.

phrases.he: דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
phrases.en: This is the statement of Rabbi Meir.

phrases.he: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים, בַּשַּׁחַר הָיָה לוֹבֵשׁ שֶׁל שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר מָנֶה,
phrases.en: And the Rabbis say: In the morning he would wear garments worth eighteen maneh,

phrases.he: וּבֵין הָעַרְבַּיִם שֶׁל שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מָנֶה,
phrases.en: and in the afternoon he would wear garments worth twelve maneh.

phrases.he: הַכֹּל שְׁלשִׁים מָנֶה.
phrases.en: In total, the clothes were worth thirty maneh.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ מִשֶּׁל צִבּוּר.
phrases.en: These sums for the garments came from the community,

phrases.he: וְאִם רָצָה לְהוֹסִיף, מוֹסִיף מִשֶּׁלּוֹ:
phrases.en: and if the High Priest wished to add money to purchase even finer garments, he would add funding of his own.

phrases.he: בָּא לוֹ אֵצֶל פָּרוֹ, וּפָרוֹ הָיָה עוֹמֵד בֵּין הָאוּלָם וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ
phrases.en: comes and stands next to his bull, and his bull was standing between the Entrance Hall and the altar

phrases.he: רֹאשׁוֹ לַדָּרוֹם וּפָנָיו לַמַּעֲרָב
phrases.en: with its head facing to the south and its face to the west

phrases.he: וְהַכֹּהֵן עוֹמֵד בַּמִּזְרָח וּפָנָיו לַמַּעֲרָב
phrases.en: And the priest stands to the east of the bull, and his face points to the west

phrases.he: וְסוֹמֵךְ שְׁתֵּי יָדָיו עָלָיו וּמִתְוַדֶּה
phrases.en: And places his two hands on the bull and confesses

phrases.he: וְכָךְ הָיָה אוֹמֵר
phrases.en: And this is what he would say

phrases.he: אָנָּא הַשֵּׁם, עָוִיתִי פָּשַׁעְתִּי חָטָאתִי לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנִי וּבֵיתִי
phrases.en: Please, God, I have sinned, I have done wrong, and I have rebelled before You, I and my family

phrases.he: אָנָּא הַשֵּׁם, כַּפֶּר נָא לָעֲוֹנוֹת וְלַפְּשָׁעִים וְלַחֲטָאִים, שֶׁעָוִיתִי וְשֶׁפָּשַׁעְתִּי וְשֶׁחָטָאתִי לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנִי וּבֵיתִי, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת משֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ, כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְיָ תִּטְהָרוּ
phrases.en: Please, God, grant atonement, please, for the sins, and for the wrongs, and for the rebellions that I have sinned, and done wrong, and rebelled before You, I and my family, as it is written in the Torah of Moses your servant: "For on this day atonement shall be made for you to cleanse you of all your sins; you shall be clean before the Lord"

phrases.he: וְהֵן עוֹנִין אַחֲרָיו
phrases.en: And the priests and the people who were in the courtyard respond after he recites the name of God

phrases.he: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
phrases.en: Blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom forever and all time

phrases.he: בָּא לוֹ לְמִזְרַח הָעֲזָרָה, לִצְפוֹן הַמִּזְבֵּחַ,
phrases.en: came to the eastern side of the Temple courtyard, to the north of the altar.

phrases.he: הַסְּגָן מִימִינוֹ וְרֹאשׁ בֵּית אָב מִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ.
phrases.en: The deputy was to his right, and the head of the patrilineal family to his left.

phrases.he: וְשָׁם שְׁנֵי שְׂעִירִים, וְקַלְפִּי הָיְתָה שָׁם וּבָהּ שְׁנֵי גוֹרָלוֹת.
phrases.en: And they arranged two goats there, and there was a lottery receptacle there, and in it were two lots.

phrases.he: שֶׁל אֶשְׁכְּרוֹעַ הָיוּ, וַעֲשָׂאָן בֶּן גַּמְלָא שֶׁל זָהָב,
phrases.en: These were originally made of boxwood, and the High Priest Yehoshua ben Gamla fashioned them of gold,

phrases.he: וְהָיוּ מַזְכִּירִין אוֹתוֹ לְשָׁבַח:
phrases.en: and the people would mention him favorably

phrases.he: בֶּן קָטִין עָשָׂה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר דַּד לַכִּיּוֹר, שֶׁלֹּא הָיוּ לוֹ אֶלָּא שְׁנַיִם.
phrases.en: ben Katin made twelve spigots for the basin as previously the basin had only two.

phrases.he: וְאַף הוּא עָשָׂה מוּכְנִי לַכִּיּוֹר, שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיו מֵימָיו נִפְסָלִין בְּלִינָה.
phrases.en: He also made a machine for the basin so that its water would not be disqualified by remaining overnight.

phrases.he: מֻנְבַּז הַמֶּלֶךְ הָיָה עוֹשֶׂה כָל יְדוֹת הַכֵּלִים שֶׁל יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים שֶׁל זָהָב.
phrases.en: King Munbaz would make the handles of all the Yom Kippur vessels of gold.

phrases.he: הִילְנִי אִמּוֹ עָשְׂתָה נִבְרֶשֶׁת שֶׁל זָהָב עַל פִּתְחוֹ שֶׁל הֵיכָל.
phrases.en: Helene, his mother, fashioned a gold chandelier above the entrance of the Sanctuary.

phrases.he: וְאַף הִיא עָשְׂתָה טַבְלָא שֶׁל זָהָב שֶׁפָּרָשַׁת סוֹטָה כְתוּבָה עָלֶיהָ.
phrases.en: She also fashioned a golden tablet on which the portion relating to sota was written.

phrases.he: נִיקָנוֹר נַעֲשׂוּ נִסִּים לְדַלְתוֹתָיו, וְהָיוּ מַזְכִּירִין אוֹתוֹ לְשָׁבַח:
phrases.en: Nicanor, miracles were performed to his doors, and would mention those favorably.

phrases.he: וְאֵלּוּ לִגְנַאי,
phrases.en: those who took action in the Temple and were mentioned unfavorably.

phrases.he: שֶׁל בֵּית גַּרְמוּ לֹא רָצוּ לְלַמֵּד עַל מַעֲשֵׂה לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים.
phrases.en: The craftsmen of the House of Garmu did not want to teach the secret of the preparation of the shewbread

phrases.he: שֶׁל בֵּית אַבְטִינָס לֹא רָצוּ לְלַמֵּד עַל מַעֲשֵׂה הַקְּטֹרֶת.
phrases.en: The craftsmen of the House of Avtinas did not want to teach the secret of the preparation of the incense.

phrases.he: הֻגְרַס בֶּן לֵוִי הָיָה יוֹדֵעַ פֶּרֶק בַּשִּׁיר וְלֹא רָצָה לְלַמֵּד.
phrases.en: Hugras ben Levi knew a chapter in the art of music, and he did not want to teach it to others.

phrases.he: בֶּן קַמְצָר לֹא רָצָה לְלַמֵּד עַל מַעֲשֵׂה הַכְּתָב.
phrases.en: ben Kamtzar did not want to teach a special act of writing.

phrases.he: עַל הָרִאשׁוֹנִים נֶאֱמַר (משלי י), זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה.
phrases.en: About the first ones, who were mentioned favorably, it is stated: "The memory of the righteous shall be for a blessing" (Proverbs 10:7);

phrases.he: וְעַל אֵלּוּ נֶאֱמַר (שם) וְשֵׁם רְשָׁעִים יִרְקָב:
phrases.en: and about these who were concerned only for themselves it is stated: "But the name of the wicked shall rot" (Proverbs 10:7).

phrases.he: טָרַף בַּקַּלְפִּי וְהֶעֱלָה שְׁנֵי גוֹרָלוֹת.
phrases.en: would mix the lots in the lottery receptacle used to hold them and draw the two lots from it

phrases.he: אֶחָד כָּתוּב עָלָיו לַשֵּׁם וְאֶחָד כָּתוּב עָלָיו לַעֲזָאזֵל.
phrases.en: Upon one was written: For God. And upon the other one was written: For Azazel

phrases.he: הַסְּגָן בִּימִינוֹ וְרֹאשׁ בֵּית אָב מִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ.
phrases.en: The deputy High Priest would stand to the High Priest's right, and the head of the patrilineal family would stand to his left

phrases.he: אִם שֶׁל שֵׁם עָלָה בִימִינוֹ, הַסְּגָן אוֹמֵר לוֹ, אִישִׁי כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל, הַגְבֵּהַּ יְמִינֶךָ.
phrases.en: If the lot for the name of God came up in his right hand, the Deputy would say to him: My master, High Priest, raise your right hand so that all can see with which hand the lot for God was selected

phrases.he: וְאִם שֶׁל שֵׁם עָלָה בִשְׂמֹאלוֹ, רֹאשׁ בֵּית אָב אוֹמֵר לוֹ, אִישִׁי כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל, הַגְּבֵּהַּ שְׂמֹאלֶךָ.
phrases.en: And if the lot for the name of God came up in his left hand, the head of the patrilineal family would say to him: My master, High Priest, raise your left hand

phrases.he: נְתָנוֹ עַל שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִים וְאוֹמֵר, לַיְיָ חַטָּאת.
phrases.en: he would place the two lots upon the two goats, and he would say: For God, as a sin-offering

phrases.he: רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל אוֹמֵר, לֹא הָיָה צָרִיךְ לוֹמַר חַטָּאת, אֶלָּא לַיְיָ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yishmael says: He need not say: As a sin-offering. Rather, it is sufficient to say: For God

phrases.he: וְהֵן עוֹנִין אַחֲרָיו, בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
phrases.en: And they respond after him: Blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom forever and all time

phrases.he: קָשַׁר לָשׁוֹן שֶׁל זְהוֹרִית בְּרֹאשׁ שָׂעִיר הַמִּשְׁתַּלֵּחַ וְהֶעֱמִידוֹ כְנֶגֶד בֵּית שִׁלּוּחוֹ,
phrases.en: tied a strip of crimson wool upon the head of the scapegoat and positioned the goat opposite the place from which it was dispatched,

phrases.he: וְלַנִּשְׁחָט כְּנֶגֶד בֵּית שְׁחִיטָתוֹ.
phrases.en: and the same was done to the goat that was to be slaughtered, opposite the place of its slaughter.

phrases.he: בָּא לוֹ אֵצֶל פָּרוֹ שְׁנִיָּה,
phrases.en: He comes and stands next to his bull a second time,

phrases.he: וְסוֹמֵךְ שְׁתֵּי יָדָיו עָלָיו וּמִתְוַדֶּה.
phrases.en: and places his two hands upon it, and confesses.

phrases.he: וְכָךְ הָיָה אוֹמֵר, אָנָּא הַשֵּׁם, עָוִיתִי פָּשַׁעְתִּי חָטָאתִי לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנִי וּבֵיתִי וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן עַם קְדוֹשֶׁיךָ.
phrases.en: And this is what he would say: Please God, I have sinned, I have done wrong, and I have rebelled before You, I and my family and the children of Aaron, your sacred people.

phrases.he: אָנָּא הַשֵּׁם, כַּפֶּר נָא לָעֲוֹנוֹת וְלַפְּשָׁעִים וְלַחֲטָאִים, שֶׁעָוִיתִי וְשֶׁפָּשַׁעְתִּי וְשֶׁחָטָאתִי לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנִי וּבֵיתִי וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ,
phrases.en: Please God, grant atonement, please, for the sins, and for the wrongs, and for the rebellions that I have sinned, and done wrong, and rebelled before You, I, and my family, and the children of Aaron, your sacred people,

phrases.he: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת משֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ (ויקרא טז), כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְיָ תִּטְהָרוּ.
phrases.en: as it is written in the Torah of Moses, your servant: "For on this day atonement shall be made for you to cleanse you of all your sins; you shall be clean before the Lord"

phrases.he: וְהֵן עוֹנִין אַחֲרָיו, בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
phrases.en: And they, the priests and the people in the Temple courtyard, respond after him upon hearing the name of God: Blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom forever and all time.

phrases.he: שְׁחָטוֹ וְקִבֵּל בַּמִּזְרָק אֶת דָּמוֹ, וּנְתָנוֹ לְמִי שֶׁהוּא מְמָרֵס בּוֹ עַל הָרֹבֶד הָרְבִיעִי שֶׁבַּהֵיכָל, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִקְרֹשׁ.
phrases.en: would slaughter the bull and receive its blood in a bowl, and give it to the one who stirs it. The stirrer would stand on the fourth row of tiles in the Sanctuary and stir the blood lest it coagulate

phrases.he: נָטַל מַחְתָּה וְעָלָה לְרֹאשׁ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ, וּפִנָּה גֶחָלִים אֵילָךְ וְאֵילָךְ, וְחוֹתֶה מִן הַמְעֻכָּלוֹת הַפְּנִימִיּוֹת, וְיָרַד וְהִנִּיחָהּ עַל הָרֹבֶד הָרְבִיעִי שֶׁבָּעֲזָרָה.
phrases.en: He would take a coal pan and ascend to the top of the altar and clear the upper layer of coals to this side and to that side and with the coal pan scoop up coals from among the inner, consumed coals. And he would then descend and place the coal pan with the coals on the fourth row of tiles in the Temple courtyard.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם הָיָה חוֹתֶה בְּשֶׁל כֶּסֶף וּמְעָרֶה בְתוֹךְ שֶׁל זָהָב, וְהַיּוֹם חוֹתֶה בְשֶׁל זָהָב וּבָהּ הָיָה מַכְנִיס.
phrases.en: On every other day, a priest would scoop up the coals with a coal pan made of silver and pour the coals from there into a coal pan of gold. But on this day, on Yom Kippur, the High Priest scoops up with a coal pan of gold, and with that coal pan he would bring the coals into the Holy of Holies.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם חוֹתֶה בְשֶׁל אַרְבַּעַת קַבִּין וּמְעָרֶה בְתוֹךְ שֶׁל שְׁלשֶׁת קַבִּין, וְהַיּוֹם חוֹתֶה בְשֶׁל שְׁלשֶׁת קַבִּין, וּבָהּ הָיָה מַכְנִיס.
phrases.en: On every other day, a priest scoops up the coals with a coal pan of four kav and pours the coals into a coal pan of three kav. But on this day, the High Priest scoops with one of three kav, and with it he would bring the coals into the Holy of Holies.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, בְּכָל יוֹם חוֹתֶה בְשֶׁל סְאָה וּמְעָרֶה בְתוֹךְ שֶׁל שְׁלשֶׁת קַבִּין, וְהַיּוֹם חוֹתֶה בְשֶׁל שְׁלשֶׁת קַבִּין, וּבָהּ הָיָה מַכְנִיס.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says a variation of this distinction: On every other day, a priest scoops up the coals with a coal pan of a se'a, which is six kav and then pours the coals into a coal pan of three kav. But on this day, the High Priest scoops with a coal pan of three kav, and with it he would bring the coals into the Holy of Holies.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם הָיְתָה כְבֵדָה, וְהַיּוֹם קַלָּה.
phrases.en: On every other day, the coal pan was heavy. But on this day it was light, so as not to tire the High Priest.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם הָיְתָה יָדָהּ קְצָרָה, וְהַיּוֹם אֲרֻכָּה.
phrases.en: On every other day, its handle was short, but on this day it was long so that he could also use his arm to support its weight.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם הָיָה זְהָבָהּ יָרוֹק, וְהַיּוֹם אָדֹם, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מְנַחֵם.
phrases.en: On every other day, it was of greenish gold, but on this day it was of a red gold. These are the statements of Rabbi Menaḥem.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם מַקְרִיב פְּרָס בְּשַׁחֲרִית וּפְרָס בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם, וְהַיּוֹם מוֹסִיף מְלֹא חָפְנָיו.
phrases.en: On every other day, a priest sacrificed a peras, half a maneh, of incense in the morning, and a peras in the afternoon, but on this day the High Priest adds an additional handful of incense and burns it in the Holy of Holies.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם הָיְתָה דַקָּה, וְהַיּוֹם דַּקָּה מִן הַדַּקָּה:
phrases.en: On every other day, the incense was ground fine as prescribed by the Torah, but on this day it was superfine.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם כֹּהֲנִים עוֹלִים בְּמִזְרָחוֹ שֶׁל כֶּבֶשׁ וְיוֹרְדִין בְּמַעֲרָבוֹ.
phrases.en: On every day, priests ascend on the eastern side of the ramp and descend on its western side,

phrases.he: וְהַיּוֹם כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל עוֹלֶה בָאֶמְצַע וְיוֹרֵד בָּאֶמְצַע.
phrases.en: but on this day the High Priest ascends in the middle of the ramp and descends in the middle.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, לְעוֹלָם כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל עוֹלֶה בָאֶמְצַע וְיוֹרֵד בָּאֶמְצַע.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says: the High Priest always ascends in the middle of the ramp and descends in the middle.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מְקַדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו מִן הַכִּיּוֹר, וְהַיּוֹם מִן הַקִּיתוֹן שֶׁל זָהָב.
phrases.en: On every day, the High Priest sanctifies his hands and his feet from the laver, and on this day from the golden flask,

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, לְעוֹלָם כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מְקַדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו מִן הַקִּיתוֹן שֶׁל זָהָב.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says the High Priest always sanctifies his hands and his feet from the golden flask.

phrases.he: בְּכָל יוֹם הָיוּ שָׁם אַרְבַּע מַעֲרָכוֹת, וְהַיּוֹם חָמֵשׁ, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
phrases.en: On every other day there were four arrangements of wood there, upon the altar, but on this day there were five; this is the statement of Rabbi Meir.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, בְּכָל יוֹם שָׁלshׁ, וְהַיּוֹם אַרְבַּע.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: On every other day there were three, but on this day there were four.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, בְּכָל יוֹם שְׁתַּיִם, וְהַיּוֹם שָׁלשׁ:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says: On every other day there were two, but on this day there were three.

phrases.he: הוֹצִיאוּ לוֹ אֶת הַכַּף וְאֶת הַמַּחְתָּה,
phrases.en: They brought out the spoon and the coal pan

phrases.he: וְחָפַן מְלֹא חָפְנָיו וְנָתַן לְתוֹךְ הַכַּף,
phrases.en: He scoops his handfuls and places it into the spoon.

phrases.he: הַגָּדוֹל לְפִי גָדְלוֹ,
phrases.en: The large hands fills the spoon with incense in an amount corresponding to the large size of his hands,

phrases.he: וְהַקָּטָן לְפִי קָטְנוֹ,
phrases.en: and the small hands fills the spoon with incense in an amount corresponding to the small size of his hands.

phrases.he: וְכָךְ הָיְתָה מִדָּתָהּ.
phrases.en: And this was the measure of the spoon

phrases.he: נָטַל אֶת הַמַּחְתָּה בִּימִינוֹ וְאֶת הַכַּף בִּשְׂמֹאלוֹ.
phrases.en: He took the coal pan in his right hand and the spoon in his left hand.

phrases.he: הָיָה מְהַלֵּךְ בַּהֵיכָל, עַד שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ לְבֵין שְׁתֵּי הַפָּרֹכוֹת הַמַּבְדִּילוֹת בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּבֵין קֹדֶשׁ הַקָּדָשִׁים, וּבֵינֵיהֶן אַמָּה.
phrases.en: would walk through the Sanctuary until he reaches the area between the two curtains that separated the Sanctuary and the Holy of Holies, and the space between them was one cubit.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, לֹא הָיְתָה שָׁם אֶלָּא פָרֹכֶת אַחַת בִּלְבָד, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (שמות כו), וְהִבְדִּילָה הַפָּרֹכֶת לָכֶם בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּבֵין קֹדֶשׁ הַקָּדָשִׁים.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: There was only one curtain there, as it is stated: "And the curtain shall divide for you between the Sanctuary and the Holy of Holies"

phrases.he: הַחִיצוֹנָה הָיְתָה פְרוּפָה מִן הַדָּרוֹם, וְהַפְּנִימִית מִן הַצָּפוֹן.
phrases.en: The outer curtain between the Sanctuary and the Holy of Holies was hooked slightly open on the south side of the Sanctuary, and the inner curtain hooked slightly open on the north side of the Sanctuary

phrases.he: מְהַלֵּךְ בֵּינֵיהֶן, עַד שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ לַצָּפוֹן.
phrases.en: walks between the curtains until he reaches the opening to the north.

phrases.he: הִגִּיעַ לַצָּפוֹן, הוֹפֵךְ פָּנָיו לַדָּרוֹם,
phrases.en: he reaches the opening to the north, turns his face to the south,

phrases.he: מְהַלֵּךְ לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ עִם הַפָּרֹכֶת עַד שֶׁהוּא מַגִּיעַ לָאָרוֹן.
phrases.en: walks to his left along the curtain until he reaches the area before the Ark.

phrases.he: הִגִּיעַ לָאָרוֹן. נוֹתֵן אֶת הַמַּחְתָּה בֵּין שְׁנֵי הַבַּדִּים.
phrases.en: he reaches the Ark, he places the coal pan between the two staves.

phrases.he: צָבַר אֶת הַקְּטֹרֶת עַל גַּבֵּי גֶחָלִים, וְנִתְמַלֵּא כָל הַבַּיִת כֻּלּוֹ עָשָׁן.
phrases.en: He piles the incense atop the coals, and the whole chamber in its entirety would fill with smoke.

phrases.he: יָצָא וּבָא לוֹ בְדֶרֶךְ בֵּית כְּנִיסָתוֹ,
phrases.en: He exits and comes out the way that he entered.

phrases.he: וּמִתְפַּלֵּל תְּפִלָּה קְצָרָה בַּבַּיִת הַחִיצוֹן,
phrases.en: And he recites a brief prayer in the outer chamber,

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיָה מַאֲרִיךְ בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ, שֶׁלֹּא לְהַבְעִית אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל:
phrases.en: And he would not extend his prayer so as not to alarm the Jewish people,

phrases.he: מִשֶּׁנִּטַּל הָאָרוֹן
phrases.en: After the Ark was taken

phrases.he: אֶבֶן הָיְתָה שָׁם מִימוֹת נְבִיאִים רִאשׁוֹנִים
phrases.en: there was a rock from the days of the early prophets

phrases.he: וּשְׁתִיָּה הָיְתָה נִקְרֵאת
phrases.en: and was called the foundation

phrases.he: גְּבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ שָׁלשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת
phrases.en: three fingerbreadths higher than the ground

phrases.he: וְעָלֶיהָ הָיָה נוֹתֵן
phrases.en: and the High Priest would place the incense on it

phrases.he: נָטַל אֶת הַדָּם מִמִּי שֶׁהָיָה מְמָרֵס בּוֹ
phrases.en: he took the blood from the one who was stirring it,

phrases.he: נִכְנַס לַמָּקוֹם שֶׁנִּכְנַס
phrases.en: He entered into the place that he had previously entered,

phrases.he: וְעָמַד בַּמָּקוֹם שֶׁעָמַד
phrases.en: and stood at the place where he had previously stood

phrases.he: וְהִזָּה מִמֶּנּוּ אַחַת לְמַעְלָה וְשֶׁבַע לְמַטָּה
phrases.en: And he sprinkled from the blood, one time upward and seven times downward.

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיָה מִתְכַּוֵּן לְהַזּוֹת לֹא לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא לְמַטָּה
phrases.en: And he would neither intend to sprinkle upward nor to sprinkle it downward,

phrases.he: אֶלָּא כְמַצְלִיף
phrases.en: but rather like one who whips,

phrases.he: וְכָךְ הָיָה מוֹנֶה
phrases.en: And this is how he would count

phrases.he: אַחַת, אַחַת וְאַחַת, אַחַת וּשְׁתַּיִם, אַחַת וְשָׁלשׁ, אַחַת וְאַרְבַּע, אַחַת וְחָמֵשׁ, אַחַת וָשֵׁשׁ, אַחַת וָשֶׁבַע
phrases.en: One; one and one; one and two; one and three; one and four; one and five; one and six; one and seven.

phrases.he: יָצָא וְהִנִּיחוֹ עַל כַּן הַזָּהָב שֶׁבַּהֵיכָל
phrases.en: He emerged and placed the bowl with the remaining blood on the golden pedestal in the Sanctuary.

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר,
phrases.en: They brought him the goat

phrases.he: שְׁחָטוֹ וְקִבֵּל בַּמִּזְרָק אֶת דָּמוֹ.
phrases.en: He slaughtered it and received its blood in the bowl.

phrases.he: נִכְנַס לִמְקוֹם שֶׁנִּכְנַס, וְעָמַד בִּמְקוֹם שֶׁעָמַד,
phrases.en: He again entered into the place that he had previously entered, the Holy of Holies, and stood at the place that he previously stood,

phrases.he: וְהִזָּה מִמֶּנּוּ אַחַת לְמַעְלָה וְשֶׁבַע לְמַטָּה,
phrases.en: and sprinkled from the blood of the goat one time upward and seven times downward.

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיָה מִתְכַּוֵּן לְהַזּוֹת לֹא לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא לְמַטָּה, אֶלָּא כְמַצְלִיף.
וְכָךְ הָיָה מוֹנֶה, אַחַת, אַחַת וְאַחַת, אַחַת וּשְׁתַּיִם, אַחַת וְשָׁלשׁ, אַחַת וְאַרְבַּע, אַחַת וְחָמֵשׁ, אַחַת וָשֵׁשׁ, אַחַת וָשֶׁבַע.
phrases.en: And this is how he would count, just as he counted when sprinkling the blood of the bull: One; one and one; one and two; etc.

phrases.he: יָצָא וְהִנִּיחוֹ עַל כַּן הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁהָיָה בַהֵיכָל.
phrases.en: The High Priest then emerged from the Holy of Holies and placed the bowl with the remaining blood on the second golden pedestal in the Sanctuary.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, לֹא הָיָה שָׁם אֶלָּא כַּן אֶחָד בִּלְבָד.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says: There was only one pedestal there,

phrases.he: נָטַל דַּם הַפָּר וְהִנִּיחַ דַּם הַשָּׂעִיר,
phrases.en: and he took the blood of the bull from the pedestal and placed the blood of the goat in its place.

phrases.he: וְהִזָּה מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַפָּרֹכֶת שֶׁכְּנֶגֶד הָאָרוֹן מִבַּחוּץ, אַחַת לְמַעְלָה וְשֶׁבַע לְמַטָּה,
phrases.en: And he sprinkled from the blood of the bull on the curtain opposite the Ark from outside the Holy of Holies, one time upward and seven times downward,

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיָה מִתְכַּוֵּן לְהַזּוֹת לֹא לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא לְמַטָּה, אֶלָּא כְמַצְלִיף.
phrases.en: and he would not intend, etc.

phrases.he: וְכָךְ הָיָה מוֹנֶה, אַחַת, אַחַת וְאַחַת, אַחַת וּשְׁתַּיִם, אַחַת וְשָׁלשׁ, אַחַת וְאַרְבַּע, אַחַת וְחָמֵשׁ, אַחַת וָשֵׁשׁ, אַחַת וָשֶׁבַע.
phrases.en: And this is how he would count, etc.

phrases.he: נָטַל דַּם הַשָּׂעִיר וְהִנִּיחַ דַּם הַפָּר,
phrases.en: When he concluded, he took the blood of the goat from the pedestal and placed blood of the bull in its place on the pedestal.

phrases.he: וְהִזָּה מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַפָּרֹכֶת שֶׁכְּנֶגֶד הָאָרוֹן מִבַּחוּץ, אַחַת לְמַעְלָה וְשֶׁבַע לְמַטָּה,
phrases.en: And he sprinkled from the goat's blood on the curtain opposite the Ark from outside, just as he did with the blood of the bull, one time upward and seven times downward,

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיָה מִתְכַּוֵּן לְהַזּוֹת לֹא לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא לְמַטָּה, אֶלָּא כְמַצְלִיף.
וְכָךְ הָיָה מוֹנֶה, אַחַת, אַחַת וְאַחַת, אַחַת וּשְׁתַּיִם, אַחַת וְשָׁלשׁ, אַחַת וְאַרְבַּע, אַחַת וְחָמֵשׁ, אַחַת וָשֵׁשׁ, אַחַת וָשֶׁבַע.
עֵרָה דַם הַפָּר לְתוֹךְ דַּם הַשָּׂעִיר, וְנָתַן אֶת הַמָּלֵא בָרֵיקָן:
phrases.en: Afterward, he poured the blood of the bull into the blood of the goat and placed the blood from the full bowl into the empty bowl, so that the blood would be mixed well.

phrases.he: וְיָצָא אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְיָ
phrases.en: And he shall go out to the altar that is before the Lord

phrases.he: זֶה מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב.
phrases.en: This altar is the golden altar

phrases.he: הִתְחִיל מְחַטֵּא וְיוֹרֵד.
phrases.en: He began to cleanse the altar, sprinkling the blood downward.

phrases.he: מֵהֵיכָן הוּא מַתְחִיל
phrases.en: From where does he begin?

phrases.he: מִקֶּרֶן מִזְרָחִית צְפוֹנִית
phrases.en: from the northeast corner

phrases.he: צְפוֹנִית מַעֲרָבִית
phrases.en: northwest corner

phrases.he: מַעֲרָבִית דְּרוֹמִית
phrases.en: southwest corner

phrases.he: דְּרוֹמִית מִזְרָחִית.
phrases.en: southeast corner

phrases.he: מְקוֹם שֶׁהוּא מַתְחִיל בַּחַטָּאת עַל מִזְבֵּחַ הַחִיצוֹן, מִשָּׁם הָיָה גוֹמֵר עַל מִזְבֵּחַ הַפְּנִימִי.
phrases.en: At the place where he begins sprinkling the blood for a sin-offering sacrificed on the outer altar, there he finishes sprinkling the blood on the inner altar.

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer says:

phrases.he: בִּמְקוֹמוֹ הָיָה עוֹמֵד וּמְחַטֵּא.
phrases.en: he stood in one place and sprinkled the blood from there.

phrases.he: וְעַל כֻּלָּן הָיָה נוֹתֵן מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה
phrases.en: And on all the corners he would present the blood from below upward

phrases.he: חוּץ מִזּוֹ שֶׁהָיְתָה לְפָנָיו, שֶׁעָלֶיהָ הָיָה נוֹתֵן מִלְמַעְלָה לְמָטָּה:
phrases.en: except for that corner that was directly before him, on which he would present the blood from above downward.

phrases.he: הִזָּה עַל טָהֳרוֹ שֶׁל מִזְבֵּחַ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים,
phrases.en: He sprinkled blood on the pure gold of the altar seven times

phrases.he: וּשְׁיָרֵי הַדָּם הָיָה שׁוֹפֵךְ עַל יְסוֹד מַעֲרָבִי שֶׁל מִזְבֵּחַ הַחִיצוֹן,
phrases.en: And he would pour the remainder of the blood on the western base of the outer altar.

phrases.he: וְשֶׁל מִזְבֵּחַ הַחִיצוֹן הָיָה שׁוֹפֵךְ עַל יְסוֹד דְּרוֹמִי.
phrases.en: he would pour the remaining blood of an offering, after it was sprinkled, on the outer altar, on its southern base.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ מִתְעָרְבִין בָּאַמָּה וְיוֹצְאִין לְנַחַל קִדְרוֹן,
phrases.en: These remainders of blood from the outer altar and those remainders of blood from the inner altar are mixed in the canal and flow out to the Kidron River.

phrases.he: וְנִמְכָּרִין לַגַּנָּנִין לְזֶבֶל,
phrases.en: sold to gardeners for fertilizer.

phrases.he: וּמוֹעֲלִין בָּהֶן:
phrases.en: misuse of consecrated property.

phrases.he: כָּל מַעֲשֵׂה יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים הָאָמוּר עַל הַסֵּדֶר,
phrases.en: Each action performed in the context of the service of Yom Kippur stated in the mishna, as in the Torah, is listed in order.

phrases.he: אִם הִקְדִּים מַעֲשֶׂה לַחֲבֵרוֹ, לֹא עָשָׂה כְלוּם.
phrases.en: If the High Priest performed one of the actions before another, he has done nothing.

phrases.he: הִקְדִּים דַּם הַשָּׂעִיר לְדַם הַפָּר, יַחֲזֹר וְיַזֶּה מִדַּם הַשָּׂעִיר לְאַחַר דַּם הַפָּר.
phrases.en: If he performed the sprinkling of the blood of the goat before the sprinkling of the blood of the bull, he must repeat the action and sprinkle the blood of the goat after sprinkling the blood of the bull, so that the actions are performed in the proper order.

phrases.he: וְאִם עַד שֶׁלֹּא גָמַר אֶת הַמַּתָּנוֹת שֶׁבִּפְנִים נִשְׁפַּךְ הַדָּם, יָבִיא דָם אַחֵר וְיַחֲזֹר וְיַזֶּה בַתְּחִלָּה בִּפְנִים.
phrases.en: And if the blood spills before he completed the presentations that were sprinkled inside the Holy of Holies, he must slaughter another bull or goat, and bring other blood, and then repeat all the services from the beginning inside the Holy of Holies.

phrases.he: וְכֵן בַּהֵיכָל,
phrases.en: And similarly, if the blood spills before he finishes the presentations in the Sanctuary, he must begin the service in the Sanctuary from the beginning,

phrases.he: וְכֵן בְּמִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב,
phrases.en: and likewise with regard to the sprinkling of blood on the golden altar.

phrases.he: שֶׁכֻּלָּן כַּפָּרָה בִפְנֵי עַצְמָן.
phrases.en: Since they are each acts of atonement in and of themselves, there is no need to repeat the service of the entire day from the beginning. Rather, he need only repeat the specific element that he failed to complete.

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמְרִים, מִמְּקוֹם שֶׁפָּסַק, מִשָּׁם הוּא מַתְחִיל:
phrases.en: Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Shimon say: From the place that he interrupted that particular service, when the blood spilled, there he resumes performance of that service. In their opinion, each individual sprinkling in each of these services is an act in and of itself, and there is no need to repeat what he has already done.

phrases.he: שְׁנֵי שְׂעִירֵי יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, מִצְוָתָן שֶׁיִּהְיוּ שְׁנֵיהֶן שָׁוִין בְּמַרְאֶה וּבְקוֹמָה וּבְדָמִים וּבִלְקִיחָתָן כְּאֶחָד.
phrases.en: The mitzva of the two Yom Kippur goats is as follows: That they will both be identical in appearance and in height, and in monetary value, and their acquisition must be as one.

phrases.he: וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינָן שָׁוִין, כְּשֵׁרִין.
phrases.en: And even if they are not identical, nevertheless, they are valid.

phrases.he: לָקַח אֶחָד הַיּוֹם וְאֶחָד לְמָחָר, כְּשֵׁרִין.
phrases.en: If he acquired one today and one tomorrow, they are valid.

phrases.he: מֵת אֶחָד מֵהֶן, אִם עַד שֶׁלֹּא הִגְרִיל מֵת, יִקַּח זוּג לַשֵּׁנִי.
phrases.en: If one of the goats died, if it died before the High Priest drew the lots, he immediately takes a counterpart for the second.

phrases.he: וְאִם מִשֶּׁהִגְרִיל מֵת, יָבִיא זוּג אַחֵר וְיַגְרִיל עֲלֵיהֶם בַּתְּחִלָּה, וְיֹאמַר, אִם שֶׁל שֵׁם מֵת, זֶה שֶׁעָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַשֵּׁם יִתְקַיֵּם תַּחְתָּיו.
phrases.en: And if it died after the High Priest drew the lots, he brings another pair of goats and draws lots over them from the start. After that lottery he utters a stipulation: If the one to be sacrificed to God died, that goat upon which the lot for God was drawn in the second lottery shall stand in its stead;

phrases.he: וְאִם שֶׁל עֲזָאזֵל מֵת, זֶה שֶׁעָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַעֲזָאזֵל יִתְקַיֵּם תַּחְתָּיו.
phrases.en: and if the one to be sent to Azazel died, that goat upon which the lot for Azazel was drawn shall stand in its stead.

phrases.he: וְהַשֵּׁנִי יִרְעֶה עַד שֶׁיִּסְתָּאֵב, וְיִמָּכֵר וְיִפְּלוּ דָמָיו לִנְדָבָה, שֶׁאֵין חַטַּאת צִבּוּר מֵתָה.
phrases.en: And the second, superfluous goat, should graze until it becomes unfit, at which point it will be sold, and the money received from its sale will go toward the purchase of a public gift-offering. Although a communal sin-offering is not left to die.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, תָּמוּת.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says: In this it should be left to die.

phrases.he: וְעוֹד אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, נִשְׁפַּךְ הַדָּם, יָמוּת הַמִּשְׁתַּלֵּחַ.
phrases.en: And furthermore, Rabbi Yehuda said: If the blood of the goat sacrificed to God spilled before it was sprinkled, the scapegoat is left to die.

phrases.he: מֵת הַמִּשְׁתַּלֵּחַ, יִשָּׁפֵךְ הַדָּם:
phrases.en: Similarly, if the scapegoat dies, the blood of the goat sacrificed to God should be spilled.

phrases.he: בָּא לוֹ אֵצֶל שָׂעִיר הַמִּשְׁתַּלֵּחַ וְסוֹמֵךְ שְׁתֵּי יָדָיו עָלָיו וּמִתְוַדֶּה.
phrases.en: comes over to the scapegoat, places both his hands upon it, and confesses.

phrases.he: וְכָךְ הָיָה אוֹמֵר, אָנָּא הַשֵּׁם, עָווּ פָּשְׁעוּ חָטְאוּ לְפָנֶיךָ עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל.
phrases.en: And he would say as follows: Please, God, Your people, the house of Israel, have sinned, and done wrong, and rebelled before You.

phrases.he: אָנָּא בַּשֵּׁם, כַּפֶּר נָא לָעֲוֹנוֹת וְלַפְּשָׁעִים וְלַחֲטָאִים, שֶׁעָווּ וְשֶׁפָּשְׁעוּ וְשֶׁחָטְאוּ לְפָנֶיךָ עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת משֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ לֵאמֹר (ויקרא טז), כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְיָ תִּטְהָרוּ.
phrases.en: Please, God, grant atonement, please, for the sins, and for the wrongs, and for the rebellions that they have sinned, and done wrong, and rebelled before You, Your people, the house of Israel, as it is written in the Torah of Moses Your servant, saying: "For on this day atonement shall be made for you to cleanse you of all your sins; before the Lord you shall be purified"

phrases.he: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָעָם הָעוֹמְדִים בָּעֲזָרָה, כְּשֶׁהָיוּ שׁוֹמְעִים שֵׁם הַמְפֹרָשׁ שֶׁהוּא יוֹצֵא מִפִּי כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל, הָיוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וְנוֹפְלִים עַל פְּנֵיהֶם, וְאוֹמְרִים, בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
phrases.en: And the priests and the people standing in the courtyard, when they would hear the Explicit Name emerging from the mouth of the High Priest, they would kneel and prostrate themselves and fall on their faces, and say: Blessed is the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.

phrases.he: מְסָרוֹ לְמִי שֶׁהָיָה מוֹלִיכוֹ.
phrases.en: passed the goat to the one who was to lead it

phrases.he: הַכֹּל כְּשֵׁרִין לְהוֹלִיכוֹ, אֶלָּא שֶׁעָשׂוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים גְּדוֹלִים קֶבַע וְלֹא הָיוּ מַנִּיחִין אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהוֹלִיכוֹ.
phrases.en: everyone is eligible to lead it, but the High Priests established a fixed custom and did not allow an Israelite to lead it.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי,
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei said:

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה וְהוֹלִיכוֹ עַרְסְלָא, וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה:
phrases.en: an incident where Arsela led the goat to the wilderness, and he was an Israelite.

phrases.he: וְכֶבֶשׁ עָשׂוּ לוֹ מִפְּנֵי הַבַּבְלִיִּים,
phrases.en: And they made a ramp for the goat due to the Babylonian Jews who were in Jerusalem,

phrases.he: שֶׁהָיוּ מְתַלְּשִׁים בִּשְׂעָרוֹ, וְאוֹמְרִים לוֹ, טֹל וָצֵא, טֹל וָצֵא.
phrases.en: who would pluck at the goat's hair and would say to the goat: Take our sins and go, take our sins and go,

phrases.he: מִיַּקִּירֵי יְרוּשָׁלַיִם הָיוּ מְלַוִּין אוֹתוֹ עַד סֻכָּה הָרִאשׁוֹנָה.
phrases.en: People from among the prominent residents of Jerusalem would escort the one leading the goat until they reached the first booth.

phrases.he: עֶשֶׂר סֻכּוֹת מִירוּשָׁלַיִם וְעַד צוּק, תִּשְׁעִים רִיס, שִׁבְעָה וּמֶחֱצָה לְכָל מִיל:
phrases.en: There were ten booths from Jerusalem to the cliff, with a distance of ninety ris between them. As there are seven and a half ris for each mil,

phrases.he: עַל כָּל סֻכָּה וְסֻכָּה אוֹמְרִים לוֹ, הֲרֵי מָזוֹן וַהֲרֵי מַיִם.
phrases.en: At each and every booth, people there say to him: Here is food; here is water, if you need it.

phrases.he: וּמְלַוִּין אוֹתוֹ מִסֻּכָּה לְסֻכָּה, חוּץ מֵאַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁבָּהֶן, שֶׁאֵינוֹ מַגִּיעַ עִמּוֹ לַצּוּק, אֶלָּא עוֹמֵד מֵרָחוֹק וְרוֹאֶה אֶת מַעֲשָׂיו.
phrases.en: And they escort him from booth to booth, except for the last person at the last booth, who does not reach the cliff with him. Rather, he stands from a distance and observes his actions to ensure that he fulfills the mitzva properly.

phrases.he: מֶה הָיָה עוֹשֶׂה,
phrases.en: What did he do

phrases.he: חוֹלֵק לָשׁוֹן שֶׁל זְהוֹרִית,
phrases.en: He divided a strip of crimson

phrases.he: חֶצְיוֹ קָשַׁר בַּסֶּלַע וְחֶצְיוֹ קָשַׁר בֵּין שְׁתֵּי קַרְנָיו,
phrases.en: half of the strip tied to the rock, and half of it tied between the two horns

phrases.he: וּדְחָפוֹ לַאֲחוֹרָיו, וְהוּא מִתְגַּלְגֵּל וְיוֹרֵד,
phrases.en: And he pushed the goat backward, and it rolls and descends.

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיָה מַגִּיעַ לַחֲצִי הָהָר עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה אֵבָרִים אֵבָרִים.
phrases.en: And it would not reach halfway down the mountain until it was torn limb from limb.

phrases.he: בָּא וְיָשַׁב לוֹ תַּחַת סֻכָּה אַחֲרוֹנָה עַד שֶׁתֶּחְשָׁךְ.
phrases.en: came and sat under the roofing of last booth until it grows dark

phrases.he: וּמֵאֵימָתַי מְטַמֵּא בְגָדִים,
phrases.en: And from what point are the garments rendered impure,

phrases.he: מִשֶּׁיֵּצֵא חוּץ לְחוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלַיִם.
phrases.en: From the moment he emerges outside the wall of Jerusalem.

phrases.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר,
phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon says:

phrases.he: מִשְּׁעַת דְּחִיָּתוֹ לַצּוּק:
phrases.en: from the moment that he pushes the goat from the cliff.

phrases.he: בָּא לוֹ אֵצֶל פָּר וְשָׂעִיר הַנִּשְׂרָפִין.
phrases.en: he came next to the bull and the goat that were to be burned.

phrases.he: קְרָעָן וְהוֹצִיא אֶת אֵמוּרֵיהֶן,
phrases.en: He tore their flesh but was not required to cut it into pieces, and removed the portions of the offering consumed on the altar

phrases.he: נְתָנָן בְּמָגֵיס, וְהִקְטִירָן עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ.
phrases.en: and placed them in a large bowl [magis] and burned them on the altar.

phrases.he: קְלָעָן בְּמִקְלָעוֹת, וְהוֹצִיאָן לְבֵית הַשְּׂרֵפָה.
phrases.en: He interwove and bound the bull and the goat together into braids as one mass. They were placed in that way upon two poles and carried by four people who took them out to the place designated for burning,

phrases.he: וּמֵאֵימָתַי מְטַמְּאִין בְּגָדִים,
phrases.en: And at what point do the bull and goat render the garments of those who carried them impure,

phrases.he: מִשֶּׁיֵּצְאוּ חוּץ לְחוֹמַת הָעֲזָרָה.
phrases.en: from the moment that they emerged outside the wall of the Temple courtyard.

phrases.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר, מִשֶּׁיִּצַּת הָאוּר בְּרֻבָּן:
phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon says: They render the garments impure from the moment that the fire has ignited in most of the bull and the goat.

phrases.he: אָמְרוּ לוֹ לְכֹהֵן גָּדוֹל, הִגִּיעַ שָׂעִיר לַמִּדְבָּר.
phrases.en: They said to the High Priest: The goat has reached the wilderness.

phrases.he: וּמִנַּיִן הָיוּ יוֹדְעִין שֶׁהִגִּיעַ שָׂעִיר לַמִּדְבָּר, דַּרְכִּיּוֹת הָיוּ עוֹשִׂין, וּמְנִיפִין בַּסּוּדָרִין, וְיוֹדְעִין שֶׁהִגִּיעַ שָׂעִיר לַמִּדְבָּר.
phrases.en: And how did they know that the goat reached the wilderness? They would build platforms and people would stand on them and wave scarves to signal when the goat arrived. And therefore they knew that the goat reached the wilderness.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, וַהֲלֹא סִימָן גָּדוֹל הָיָה לָהֶם, מִירוּשָׁלַיִם וְעַד בֵּית חִדּוּדוֹ שְׁלשָׁה מִילִין.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda said: Didn't they already have a reliable indicator? From Jerusalem to Beit Ḥiddudo, the edge of the wilderness, where the mitzva of dispatching the goat was performed, was a distance of three mil.

phrases.he: הוֹלְכִין מִיל, וְחוֹזְרִין מִיל, וְשׁוֹהִין כְּדֵי מִיל, וְיוֹדְעִין שֶׁהִגִּיעַ שָׂעִיר לַמִּדְבָּר.
phrases.en: walked a mil and returned a mil, and waited the time equivalent to the time it takes to walk a mil, they knew that the goat reached the wilderness.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל אוֹמֵר, וַהֲלֹא סִימָן אַחֵר הָיָה לָהֶם, לָשׁוֹן שֶׁל זְהוֹרִית הָיָה קָשׁוּר עַל פִּתְחוֹ שֶׁל הֵיכָל, וּכְשֶׁהִגִּיעַ שָׂעִיר לַמִּדְבָּר הָיָה הַלָּשׁוֹן מַלְבִּין, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ישעיה א), אִם יִהְיוּ חֲטָאֵיכֶם כַּשָּׁנִים כַּשֶּׁלֶג יַלְבִּינוּ:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yishmael says: Didn't they have a different indicator? There was a strip of crimson tied to the entrance to the Sanctuary, and when the goat reached the wilderness and the mitzva was fulfilled the strip would turn white, as it is stated: "Though your sins be as scarlet, they will become white as snow"

phrases.he: בָּא לוֹ כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל לִקְרוֹת.
phrases.en: The High Priest came to read

phrases.he: אִם רָצָה לִקְרוֹת בְּבִגְדֵי בוּץ, קוֹרֵא.
phrases.en: If he wished to read the Torah while still dressed in the fine linen garments, he may read

phrases.he: וְאִם לֹא, קוֹרֵא בְאִצְטְלִית לָבָן מִשֶּׁלּוֹ.
phrases.en: and if not he is permitted to read in a white robe of his own

phrases.he: חַזַּן הַכְּנֶסֶת נוֹטֵל סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה וְנוֹתְנוֹ לְרֹאשׁ הַכְּנֶסֶת, וְרֹאשׁ הַכְּנֶסֶת נוֹתְנוֹ לַסְּגָן, וְהַסְּגָן נוֹתְנוֹ לְכֹהֵן גָּדוֹל, וְכֹהֵן גָּדוֹל עוֹמֵד וּמְקַבֵּל וְקוֹרֵא עוֹמֵד,
phrases.en: The synagogue attendant takes a Torah scroll and gives it to the head of the synagogue and the head of the synagogue gives it to the deputy and the Deputy gives it to the High Priest, and the High Priest stands and receives the scroll from his hands. And he reads

phrases.he: וְקוֹרֵא אַחֲרֵי מוֹת וְאַךְ בֶּעָשׂוֹר.
phrases.en: from the scroll the Torah portion beginning with the verse: "After the death" and the portion beginning with the verse: "But on the tenth"

phrases.he: וְגוֹלֵל סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה וּמַנִּיחוֹ בְחֵיקוֹ, וְאוֹמֵר, יוֹתֵר מִמַּה שֶּׁקָּרָאתִי לִפְנֵיכֶם כָּתוּב כָּאן,
phrases.en: and furls the Torah scroll and places it on his bosom and says: More than what I have read before you is written here.

phrases.he: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר שֶׁבְּחֻמַּשׁ הַפְּקוּדִים קוֹרֵא עַל פֶּה,
phrases.en: The Torah portion beginning with the verse: "And on the tenth," from the book of Numbers he then reads by heart.

phrases.he: וּמְבָרֵךְ עָלֶיהָ שְׁמֹנֶה בְרָכוֹת, עַל הַתּוֹרָה, וְעַל הָעֲבוֹדָה, וְעַל הַהוֹדָאָה, וְעַל מְחִילַת הֶעָוֹן, וְעַל הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ, וְעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ וְעַל הַכֹּהֲנִים בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן וְעַל שְׁאָר הַתְּפִלָּה:
phrases.en: And he recites after the reading the following eight blessings: Concerning the Torah and concerning the Temple service and concerning thanksgiving and concerning pardon of iniquity and concerning the Temple in and of itself and concerning the Jewish People in and of itself and concerning Jerusalem in and of itself and concerning the priests in and of themselves and concerning the rest of the prayer

phrases.he: הָרוֹאֶה כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל כְּשֶׁהוּא קוֹרֵא, אֵינוֹ רוֹאֶה פַר וְשָׂעִיר הַנִּשְׂרָפִים.
phrases.en: One who sees the High Priest reading does not see the bull and goat that are burned

phrases.he: וְהָרוֹאֶה פַר וְשָׂעִיר הַנִּשְׂרָפִים, אֵינוֹ רוֹאֶה כֹהֵן גָּדוֹל כְּשֶׁהוּא קוֹרֵא.
phrases.en: and one who sees the bull and goat that are burned does not see the High Priest reading

phrases.he: וְלֹא מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאֵינוֹ רַשַּׁאי, אֶלָּא שֶׁהָיְתָה דֶרֶךְ רְחוֹקָה, וּמְלֶאכֶת שְׁנֵיהֶן שָׁוָה כְאֶחָת:
phrases.en: And this is not due to the fact that one is not permitted to see both, but because there was a distant path between them, and the performance of both of them is undertaken simultaneously

phrases.he: אִם בְּבִגְדֵי בוּץ קוֹרֵא,
phrases.en: If the High Priest read the Torah in sacred white fine linen garments, he

phrases.he: קִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו,
phrases.en: sanctified his hands and feet

phrases.he: פָּשַׁט יָרַד וְטָבַל,
phrases.en: removed the linen garments, descended to the ritual bath, and immersed.

phrases.he: עָלָה וְנִסְתַּפֵּג.
phrases.en: ascended and dried himself

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ בִגְדֵי זָהָב,
phrases.en: and they brought him the golden garments

phrases.he: וְלָבַשׁ,
phrases.en: of the High Priesthood, and he dressed

phrases.he: וְקִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו,
phrases.en: in them and sanctified his hands and feet.

phrases.he: וְיָצָא וְעָשָׂה אֶת אֵילוֹ וְאֶת אֵיל הָעָם, וְאֶת שִׁבְעַת כְּבָשִׂים תְּמִימִים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה,
phrases.en: He emerged and offered his ram and the ram of the people and the seven unblemished year-old lambs

phrases.he: דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר.
phrases.en: This is the statement of Rabbi Eliezer.

phrases.he: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר,
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva says:

phrases.he: עִם תָּמִיד שֶׁל שַׁחַר הָיוּ קְרֵבִין,
phrases.en: rather, they were sacrificed with the daily morning offering;

phrases.he: וּפַר הָעוֹלָה וְשָׂעִיר הַנַּעֲשֶׂה בַחוּץ הָיוּ קְרֵבִין עִם תָּמִיד שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם:
phrases.en: and the bull of the Yom Kippur burnt-offering; and the goat whose services are performed outside of the Sanctuary, i.e., in the Temple courtyard, were sacrificed with the daily afternoon offering.

phrases.he: קִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו, וּפָשַׁט וְיָרַד וְטָבַל וְעָלָה וְנִסְתַּפֵּג.
phrases.en: he sanctified his hands and feet and removed and he descended into the ritual bath and immersed and ascended and dried himself.

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ בִגְדֵי לָבָן, וְלָבַשׁ, וְקִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו.
phrases.en: They brought him the white garments and he dressed in them and sanctified his hands and feet.

phrases.he: נִכְנַס לְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַכַּף וְאֶת הַמַּחְתָּה.
phrases.en: he entered the Holy of Holies to take out the incense spoon and the coal pan,

phrases.he: קִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו, וּפָשַׁט וְיָרַד וְטָבַל, עָלָה וְנִסְתַּפֵּג.
phrases.en: He again sanctified his hands and feet and removed the white garments and descended to the ritual bath and immersed and ascended and dried himself

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ בִגְדֵי זָהָב וְלָבַשׁ, וְקִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו, וְנִכְנַס לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם וּלְהֵטִיב אֶת הַנֵּרוֹת, וְקִדֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו, וּפָשַׁט.
phrases.en: They brought him the golden garments, and he dressed in them and sanctified his hands and feet and entered the Sanctuary to burn the afternoon incense and to remove the ashes from the lamps, And he sanctified his hands and feet and removed the golden garments,

phrases.he: הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ בִגְדֵי עַצְמוֹ, וְלָבַשׁ.
phrases.en: They then brought him his own clothing and he dressed,

phrases.he: וּמְלַוִּין אוֹתוֹ עַד בֵּיתוֹ.
phrases.en: escort him to his house

phrases.he: וְיוֹם טוֹב הָיָה עוֹשֶׂה לְאוֹהֲבָיו בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁיָּצָא בְשָׁלוֹם מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ:
phrases.en: And the High Priest would make a feast for his loved ones and his friends when he emerged in peace from the Sanctuary.

phrases.he: כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מְשַׁמֵּשׁ בִּשְׁמֹנָה כֵלִים.
phrases.en: the High Priest serves in eight garments

phrases.he: וְהַהֶדְיוֹט בְּאַרְבָּעָה, בְּכֻתֹּנֶת וּמִכְנָסַיִם וּמִצְנֶפֶת וְאַבְנֵט.
phrases.en: and the common priest serves in four: In a tunic and trousers and a mitre and a belt

phrases.he: מוֹסִיף עָלָיו כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל, חשֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד וּמְעִיל וָצִיץ.
phrases.en: The High Priest adds beyond those worn by the common priest: A breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a frontplate

phrases.he: בְּאֵלּוּ נִשְׁאָלִין בְּאוּרִים וְתֻמִּים.
phrases.en: in these he may be consulted for the decision of the Urim VeTummim

phrases.he: וְאֵין נִשְׁאָלִין אֶלָּא לַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְבֵית דִּין וּלְמִי שֶׁהַצִּבּוּר צָרִיךְ בּוֹ:
phrases.en: And he may be consulted only on behalf of the king, or on behalf of the president of the court, or on behalf of one whom the community needs

phrases.he: יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים אָסוּר בַּאֲכִילָה וּבִשְׁתִיָּה וּבִרְחִיצָה וּבְסִיכָה וּבִנְעִילַת הַסַּנְדָּל וּבְתַשְׁמִישׁ הַמִּטָּה.
phrases.en: On Yom Kippur, it is prohibited to engage in eating and in drinking, and in bathing, and in smearing oil on one's body, and in wearing shoes, and in conjugal relations.

phrases.he: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַכַּלָּה יִרְחֲצוּ אֶת פְּנֵיהֶם,
phrases.en: However, the king, in deference to his eminence, and a new bride within thirty days of her marriage, who wishes to look especially attractive at the beginning of her relationship with her husband, may wash their faces on Yom Kippur.

phrases.he: וְהֶחָיָה תִנְעֹל אֶת הַסַּנְדָּל,
phrases.en: A woman after childbirth, who is suffering, may wear shoes because going barefoot causes her pain.

phrases.he: דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר,
phrases.en: This is the statement of Rabbi Eliezer.

phrases.he: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹסְרִין.
phrases.en: The Rabbis prohibit these activities for a king, a new bride, and a woman after childbirth.

phrases.he: הָאוֹכֵל כְּכוֹתֶבֶת הַגַּסָּה, כָּמוֹהָ וּכְגַרְעִינָתָהּ, וְהַשּׁוֹתֶה מְלֹא לֻגְמָיו, חַיָּב.
phrases.en: One who eats a large date-bulk of food, equivalent to a date and its pit, or who drinks a cheekful of liquid is liable.

phrases.he: כָּל הָאֳכָלִין מִצְטָרְפִין לִכְכוֹתֶבֶת.
phrases.en: All foods that one eats join together to constitute a date-bulk.

phrases.he: כָּל הַמַּשְׁקִין מִצְטָרְפִין לִמְלֹא לֻגְמָיו.
phrases.en: All liquids that one drinks join together to constitute a cheekful.

phrases.he: הָאוֹכֵל וְשׁוֹתֶה, אֵין מִצְטָרְפִין:
phrases.en: If one eats and drinks, they do not join together.

phrases.he: אָכַל וְשָׁתָה בְּהֶעְלֵם אַחַת, אֵינוֹ חַיָּב אֶלָּא חַטָּאת אֶחָת.
phrases.en: If one ate and drank unwittingly within one lapse of awareness, he is liable to bring only one sin-offering.

phrases.he: אָכַל וְעָשָׂה מְלָאכָה, חַיָּב שְׁתֵּי חַטָּאוֹת.
phrases.en: If he ate and performed labor unwittingly, he is liable to bring two sin-offerings.

phrases.he: אָכַל אֳכָלִין שֶׁאֵינָן רְאוּיִין לַאֲכִילָה, וְשָׁתָה מַשְׁקִין שֶׁאֵינָן רְאוּיִין לִשְׁתִיָּה, וְשָׁתָה צִיר אוֹ מֻרְיָס, פָּטוּר.
phrases.en: If he ate foods that are not fit for eating, or drank liquids that are not fit for drinking, or drank fish brine or the briny liquid in which fish are pickled, he is exempt.

phrases.he: הַתִּינוֹקוֹת, אֵין מְעַנִּין אוֹתָן בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים,
phrases.en: the children, one does not afflict them on Yom Kippur;

phrases.he: אֲבָל מְחַנְּכִין אוֹתָם לִפְנֵי שָׁנָה וְלִפְנֵי שְׁנָתַיִם,
phrases.en: however, one trains them one year before or two years before

phrases.he: בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁיִּהְיוּ רְגִילִין בַּמִּצְוֹת:
phrases.en: so that they will be accustomed to fulfill mitzvot.

phrases.he: עֻבָּרָה שֶׁהֵרִיחָה, מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתָהּ עַד שֶׁתָּשִׁיב נַפְשָׁהּ.
phrases.en: a pregnant woman who smelled food and was overcome by a craving to eat it, one feeds her until she recovers

phrases.he: חוֹלֶה מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתוֹ עַל פִּי בְקִיאִין.
phrases.en: If a person is ill and requires food due to potential danger, one feeds him according to the advice of medical experts who determine that he indeed requires food

phrases.he: וְאִם אֵין שָׁם בְּקִיאִין, מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתוֹ עַל פִּי עַצְמוֹ, עַד שֶׁיֹּאמַר דָּי.
phrases.en: And if there are no experts there, one feeds him according to his own instructions, until he says that he has eaten enough and needs no more

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁאֲחָזוֹ בֻלְמוּס, מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתוֹ אֲפִלּוּ דְבָרִים טְמֵאִים, עַד שֶׁיֵּאוֹרוּ עֵינָיו.
phrases.en: In the case of one who is seized with the life-threatening illness bulmos, causing him unbearable hunger pangs and impaired vision, one may feed him even impure foods on Yom Kippur or any other day until his eyes recover, as the return of his sight indicates that he is recovering.

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁנְּשָׁכוֹ כֶלֶב שׁוֹטֶה, אֵין מַאֲכִילִין אוֹתוֹ מֵחֲצַר כָּבֵד שֶׁלוֹ, וְרַבִּי מַתְיָא בֶן חָרָשׁ מַתִּיר.
phrases.en: In the case of one whom a mad dog bit, one may not feed him from the lobe of the dog's liver. This was thought to be a remedy for the bite, but the Rabbis deem it ineffective. And Rabbi Matya ben Ḥarash permits feeding it to him, as he deems it effective.

phrases.he: וְעוֹד אָמַר רַבִּי מַתְיָא בֶן חָרָשׁ, הַחוֹשֵׁשׁ בִּגְרוֹנוֹ, מַטִּילִין לוֹ סַם בְּתוֹךְ פִּיו בְּשַׁבָּת, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא סְפֵק נְפָשׁוֹת, וְכָל סְפֵק נְפָשׁוֹת דּוֹחֶה אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת.
phrases.en: And furthermore, Rabbi Matya ben Ḥarash said: With regard to one who suffers pain in his throat, one may place medicine inside his mouth on Shabbat, although administering a remedy is prohibited on Shabbat. This is because there is uncertainty whether or not it is a life-threatening situation for him, as it is difficult to ascertain the severity of internal pain. And a case of uncertainty concerning a life-threatening situation overrides Shabbat.

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁנָּפְלָה עָלָיו מַפֹּלֶת, סָפֵק הוּא שָׁם סָפֵק אֵינוֹ שָׁם, סָפֵק חַי סָפֵק מֵת, סָפֵק נָכְרִי סָפֵק יִשְׂרָאֵל, מְפַקְּחִין עָלָיו אֶת הַגַּל.
phrases.en: one upon whom a rockslide fell, and there is uncertainty whether he is there under the debris or whether he is not there; and there is uncertainty whether he is still alive or whether he is dead; and there is uncertainty whether the person under the debris is a gentile or whether he is a Jew, one clears the pile from atop him.

phrases.he: מְצָאוּהוּ חַי, מְפַקְּחִין עָלָיו.
phrases.en: If they found him alive after beginning to clear the debris, they continue to clear the pile until they can extricate him.

phrases.he: וְאִם מֵת, יַנִּיחוּהוּ:
phrases.en: And if they found him dead, they should leave him,

phrases.he: חַטָּאת וְאָשָׁם וַדַּאי מְכַפְּרִין.
phrases.en: A sin-offering and a definite guilt-offering atone

phrases.he: מִיתָה וְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מְכַפְּרִין עִם הַתְּשׁוּבָה.
phrases.en: Death and Yom Kippur atone for sins when accompanied by repentance.

phrases.he: הַתְּשׁוּבָה מְכַפֶּרֶת עַל עֲבֵרוֹת קַלּוֹת עַל עֲשֵׂה וְעַל לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה.
phrases.en: Repentance itself atones for minor transgressions, for both positive mitzvot and negative mitzvot.

phrases.he: וְעַל הַחֲמוּרוֹת הִיא תוֹלָה עַד שֶׁיָּבֹא יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים וִיכַפֵּר:
phrases.en: And repentance places punishment for severe transgressions in abeyance until Yom Kippur comes and completely atones for the transgression.

phrases.he: הָאוֹמֵר, אֶחֱטָא וְאָשׁוּב, אֶחֱטָא וְאָשׁוּב, אֵין מַסְפִּיקִין בְּיָדוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת תְּשׁוּבָה.
phrases.en: one who says: I will sin and then I will repent, I will sin and I will repent, Heaven does not provide him the opportunity to repent

phrases.he: אֶחֱטָא וְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מְכַפֵּר, אֵין יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מְכַפֵּר.
phrases.en: I will sin and Yom Kippur will atone for my sins, Yom Kippur does not atone for his sins

phrases.he: עֲבֵרוֹת שֶׁבֵּין אָדָם לַמָּקוֹם, יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מְכַפֵּר.
phrases.en: transgressions between a person and God, Yom Kippur atones

phrases.he: עֲבֵרוֹת שֶׁבֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ, אֵין יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מְכַפֵּר, עַד שֶׁיְּרַצֶּה אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ.
phrases.en: transgressions between a person and another, Yom Kippur does not atone until he appeases the other person

phrases.he: אֶת זוֹ דָּרַשׁ רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן עֲזַרְיָה, מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְיָ תִּטְהָרוּ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya taught that point from the verse: "From all your sins you shall be cleansed before the Lord"

phrases.he: עֲבֵרוֹת שֶׁבֵּין אָדָם לַמָּקוֹם, יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מְכַפֵּר.
phrases.en: transgressions between a person and God, Yom Kippur atones

phrases.he: עֲבֵרוֹת שֶׁבֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ, אֵין יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מְכַפֵּר, עַד שֶׁיְּרַצֶּה אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ.
phrases.en: transgressions between a person and another, Yom Kippur does not atone until he appeases the other person

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, אַשְׁרֵיכֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל, לִפְנֵי מִי אַתֶּם מִטַּהֲרִין, וּמִי מְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם, אֲבִיכֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם.
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva said: How fortunate are you, Israel; before Whom are you purified, and Who purifies you? It is your Father in Heaven

phrases.he: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, וְזָרַקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַיִם טְהוֹרִים וּטְהַרְתֶּם.
phrases.en: as it is stated: "And I will sprinkle purifying water upon you, and you shall be purified"

phrases.he: וְאוֹמֵר, מִקְוֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ.
phrases.en: And it says: "The ritual bath of Israel is God"

phrases.he: מַה מִּקְוֶה מְטַהֵר אֶת הַטְּמֵאִים, אַף הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְטַהֵר אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל.
phrases.en: Just as a ritual bath purifies the impure, so too, the Holy One, Blessed be He, purifies Israel

phrases.he: סֻכָּה שֶׁהִיא גְבוֹהָה לְמַעְלָה מֵעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה, פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: A sukka that is more than twenty cubits high is unfit.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה מַכְשִׁיר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda deems it fit.

phrases.he: וְשֶׁאֵינָהּ גְּבוֹהָה עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים, וְשֶׁאֵין לָהּ שְׁלֹשָׁה דְּפָנוֹת, וְשֶׁחַמָּתָהּ מְרֻבָּה מִצִּלָּתָהּ, פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: A sukka that is not even ten handbreadths high, and one that does not have three walls, and one whose sunlight that passes through its roofing is greater than its shade are unfit.

phrases.he: סֻכָּה יְשָׁנָה, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי פּוֹסְלִין, וּבֵית הִלֵּל מַכְשִׁירִין.
phrases.en: An old sukka, Beit Shammai deem it unfit and Beit Hillel deem it fit.

phrases.he: וְאֵיזוֹ הִיא סֻכָּה יְשָׁנָה, כָּל שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ קֹדֶם לֶחָג שְׁלשִׁים יוֹם.
phrases.en: And which is considered an old sukka? Any booth that one established thirty days or more prior to the Festival.

phrases.he: אֲבָל אִם עֲשָׂאָהּ לְשֵׁם חָג, אֲפִלּוּ מִתְּחִלַּת הַשָּׁנָה, כְּשֵׁרָה:
phrases.en: However, if he established it expressly for the sake of the festival of Sukkot, even if he constructed it at the beginning of the previous year, it is fit.

phrases.he: הָעוֹשֶׂה סֻכָּתוֹ תַחַת הָאִילָן, כְּאִלּוּ עֲשָׂאָהּ בְּתוֹךְ הַבָּיִת.
phrases.en: one who establishes his sukka beneath a tree, it is as though he established it inside the house

phrases.he: סֻכָּה עַל גַּבֵּי סֻכָּה, הָעֶלְיוֹנָה כְשֵׁרָה, וְהַתַּחְתּוֹנָה פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: a sukka atop another sukka, the upper sukka is fit and the lower sukka is unfit

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, אִם אֵין דִּיּוּרִין בָּעֶלְיוֹנָה, הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה כְּשֵׁרָה:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says: If there are no residents in the upper sukka, the lower sukka is fit.

phrases.he: פֵּרַס עָלֶיהָ סָדִין מִפְּנֵי הַחַמָּה, אוֹ תַּחְתֶּיהָ מִפְּנֵי הַנְּשָׁר, אוֹ שֶׁפֵּרַס עַל גַּבֵּי הַקִּינוֹף, פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: one spread a sheet over due to the sun, or beneath due to the falling leaves, or one spread over the frame of a four-post kinof bed, the area in the sukka beneath the sheets is unfit.

phrases.he: אֲבָל פּוֹרֵס הוּא עַל גַּבֵּי נַקְלִיטֵי הַמִּטָּה:
phrases.en: However, one may spread the sheet over the frame of a two-post naklitei bed,

phrases.he: הִדְלָה עָלֶיהָ אֶת הַגֶּפֶן וְאֶת הַדְּלַעַת וְאֶת הַקִּסּוֹם וְסִכֵּךְ עַל גַּבָּהּ, פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: If one trellised climbing plants such as a grapevine, or gourd plant, or ivy [kissos], over a sukka while they were still attached to the ground, and then added roofing atop them, the sukka is unfit.

phrases.he: וְאִם הָיָה סִכּוּךְ הַרְבֵּה מֵהֶן, אוֹ שֶׁקְּצָצָן, כְּשֵׁרָה.
phrases.en: If the amount of fit roofing was greater than the plants attached to the ground, or if he cut the climbing plants so that they were no longer attached to the ground, it is fit.

phrases.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל, כֹּל שֶׁהוּא מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה וְאֵין גִּדּוּלוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ, אֵין מְסַכְּכִין בּוֹ.
phrases.en: This is the principle with regard to the roofing of a sukka: Anything that is susceptible to ritual impurity, e.g., vessels, or its growth is not from the ground, e.g., animal hides, one may not roof his sukka with it.

phrases.he: וְכָל דָּבָר שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה וְגִדּוּלוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ, מְסַכְּכִין בּוֹ:
phrases.en: And anything that is not susceptible to ritual impurity and its growth is from the ground, one may roof his sukka with it.

phrases.he: חֲבִילֵי קַשׁ וַחֲבִילֵי עֵצִים וַחֲבִילֵי זְרָדִין, אֵין מְסַכְּכִין בָּהֶן.
phrases.en: One may not roof a sukka with bundles of straw tied with rope, or bundles of wood, or bundles of twigs.

phrases.he: וְכֻלָּן שֶׁהִתִּירָן, כְּשֵׁרוֹת.
phrases.en: And with regard to all of the bundles, if one untied them, they are fit for use in roofing the sukka, as their lack of fitness is due to the fact that the bundles are tied.

phrases.he: וְכֻלָּן כְּשֵׁרוֹת לַדְּפָנוֹת:
phrases.en: And all of the bundles are fit for use in constructing the walls of the sukka.

phrases.he: מְסַכְּכִין בִּנְסָרִים, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה.
phrases.en: One may roof the sukka with boards; this is the statement of Rabbi Yehuda.

phrases.he: וְרַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹסֵר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Meir prohibits their use.

phrases.he: נָתַן עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶר שֶׁהוּא רָחָב אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים, כְּשֵׁרָה, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁלֹא יִישַׁן תַּחְתָּיו:
phrases.en: If one placed a board that is four handbreadths wide atop the sukka, the sukka is fit, provided he does not sleep beneath the board.

phrases.he: תִּקְרָה שֶׁאֵין עָלֶיהָ מַעֲזִיבָה,
phrases.en: a roof upon which there is no plaster

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, מְפַקְפֵּק וְנוֹטֵל אַחַת מִבֵּינְתַיִם,
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says that Beit Shammai say: One moves and one removes one from among them

phrases.he: וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, מְפַקְפֵּק אוֹ נוֹטֵל אַחַת מִבֵּינְתַיִם.
phrases.en: Beit Hillel say: one must either move or remove one from among them

phrases.he: רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר, נוֹטֵל אַחַת מִבֵּינְתַיִם, וְאֵין מְפַקְפֵּק:
phrases.en: Rabbi Meir says: One only removes one from among them and does not move the others

phrases.he: הַמְקָרֶה סֻכָּתוֹ בְשַׁפּוּדִין אוֹ בַאֲרֻכּוֹת הַמִּטָּה,
phrases.en: one who roofs his sukka with metal skewers or with the long boards of the bed,

phrases.he: אִם יֵשׁ רֶוַח בֵּינֵיהֶן כְּמוֹתָן, כְּשֵׁרָה.
phrases.en: if there is space between them equal to them, it is fit.

phrases.he: הַחוֹטֵט בְּגָדִישׁ לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ סֻכָּה, אֵינָהּ סֻכָּה:
phrases.en: one who hollows out a stack of grain to construct a sukka in it, it is not a sukka.

phrases.he: הַמְשַׁלְשֵׁל דְּפָנוֹת מִלְמַעְלָה לְמַטָּה, אִם גָּבוֹהַּ מִן הָאָרֶץ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים, פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: One who lowers the walls of the sukka from up downward, if the lower edge of the wall is three handbreadths above the ground, the sukka is unfit.

phrases.he: מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה, אִם גָּבוֹהַּ מִן הָאָרֶץ עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים, כְּשֵׁרָה.
phrases.en: If one constructs the wall from down upward, if the wall is ten handbreadths high, even if it does not reach the roofing, the sukka is fit.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמִּלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים, כָּךְ מִלְמַעְלָה לְמַטָּה עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: Just as a wall built from down upward must be ten handbreadths, so too, in a case where one lowers the wall from up downward, it must be ten handbreadths in length.

phrases.he: הִרְחִיק אֶת הַסִּכּוּךְ מִן הַדְּפָנוֹת שְׁלשָׁה טְפָחִים, פְּסוּלָה:
phrases.en: If one distanced the roofing from the walls of the sukka at a distance of three handbreadths the sukka is unfit,

phrases.he: בַּיִת שֶׁנִּפְחַת וְסִכֵּךְ עַל גַּבָּיו,
phrases.en: a house that was breached, creating a hole in the middle of the roof, and one roofed over the breach

phrases.he: אִם יֵשׁ מִן הַכֹּתֶל לַסִּכּוּךְ אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת, פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: if from the wall to the roofing there are four or more cubits of the remaining original roof, it is an unfit sukka

phrases.he: וְכֵן חָצֵר שֶׁהִיא מֻקֶּפֶת אַכְסַדְרָה.
phrases.en: And likewise, in the case of a courtyard that is surrounded on three sides by a portico

phrases.he: סֻכָּה גְדוֹלָה, שֶׁהִקִּיפוּהָ בְדָבָר שֶׁאֵין מְסַכְּכִים בּוֹ,
phrases.en: a large sukka that was surrounded at the edge of its roofing with material with which one may not roof a sukka

phrases.he: אִם יֵשׁ תַּחְתָּיו אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת, פְּסוּלָה:
phrases.en: if there are four cubits beneath the unfit roofing, the sukka is unfit

phrases.he: הָעוֹשֶׂה סֻכָּתוֹ כְּמִין צְרִיף, אוֹ שֶׁסְּמָכָהּ לְכֹתֶל,
phrases.en: One who establishes his sukka like a type of circular hut, or who rested the sukka against the wall,

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר פּוֹסֵל, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאֵין לָהּ גָּג,
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer deems it unfit because it does not have a roof,

phrases.he: וַחֲכָמִים מַכְשִׁירִין.
phrases.en: and the Rabbis deem it fit;

phrases.he: מַחְצֶלֶת קָנִים גְּדוֹלָה, עֲשָׂאָהּ לִשְׁכִיבָה, מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה וְאֵין מְסַכְּכִין בָּהּ.
phrases.en: In the case of a large mat of reeds, if one initially produced it for the purpose of lying upon it, it is susceptible to ritual impurity and therefore one may not roof a sukka with it.

phrases.he: לְסִכּוּךְ, מְסַכְּכִין בָּהּ וְאֵינָהּ מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה.
phrases.en: If one initially produced it for roofing, one may roof a sukka with it, and it is not susceptible to ritual impurity,

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר, אַחַת קְטַנָּה וְאַחַת גְּדוֹלָה, עֲשָׂאָהּ לִשְׁכִיבָה, מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה וְאֵין מְסַכְּכִין בָּהּ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer says that with regard to both a small mat and a large mat, if one produced it for the purpose of lying upon it, it is susceptible to ritual impurity and one may not roof a sukka with it.

phrases.he: לְסִכּוּךְ, מְסַכְּכִין בָּהּ וְאֵינָהּ מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה:
phrases.en: If one produced it for roofing, one may roof a sukka with it, and it is not susceptible to ritual impurity.

phrases.he: הַיָּשֵׁן תַּחַת הַמִּטָּה בַסֻּכָּה, לֹא יָצָא יְדֵי חוֹבָתוֹ.
phrases.en: One who sleeps beneath the bed in the sukka did not fulfill his obligation,

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, נוֹהֲגִין הָיִינוּ, שֶׁהָיִינוּ יְשֵׁנִים תַּחַת הַמִּטָּה בִּפְנֵי הַזְּקֵנִים, וְלֹא אָמְרוּ לָנוּ דָבָר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda said: It was our custom that we would sleep beneath the bed before the Elders and they did not say anything to us

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן, מַעֲשֶׂה בְטָבִי עַבְדּוֹ שֶׁל רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל שֶׁהָיָה יָשֵׁן תַּחַת הַמִּטָּה, וְאָמַר לָהֶן רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל לַזְּקֵנִים, רְאִיתֶם טָבִי עַבְדִּי, שֶׁהוּא תַלְמִיד חָכָם וְיוֹדֵעַ שֶׁעֲבָדִים פְּטוּרִין מִן הַסֻּכָּה, לְפִיכָךְ יָשֵׁן הוּא תַּחַת הַמִּטָּה.
phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon said, There was an incident involving Tavi, the slave of Rabban Gamliel, who was sleeping beneath the bed, and Rabban Gamliel said to the Elders: you see my slave Tavi, who is a Torah scholar and knows that slaves are exempt from the sukka? Therefore, he sleeps under the bed.

phrases.he: וּלְפִי דַרְכֵּנוּ לָמַדְנוּ, שֶׁהַיָּשֵׁן תַּחַת הַמִּטָּה, לֹא יָצָא יְדֵי חוֹבָתוֹ:
phrases.en: And by the way, we learned that one who sleeps beneath the bed did not fulfill his obligation.

phrases.he: הַסּוֹמֵךְ סֻכָּתוֹ בְּכַרְעֵי הַמִּטָּה, כְּשֵׁרָה.
phrases.en: One who supports his sukka on the legs of the bed, the sukka is fit.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, אִם אֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לַעֲמֹד בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ, פְּסוּלָה.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says: If the sukka cannot stand in and of itself, it is unfit.

phrases.he: סֻכָּה הַמְדֻבְלֶלֶת, וְשֶׁצִּלָּתָהּ מְרֻבָּה מֵחַמָּתָהּ, כְּשֵׁרָה.
phrases.en: A sukka that is meduvlelet and whose shade exceeds its sunlight is fit.

phrases.he: הַמְעֻבָּה כְמִין בַּיִת, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין הַכּוֹכָבִים נִרְאִים מִתּוֹכָהּ, כְּשֵׁרָה:
phrases.en: whose roofing is thick like a house of sorts, even though that the stars cannot be seen from within it, is fit.

phrases.he: הָעוֹשֶׂה סֻכָּתוֹ בְּרֹאשׁ הָעֲגָלָה אוֹ בְּרֹאשׁ הַסְּפִינָה, כְּשֵׁרָה, וְעוֹלִין לָהּ בְּיוֹם טוֹב.
phrases.en: One who establishes his sukka at the top of the wagon or at the top of the ship, is fit, and one may ascend it on the Festival day.

phrases.he: בְּרֹאשׁ הָאִילָן אוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי גָמָל, כְּשֵׁרָה, וְאֵין עוֹלִין לָהּ בְּיוֹם טוֹב.
phrases.en: At the top of a tree or atop a camel, is fit, but one may not ascend it on the Festival day.

phrases.he: שְׁתַּיִם בָּאִילָן וְאַחַת בִּידֵי אָדָם, אוֹ שְׁתַּיִם בִּידֵי אָדָם וְאַחַת בָּאִילָן, כְּשֵׁרָה, וְאֵין עוֹלִין לָהּ בְּיוֹם טוֹב.
phrases.en: Two in the tree and one by a person, or two by a person and one in the tree, is fit, but one may not ascend it on the Festival day.

phrases.he: שָׁלshׁ בִּידֵי אָדָם וְאַחַת בָּאִילָן, כְּשֵׁרָה, וְעוֹלִין לָהּ בְּיוֹם טוֹב.
phrases.en: Three by a person and one in the tree, is fit, and one may enter it on the Festival day.

phrases.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל, כֹּל שֶׁנִּטַּל הָאִילָן וִיכוֹלָה לַעֲמוֹד בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ, כְּשֵׁרָה, וְעוֹלִין לָהּ בְּיוֹם טוֹב:
phrases.en: This is the principle: Any where the tree removed, the sukka would be able to remain standing in and of itself, is fit, and one may ascend it on the Festival.

phrases.he: הָעוֹשֶׂה סֻכָּתוֹ בֵּין הָאִילָנוֹת, וְהָאִילָנוֹת דְּפָנוֹת לָהּ, כְּשֵׁרָה.
