phrases.en: And water drawn from a cistern of those who come up to Eretz Yisrael from Babylonia, i.e., a public cistern, is as the feet of whoever fills his vessel with its water; the water has no defined boundary of its own since it is made available to all.

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁהָיוּ פֵרוֹתָיו בְּעִיר אַחֶרֶת
phrases.en: one who had produce in a different city

phrases.he: וְעֵרְבוּ בְנֵי אוֹתָהּ הָעִיר לְהָבִיא אֶצְלוֹ מִפֵּרוֹתָיו
phrases.en: and the residents of that city joined the Shabbat boundaries, enabling them to reach the owner's home on the Festival, and they wish to bring him some of his produce

phrases.he: לֹא יָבִיאוּ לוֹ
phrases.en: they may not bring it to him

phrases.he: וְאִם עֵרַב הוּא
phrases.en: However, if the owner placed an eiruv

phrases.he: פֵּרוֹתָיו כָּמוֹהוּ
phrases.en: his produce is like his status with regard to the Shabbat limit

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁזִּמֵּן אֶצְלוֹ אוֹרְחִים, לֹא יוֹלִיכוּ בְיָדָם מָנוֹת, אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן זִכָּה לָהֶם מָנוֹתֵיהֶם מֵעֶרֶב יוֹם טוֹב.
phrases.en: one who invited guests to visit him, they may not carry in their hands portions unless he transferred ownership of their portions to them on the eve of the Festival

phrases.he: אֵין מַשְׁקִין וְשׁוֹחֲטִין אֶת הַמִּדְבָּרִיּוֹת, אֲבָל מַשְׁקִין וְשׁוֹחֲטִין אֶת הַבַּיָתוֹת.
phrases.en: one may not water or slaughter desert animals, however, one may water and slaughter domestic animals

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ הֵן בַּיָתוֹת, הַלָּנוֹת בָּעִיר.
phrases.en: These are considered domestic animals: Those that sleep in the city

phrases.he: מִדְבָּרִיּוֹת, הַלָּנוֹת בָּאֲפָר:
phrases.en: Desert animals are those that sleep in the pasture

phrases.he: אַרְבָּעָה רָאשֵׁי שָׁנִים הֵם.
phrases.en: They are four New Year days in the year that serve as the New Year, each for a different purpose

phrases.he: בְּאֶחָד בְּנִיסָן רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לַמְּלָכִים וְלָרְגָלִים.
phrases.en: On the first of Nisan is the New Year for kings and for the order of the Festivals

phrases.he: בְּאֶחָד בֶּאֱלוּל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לְמַעְשַׂר בְּהֵמָה.
phrases.en: On the first of Elul is the New Year for animal tithes

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמְרִים, בְּאֶחָד בְּתִשְׁרֵי.
phrases.en: Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Shimon say: The New Year for animal tithes is on the first of Tishrei

phrases.he: בְּאֶחָד בְּתִשְׁרֵי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לַשָּׁנִים וְלַשְּׁמִטִּין וְלַיּוֹבְלוֹת, לַנְּטִיעָה וְלַיְרָקוֹת.
phrases.en: On the first of Tishrei is the New Year for years, for Sabbatical Years and Jubilee Years, for planting, and for vegetables

phrases.he: בְּאֶחָד בִּשְׁבָט, רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לָאִילָן, כְּדִבְרֵי בֵית שַׁמַּאי.
phrases.en: On the first of Shevat is the New Year for the tree; this ruling is in accordance with the statement of Beit Shammai

phrases.he: בֵּית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בּוֹ:
phrases.en: Beit Hillel say: The New Year for trees is on the fifteenth of Shevat

phrases.he: בְּאַרְבָּעָה פְרָקִים הָעוֹלָם נִדּוֹן,
phrases.en: At four times of the year the world is judged:

phrases.he: בְּפֶסַח עַל הַתְּבוּאָה,
phrases.en: On Passover judgment is passed concerning grain;

phrases.he: בַּעֲצֶרֶת עַל פֵּרוֹת הָאִילָן,
phrases.en: on Shavuot concerning fruits that grow on a tree;

phrases.he: בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כָּל בָּאֵי הָעוֹלָם עוֹבְרִין לְפָנָיו כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן,
phrases.en: on Rosh HaShana, all creatures pass before Him like sheep [benei maron],

phrases.he: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (תהלים לג) הַיּוֹצֵר יַחַד לִבָּם, הַמֵּבִין אֶל כָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם.
phrases.en: as it is stated: "He Who fashions their hearts alike, Who considers all their deeds" (Psalms 33:15);

phrases.he: וּבֶחָג נִדּוֹנִין עַל הַמָּיִם:
phrases.en: and on the festival they are judged concerning water,

phrases.he: עַל שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים הַשְּׁלוּחִין יוֹצְאִים
phrases.en: In six months of the year the messengers go out

phrases.he: עַל נִיסָן מִפְּנֵי הַפֶּסַח
phrases.en: in the month of Nisan, due to Passover

phrases.he: עַל אָב מִפְּנֵי הַתַּעֲנִית
phrases.en: in the month of Av, due to the fast

phrases.he: עַל אֱלוּל מִפְּנֵי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה
phrases.en: in Elul, due to Rosh HaShana

phrases.he: עַל תִּשְׁרֵי מִפְּנֵי תַקָּנַת הַמּוֹעֲדוֹת
phrases.en: in Tishrei, due to the correct dates on which to celebrate the Festivals

phrases.he: עַל כִּסְלֵו מִפְּנֵי חֲנֻכָּה
phrases.en: in Kislev, due to Hanukkah

phrases.he: וְעַל אֲדָר מִפְּנֵי הַפּוּרִים
phrases.en: and in Adar, due to Purim

phrases.he: וּכְשֶׁהָיָה בֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ קַיָּם
phrases.en: And when the Temple was standing

phrases.he: יוֹצְאִין אַף עַל אִיָּר מִפְּנֵי פֶסַח קָטָן
phrases.en: messengers would also go out in the month of Iyyar due to small Passover

phrases.he: עַל שְׁנֵי חֳדָשִׁים מְחַלְּלִין אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת,
phrases.en: Only for the sake of two months may witnesses who saw the new moon desecrate Shabbat, should that be necessary in order for them to offer testimony before the court:

phrases.he: עַל נִיסָן וְעַל תִּשְׁרֵי,
phrases.en: For the month of Nisan and for the month of Tishrei,

phrases.he: שֶׁבָּהֶן הַשְּׁלוּחִין יוֹצְאִין לְסוּרְיָא,
phrases.en: for in these months messengers are sent out to Syria,

phrases.he: וּבָהֶן מְתַקְּנִין אֶת הַמּוֹעֲדוֹת.
phrases.en: and by them, the dates of the major Festivals are set:

phrases.he: וּכְשֶׁהָיָה בֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ קַיָּם,
phrases.en: And when the Temple was standing,

phrases.he: מְחַלְּלִין אַף עַל כֻּלָּן מִפְּנֵי תַקָּנַת הַקָּרְבָּן:
phrases.en: the witnesses desecrated Shabbat for the fixing of the New Moon of all the months, due to the imperative of fixing the proper offering of the New Moon at the correct time.

phrases.he: בֵּין שֶׁנִּרְאָה בַעֲלִיל בֵּין שֶׁלֹּא נִרְאָה בַעֲלִיל, מְחַלְּלִין עָלָיו אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת,
phrases.en: Whether the new moon was seen clearly or whether it was not clearly seen, one may desecrate Shabbat

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, אִם נִרְאָה בַעֲלִיל, אֵין מְחַלְּלִין עָלָיו אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: If the moon was clearly seen, they may not desecrate Shabbat for it,

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁעָבְרוּ יוֹתֵר מֵאַרְבָּעִים זוּג
phrases.en: an incident where more than forty pairs of witnesses were passing

phrases.he: וְעִכְּבָן רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא בְלוּד
phrases.en: and Rabbi Akiva detained them in Lod

phrases.he: שָׁלַח לוֹ רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל
phrases.en: Rabban Gamliel sent to him

phrases.he: אִם מְעַכֵּב אַתָּה אֶת הָרַבִּים, נִמְצֵאתָ מַכְשִׁילָן לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא
phrases.en: If you detain the many people who wish to testify about the new moon, you will cause them to stumble in the future

phrases.he: אָב וּבְנוֹ שֶׁרָאוּ אֶת הַחֹדֶשׁ, יֵלְכוּ.
phrases.en: a father and his son saw the new moon, they should both go to the court in Jerusalem.

phrases.he: לֹא שֶׁמִּצְטָרְפִין זֶה עִם זֶה, אֶלָּא שֶׁאִם יִפָּסֵל אֶחָד מֵהֶן, יִצְטָרֵף הַשֵּׁנִי עִם אַחֵר.
phrases.en: It is not that they can join together to give testimony, for close relatives are disqualified from testifying together, but they both go so that if one of them is disqualified, the second may join together with another witness to testify about the new moon.

phrases.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר, אָב וּבְנוֹ וְכָל הַקְּרוֹבִין, כְּשֵׁרִין לְעֵדוּת הַחֹדֶשׁ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon says: A father and his son and all their relatives are fit to combine together as witnesses for testimony to determine the start of the month.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי, מַעֲשֶׂה בְטוֹבִיָּה הָרוֹפֵא, שֶׁרָאָה אֶת הַחֹדֶשׁ בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, הוּא וּבְנוֹ וְעַבְדּוֹ מְשֻׁחְרָר, וְקִבְּלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אוֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ, וּפָסְלוּ אֶת עַבְדּוֹ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei said: There was an incident with Toviyya the doctor. When he saw the new moon in Jerusalem, he and his son and his freed slave all went to testify. The priests accepted him and his son as witnesses and disqualified his slave, for they ruled stringently that the month may be sanctified only on the basis of the testimony of those of Jewish lineage.

phrases.he: וּכְשֶׁבָּאוּ לִפְנֵי בֵית דִּין, קִבְּלוּ אוֹתוֹ וְאֶת עַבְדּוֹ, וּפָסְלוּ אֶת בְּנוֹ:
phrases.en: And when they came before the court, they accepted him and his slave as witnesses and disqualified his son, due to the familial relationship.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ הֵן הַפְּסוּלִין,
phrases.en: The following are unfit

phrases.he: הַמְשַׂחֵק בְּקֻבְיָא,
phrases.en: One who plays with dice [kubbiyya]

phrases.he: וּמַלְוֵי בְרִבִּית,
phrases.en: and those who lend money with interest

phrases.he: וּמַפְרִיחֵי יוֹנִים,
phrases.en: and those who race pigeons

phrases.he: וְסוֹחֲרֵי שְׁבִיעִית,
phrases.en: and merchants who deal in produce of the Sabbatical Year

phrases.he: וַעֲבָדִים.
phrases.en: and slaves

phrases.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל, כָּל עֵדוּת שֶׁאֵין הָאִשָּׁה כְשֵׁרָה לָהּ, אַף הֵן אֵינָן כְּשֵׁרִים לָהּ:
phrases.en: This is the principle: Any testimony for which a woman is unfit, these too are unfit.

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁרָאָה אֶת הַחֹדֶשׁ וְאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהַלֵּךְ, מוֹלִיכִין אוֹתוֹ עַל הַחֲמוֹר, אֲפִלּוּ בְמִטָּה.
phrases.en: one who saw the new moon but is unable to go to Jerusalem by foot because he is sick or has difficulty walking, others may bring him on a donkey or even in a bed, even on Shabbat if necessary.

phrases.he: וְאִם צוֹדֶה לָהֶם, לוֹקְחִין בְּיָדָם מַקְּלוֹת.
phrases.en: And if the witnesses are concerned that bandits may be lying in wait for them along the road, they may take clubs or other weapons in their hands, even on Shabbat.

phrases.he: וְאִם הָיְתָה דֶרֶךְ רְחוֹקָה, לוֹקְחִין בְּיָדָם מְזוֹנוֹת, שֶׁעַל מַהֲלַךְ לַיְלָה וָיוֹם מְחַלְּלִין אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת וְיוֹצְאִין לְעֵדוּת הַחֹדֶשׁ.
phrases.en: And if it was a long journey to Jerusalem, they may take sustenance with them, although it is ordinarily prohibited to carry on Shabbat, since for a distance of a walk of a night and a day, the witnesses may desecrate Shabbat and go out to give testimony to determine the start of the month.

phrases.he: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ויקרא כג), אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי ה' אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אוֹתָם בְּמוֹעֲדָם.
phrases.en: This is as it is stated: "These are the Festivals of the Lord, sacred gatherings, which you shall declare in their seasons" (Leviticus 23:4).

phrases.he: אִם אֵינָן מַכִּירִין אוֹתוֹ, מְשַׁלְּחִין אַחֵר עִמּוֹ לַהֲעִידוֹ.
phrases.en: If the members of the Great Sanhedrin in Jerusalem are not familiar with that one who saw the new moon, the members of his local court of twenty-three send another with him to testify about him.

phrases.he: בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה הָיוּ מְקַבְּלִין עֵדוּת הַחֹדֶשׁ מִכָּל אָדָם.
phrases.en: Initially, the court would accept testimony to determine the start of the month from any person.

phrases.he: מִשֶּׁקִּלְקְלוּ הַמִּינִין, הִתְקִינוּ שֶׁלֹּא יְהוּ מְקַבְּלִין אֶלָּא מִן הַמַּכִּירִים:
phrases.en: When the Boethusians corrupted the process by sending false witnesses to testify about the new moon, the Sages instituted that they would accept this testimony only from those men familiar to the Sanhedrin as valid witnesses.

phrases.he: בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה הָיוּ מַשִּׂיאִין מַשּׂוּאוֹת.
phrases.en: Initially, they would light torches

phrases.he: מִשֶּׁקִּלְקְלוּ הַכּוּתִים, הִתְקִינוּ שֶׁיְּהוּ שְׁלוּחִין יוֹצְאִין:
phrases.en: After the Samaritans corrupted, the Sages instituted that messengers should go out

phrases.he: כֵּיצַד הָיוּ מַשִּׂיאִין מַשּׂוּאוֹת,
phrases.en: How would they light the torches

phrases.he: מְבִיאִין כְּלֻנְסָאוֹת שֶׁל אֶרֶז אֲרֻכִּין וְקָנִים וַעֲצֵי שֶׁמֶן וּנְעֹרֶת שֶׁל פִּשְׁתָּן
phrases.en: They would bring long poles of cedar, reeds, pinewood, and beaten flax

phrases.he: וְכוֹרֵךְ בִּמְשִׁיחָה,
phrases.en: and tie them together with a string

phrases.he: וְעוֹלֶה לְרֹאשׁ הָהָר
phrases.en: And ascend to the top of the mountain

phrases.he: וּמַצִּית בָּהֶן אֶת הָאוּר,
phrases.en: and light the torch on fire with them

phrases.he: וּמוֹלִיךְ וּמֵבִיא וּמַעֲלֶה וּמוֹרִיד,
phrases.en: and wave it back and forth and up and down

phrases.he: עַד שֶׁהוּא רוֹאֶה אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ שֶׁהוּא עוֹשֶׂה כֵן בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר הַשֵּׁנִי,
phrases.en: until he would see his colleague doing likewise on the top of the second mountain

phrases.he: וְכֵן בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי:
phrases.en: And similarly, on the top of the third mountain

phrases.he: וּמֵאַיִן הָיוּ מַשִּׂיאִים מַשּׂוּאוֹת
phrases.en: And from which mountains would they light the torches?

phrases.he: מֵהַר הַמִּשְׁחָה לְסַרְטְבָא
phrases.en: from the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem to Sartava

phrases.he: וּמִסַּרְטְבָא לִגְרוֹפִינָא
phrases.en: and from Sartava to Gerofina

phrases.he: וּמִגְּרוֹפִינָא לְחַוְרָן
phrases.en: and from Gerofina to Ḥavran

phrases.he: וּמֵחַוְרָן לְבֵית בִּלְתִּין
phrases.en: and from Ḥavran to Beit Baltin

phrases.he: וּמִבֵּית בִּלְתִּין לֹא זָזוּ מִשָּׁם
phrases.en: And from Beit Baltin they would not move

phrases.he: אֶלָּא מוֹלִיךְ וּמֵבִיא וּמַעֲלֶה וּמוֹרִיד
phrases.en: Rather, would wave the torch back and forth and up and down

phrases.he: עַד שֶׁהָיָה רוֹאֶה כָל הַגּוֹלָה לְפָנָיו כִּמְדוּרַת הָאֵשׁ
phrases.en: until he would see the entire Diaspora before him like one large bonfire

phrases.he: חָצֵר גְּדוֹלָה הָיְתָה בִירוּשָׁלַיִם, וּבֵית יַעְזֵק הָיְתָה נִקְרֵאת, וּלְשָׁם כָּל הָעֵדִים מִתְכַּנְּסִים, וּבֵית דִּין בּוֹדְקִין אוֹתָם שָׁם.
phrases.en: There was a large courtyard in Jerusalem, which was called Beit Ya'zek. And there all the witnesses gather, and the court examine them there.

phrases.he: וּסְעוּדוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת עוֹשִׂין לָהֶם בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁיְּהוּ רְגִילִין לָבֹא.
phrases.en: And they prepare great feasts for them, so that they would be willing and accustomed to coming.

phrases.he: בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה לֹא הָיוּ זָזִין מִשָּׁם כָּל הַיּוֹם,
phrases.en: Initially, they would not move from there all day,

phrases.he: הִתְקִין רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל הַזָּקֵן שֶׁיְּהוּ מְהַלְּכִין אַלְפַּיִם אַמָּה לְכָל רוּחַ.
phrases.en: Rabban Gamliel the Elder instituted that they be permitted to walk two thousand cubits in each direction.

phrases.he: וְלֹא אֵלּוּ בִלְבַד, אֶלָּא אַף הַחֲכָמָה הַבָּאָה לְיַלֵּד, וְהַבָּא לְהַצִּיל מִן הַדְּלֵקָה וּמִן הַגַּיִס וּמִן הַנָּהָר וּמִן הַמַּפֹּלֶת, הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ כְאַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר, וְיֵשׁ לָהֶם אַלְפַּיִם אַמָּה לְכָל רוּחַ:
phrases.en: And not only these, but also a midwife who comes to deliver a child, and one who comes to rescue from a fire, from troops, from a river, or from a collapse, these are like the inhabitants of the city, and they have two thousand cubits in each direction.

phrases.he: כֵּיצַד בּוֹדְקִין אֶת הָעֵדִים.
phrases.en: How do they examine the witnesses

phrases.he: זוּג שֶׁבָּא רִאשׁוֹן, בּוֹדְקִין אוֹתוֹ רִאשׁוֹן.
phrases.en: the pair that arrives first they examine first

phrases.he: וּמַכְנִיסִין אֶת הַגָּדוֹל שֶׁבָּהֶם וְאוֹמְרִים לוֹ, אֱמֹר, כֵּיצַד רָאִיתָ אֶת הַלְּבָנָה,
phrases.en: They bring in the greater of the two witnesses, and they say to him: Say how you saw the moon.

phrases.he: לִפְנֵי הַחַמָּה אוֹ לְאַחַר הַחַמָּה, לִצְפוֹנָהּ אוֹ לִדְרוֹמָהּ, כַּמָּה הָיָה גָבוֹהַּ וּלְאַיִן הָיָה נוֹטֶה, וְכַמָּה הָיָה רָחָב.
phrases.en: Was it in front of the sun or behind the sun? To its north or to its south? How high was the moon over the horizon, and in which direction did it tilt? And how wide was it?

phrases.he: אִם אָמַר לִפְנֵי הַחַמָּה, לֹא אָמַר כְּלוּם.
phrases.en: If he said that he saw the moon in front of the sun, he has not said anything of substance, as this is impossible and therefore he is either mistaken or lying.

phrases.he: וְאַחַר כָּךְ הָיוּ מַכְנִיסִים אֶת הַשֵּׁנִי וּבוֹדְקִין אוֹתוֹ.
phrases.en: And after they finish hearing the first witness's testimony, they would bring in the second witness and examine him in a similar manner.

phrases.he: אִם נִמְצְאוּ דִבְרֵיהֶם מְכֻוָּנִים, עֵדוּתָן קַיָּמֶת.
phrases.en: If their statements match, their testimony is accepted and the court sanctifies the New Moon.

phrases.he: וּשְׁאָר כָּל הַזּוּגוֹת שׁוֹאֲלִין אוֹתָם רָאשֵׁי דְבָרִים,
phrases.en: And the court then asks all the other pairs of witnesses certain general matters,

phrases.he: לֹא שֶׁהָיוּ צְרִיכִין לָהֶם, אֶלָּא כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יֵצְאוּ בְּפַחֵי נֶפֶשׁ, בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁיְּהוּ רְגִילִים לָבֹא.
phrases.en: without probing into all the details. They do this not because they require the additional testimony, but so that the witnesses should not leave disappointed, and so that the witnesses should be accustomed to coming to testify, and will not hesitate to come the next time, when they might be needed.

phrases.he: רֹאשׁ בֵּית דִּין אוֹמֵר מְקֻדָּשׁ,
phrases.en: the head of the court says: It is sanctified.

phrases.he: וְכָל הָעָם עוֹנִין אַחֲרָיו מְקֻדָּשׁ מְקֻדָּשׁ.
phrases.en: And all the people respond after him: It is sanctified; it is sanctified.

phrases.he: בֵּין שֶׁנִּרְאָה בִזְמַנּוֹ בֵּין שֶׁלֹּא נִרְאָה בִזְמַנּוֹ, מְקַדְּשִׁין אוֹתוֹ.
phrases.en: Whether the moon was seen at its anticipated time, or whether it was not seen at its anticipated time, the court sanctifies it and formally proclaims the day as the New Moon.

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בְּרַבִּי צָדוֹק אוֹמֵר, אִם לֹא נִרְאָה בִזְמַנּוֹ, אֵין מְקַדְּשִׁין אוֹתוֹ, שֶׁכְּבָר קִדְּשׁוּהוּ שָׁמָיִם:
phrases.en: Rabbi Elazar, son of Rabbi Tzadok, says: If the new moon was not seen at its anticipated time, the court does not sanctify the New Moon on the following day, as the celestial court in Heaven has already sanctified it,

phrases.he: דְּמוּת צוּרוֹת לְבָנוֹת הָיוּ לוֹ לְרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל בַּטַּבְלָא וּבַכֹּתֶל בַּעֲלִיָּתוֹ,
phrases.en: Rabban Gamliel had a diagram of the different forms of the moon drawn on a tablet that hung on the wall of his attic,

phrases.he: שֶׁבָּהֶן מַרְאֶה אֶת הַהֶדְיוֹטוֹת וְאוֹמֵר, הֲכָזֶה רָאִיתָ אוֹ כָזֶה.
phrases.en: which he would show to the laymen and he would say to them: Did you see a form like this or like this?

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁבָּאוּ שְׁנַיִם וְאָמְרוּ, רְאִינוּהוּ שַׁחֲרִית בַּמִּזְרָח וְעַרְבִית בַּמַּעֲרָב.
phrases.en: There was an incident in which two witnesses came to testify about the new moon, and they said: We saw the waning moon in the morning in the east, and that same day we saw the new moon in the evening in the west.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי, עֵדֵי שֶׁקֶר הֵם.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri said: They are false witnesses,

phrases.he: כְּשֶׁבָּאוּ לְיַבְנֶה קִבְּלָן רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל.
phrases.en: when they arrived in Yavne, Rabban Gamliel accepted them as witnesses without concern.

phrases.he: וְעוֹד בָּאוּ שְׁנַיִם וְאָמְרוּ, רְאִינוּהוּ בִזְמַנּוֹ, וּבְלֵיל עִבּוּרוֹ לֹא נִרְאָה, וְקִבְּלָן רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל.
phrases.en: And there was another incident in which two witnesses came and said: We saw the new moon at its anticipated time, however, on the following night, it was not seen. And nevertheless Rabban Gamliel accepted their testimony and established the New Moon on the thirtieth day.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי דוֹסָא בֶּן הַרְכִּינָס, עֵדֵי שֶׁקֶר הֵן, הֵיאָךְ מְעִידִין עַל הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁיָּלְדָה, וּלְמָחָר כְּרֵסָהּ בֵּין שִׁנֶּיהָ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Dosa ben Horkinas said: They are false witnesses; how can witnesses testify that a woman gave birth and the next day her belly is between her teeth,

phrases.he: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ, רוֹאֶה אֲנִי אֶת דְּבָרֶיךָ:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehoshua said to him: I see the logic of your statement;

phrases.he: שָׁלַח לוֹ רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל, גּוֹזְרַנִי עָלֶיךָ שֶׁתָּבֹא אֶצְלִי בְּמַקֶּלְךָ וּבִמְעוֹתֶיךָ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים שֶׁחָל לִהְיוֹת בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹנְךָ.
phrases.en: Rabban Gamliel sent a message to him: I decree against you that you must appear before me with your staff and with your money on the day on which Yom Kippur occurs according to your calculation;

phrases.he: הָלַךְ וּמְצָאוֹ רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא מֵצֵר, אָמַר לוֹ, יֶשׁ לִי לִלְמוֹד שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁעָשָׂה רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל עָשׂוּי, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ויקרא כג), אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְיָ מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ, אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם, בֵּין בִּזְמַנָּן בֵּין שֶׁלֹּא בִזְמַנָּן, אֵין לִי מוֹעֲדוֹת אֶלָּא אֵלּוּ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva went and found him distressed. said to him: I can learn that everything that Rabban Gamliel did is done. As it is stated: "These are the appointed seasons of the Lord, sacred convocations, which you shall proclaim whether at their proper time or whether not at their proper time, I have only these Festivals as established by the representatives of the Jewish people.

phrases.he: בָּא לוֹ אֵצֶל רַבִּי דוֹסָא בֶּן הַרְכִּינָס, אָמַר לוֹ, אִם בָּאִין אָנוּ לָדוּן אַחַר בֵּית דִּינוֹ שֶׁל רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל, צְרִיכִין אָנוּ לָדוּן אַחַר כָּל בֵּית דִּין וּבֵית דִּין שֶׁעָמַד מִימוֹת משֶׁה וְעַד עַכְשָׁיו, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (שמות כד), וַיַּעַל משֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא וְשִׁבְעִים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
phrases.en: He came to Rabbi Dosa ben Horkinas, who said to him: If we come to debate the court of Rabban Gamliel, we must debate every court that has stood from the days of Moses until now. As it is stated: "Then Moses went up, and Aaron, Nadav and Avihu, and seventy of the Elders of Israel"

phrases.he: וְלָמָּה לֹא נִתְפָּרְשׁוּ שְׁמוֹתָן שֶׁל זְקֵנִים, אֶלָּא לְלַמֵּד, שֶׁכָּל שְׁלשָׁה וּשְׁלשָׁה שֶׁעָמְדוּ בֵית דִּין עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, הֲרֵי הוּא כְבֵית דִּינוֹ שֶׁל משֶׁה.
phrases.en: But why were the names of these Elders not specified? Rather, this comes to teach that every set of three judges that stands as a court over the Jewish people has the same status as the court of Moses.

phrases.he: נָטַל מַקְלוֹ וּמְעוֹתָיו בְּיָדוֹ, וְהָלַךְ לְיַבְנֶה אֵצֶל רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל בְּיוֹם שֶׁחָל יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים לִהְיוֹת בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹ.
phrases.en: He took his staff and his money in his hand, and went to Yavne to Rabban Gamliel on the day on which Yom Kippur occurred according to his own calculation.

phrases.he: עָמַד רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל וּנְשָׁקוֹ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ, אָמַר לוֹ, בֹּא בְשָׁלוֹם, רַבִּי וְתַלְמִידִי, רַבִּי בְחָכְמָה, וְתַלְמִידִי שֶׁקִּבַּלְתָּ דְּבָרָי:
phrases.en: Rabban Gamliel stood up and kissed him on his head. He said to him: Come in peace, my teacher and my student. You are my teacher in wisdom, and you are my student, as you accepted my statement,

phrases.he: רָאוּהוּ בֵית דִּין וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל,
phrases.en: the court and all of the Jewish people saw

phrases.he: נֶחְקְרוּ הָעֵדִים,
phrases.en: the witnesses were interrogated,

phrases.he: וְלֹא הִסְפִּיקוּ לוֹמַר מְקֻדָּשׁ, עַד שֶׁחֲשֵׁכָה,
phrases.en: but the court did not manage to say: Sanctified, before nightfall,

phrases.he: הֲרֵי זֶה מְעֻבָּר.
phrases.en: is rendered a full,

phrases.he: רָאוּהוּ בֵית דִּין בִּלְבַד,
phrases.en: the court alone saw the new moon,

phrases.he: יַעַמְדוּ שְׁנַיִם וְיָעִידוּ בִפְנֵיהֶם,
phrases.en: two should stand and testify before the others,

phrases.he: וְיֹאמְרוּ מְקֻדָּשׁ מְקֻדָּשׁ.
phrases.en: the court should say: Sanctified, sanctified.

phrases.he: רָאוּהוּ שְׁלשָׁה וְהֵן בֵּית דִּין,
phrases.en: three people saw the new moon, and they are themselves members of a court

phrases.he: יַעַמְדוּ הַשְּׁנַיִם וְיוֹשִׁיבוּ מֵחַבְרֵיהֶם אֵצֶל הַיָּחִיד וְיָעִידוּ בִפְנֵיהֶם,
phrases.en: two of them should stand and seat two of their colleagues next to the individual who remains of the three, thereby forming a new court of three. The two standing judges should testify before

phrases.he: וְיֹאמְרוּ מְקֻדָּשׁ מְקֻדָּשׁ,
phrases.en: say: Sanctified, sanctified.

phrases.he: שֶׁאֵין הַיָּחִיד נֶאֱמָן עַל יְדֵי עַצְמוֹ:
phrases.en: because an individual is not authorized by himself.

phrases.he: כָּל הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת כְּשֵׁרִין חוּץ מִשֶּׁל פָּרָה, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא קֶרֶן.
phrases.en: All shofarot are fit except for the horn of a cow, because it is a horn [keren]

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי, וַהֲלֹא כָל הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת נִקְרְאוּ קֶרֶן, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (יהושע ו), בִּמְשֹׁךְ בְּקֶרֶן הַיּוֹבֵל:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei said: But aren't all shofarot called horn, as it is stated: that when they sound a long blast with the horn [keren] of a ram [yovel]

phrases.he: שׁוֹפָר שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה שֶׁל יָעֵל, פָּשׁוּט, וּפִיו מְצֻפֶּה זָהָב
phrases.en: The shofar that was used on Rosh HaShana in the Temple was made from the straight horn of an ibex, and its mouth, the mouthpiece into which one blows, was plated with gold.

phrases.he: וּשְׁתֵּי חֲצוֹצְרוֹת מִן הַצְּדָדִין
phrases.en: And there were two trumpets, one on each of the two sides of the person sounding the shofar.

phrases.he: שׁוֹפָר מַאֲרִיךְ וַחֲצוֹצְרוֹת מְקַצְּרוֹת, שֶׁמִּצְוַת הַיּוֹם בַּשּׁוֹפָר
phrases.en: The shofar would sound a long blast, whereas the trumpets would sound a short blast, because the mitzva of the day is with the shofar.

phrases.he: בַּתַּעֲנִיּוֹת, בְּשֶׁל זְכָרִים, כְּפוּפִין, וּפִיהֶן מְצֻפֶּה כֶסֶף,
phrases.en: on public fast days were made from the curved horns of rams, and their mouths were plated with silver.

phrases.he: וּשְׁתֵּי חֲצוֹצְרוֹת בָּאֶמְצַע.
phrases.en: There were two trumpets in the middle

phrases.he: שׁוֹפָר מְקַצֵּר וַחֲצוֹצְרוֹת מַאֲרִיכוֹת,
phrases.en: the shofar would sound a short blast, whereas the trumpets would sound a long blast,

phrases.he: שֶׁמִּצְוַת הַיּוֹם בַּחֲצוֹצְרוֹת:
phrases.en: for the mitzva of the day is with the trumpets.

phrases.he: שָׁוֶה הַיּוֹבֵל לְרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לַתְּקִיעָה וְלַבְּרָכוֹת.
phrases.en: the Jubilee Year is the same as Rosh HaShana with regard to both the shofar blasts that are sounded and the additional blessings that are recited in the Amida prayer.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה תּוֹקְעִין בְּשֶׁל זְכָרִים, וּבַיּוֹבְלוֹת בְּשֶׁל יְעֵלִים:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says: On Rosh HaShana one blows with horns of rams, whereas in Jubilee Years one blows with horns of ibexes.

phrases.he: שׁוֹפָר שֶׁנִּסְדַּק וְדִבְּקוֹ, פָּסוּל.
phrases.en: A shofar that was cracked and then glued together, even though it appears to be whole, is unfit.

phrases.he: דִּבֵּק שִׁבְרֵי שׁוֹפָרוֹת, פָּסוּל.
phrases.en: Similarly, if one glued together broken fragments of shofarot to form a complete shofar, the shofar is unfit.

phrases.he: נִקַּב וּסְתָמוֹ, אִם מְעַכֵּב אֶת הַתְּקִיעָה, פָּסוּל.
phrases.en: If the shofar was punctured and the puncture was sealed, if it impedes the blowing, the shofar is unfit,

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, כָּשֵׁר:
phrases.en: but if not, it is fit.

phrases.he: הַתּוֹקֵעַ לְתוֹךְ הַבּוֹר אוֹ לְתוֹךְ הַדּוּת אוֹ לְתוֹךְ הַפִּטָּס, אִם קוֹל שׁוֹפָר שָׁמַע, יָצָא.
phrases.en: If one sounds a shofar into a pit, or into a cistern, or into a large jug, if he clearly heard the sound of the shofar, he has fulfilled his obligation;

phrases.he: וְאִם קוֹל הֲבָרָה שָׁמַע, לֹא יָצָא.
phrases.en: but if he heard the sound of an echo, he has not fulfilled his obligation.

phrases.he: וְכֵן מִי שֶׁהָיָה עוֹבֵר אֲחוֹרֵי בֵית הַכְּנֶסֶת, אוֹ שֶׁהָיָה בֵיתוֹ סָמוּךְ לְבֵית הַכְּנֶסֶת, וְשָׁמַע קוֹל שׁוֹפָר אוֹ קוֹל מְגִלָּה, אִם כִּוֵּן לִבּוֹ, יָצָא, וְאִם לָאו, לֹא יָצָא.
phrases.en: And similarly, if one was passing behind a synagogue, or his house was adjacent to the synagogue, and he heard the sound of the shofar or the sound of the Scroll of Esther being read, if he focused his heart, i.e. his intent, to fulfill his obligation, he has fulfilled his obligation; but if not, he has not fulfilled his obligation.

phrases.he: אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁזֶּה שָׁמַע וְזֶה שָׁמַע, זֶה כִּוֵּן לִבּוֹ וְזֶה לֹא כִוֵּן לִבּוֹ:
phrases.en: Even though this one heard and also the other one heard, nevertheless, this one focused his heart to fulfill his obligation and has therefore indeed fulfilled it, but the other one did not focus his heart, and so he has not fulfilled his obligation.

phrases.he: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרִים משֶׁה יָדוֹ וְגָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגוֹ' (שמות יז)
phrases.en: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed; and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed (Exodus 17:11).

phrases.he: וְכִי יָדָיו שֶׁל משֶׁה עוֹשׂוֹת מִלְחָמָה אוֹ שׁוֹבְרוֹת מִלְחָמָה.
phrases.en: Did the hands of Moses make war when he raised them or break war when he lowered them?

phrases.he: אֶלָּא לוֹמַר לְךָ, כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהָיוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִסְתַּכְּלִים כְּלַפֵּי מַעְלָה וּמְשַׁעְבְּדִין אֶת לִבָּם לַאֲבִיהֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם הָיוּ מִתְגַּבְּרִים וְאִם לָאו, הָיוּ נוֹפְלִין.
phrases.en: Rather, the verse comes to tell you that as long as the Jewish people turned their eyes upward and subjected their hearts to their Father in Heaven, they prevailed, but if not, they fell.

phrases.he: כַּיּוֹצֵא בַדָּבָר אַתָּה אוֹמֵר (במדבר כא), עֲשֵׂה לְךָ שָׂרָף וְשִׂים אֹתוֹ עַל נֵס, וְהָיָה כָּל הַנָּשׁוּךְ וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ וָחָי.
phrases.en: Similarly, you can say: The verse states: Make for yourself a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole; and it shall come to pass, that everyone that is bitten, when he sees it, he shall live (Numbers 21:8).

phrases.he: וְכִי נָחָשׁ מֵמִית, אוֹ נָחָשׁ מְחַיֶּה.
phrases.en: Did the serpent kill, or did the serpent preserve life?

phrases.he: אֶלָּא, בִּזְמַן שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל מִסְתַּכְּלִים כְּלַפֵּי מַעְלָה וּמְשַׁעְבְּדִין אֶת לִבָּם לַאֲבִיהֶן שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם, הָיוּ מִתְרַפְּאִים, וְאִם לָאו, הָיוּ נִמּוֹקִים.
phrases.en: Rather, when the Jewish people turned their eyes upward and subjected their hearts to their Father in Heaven, they were healed, but if not, they rotted from their snakebites.

phrases.he: חֵרֵשׁ, שׁוֹטֶה, וְקָטָן, אֵין מוֹצִיאִין אֶת הָרַבִּים יְדֵי חוֹבָתָן.
phrases.en: A deaf-mute, an imbecile, or a minor who sounds the shofar cannot discharge the obligation on behalf of the community.

phrases.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל, כֹּל שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְחֻיָּב בַּדָּבָר, אֵינוֹ מוֹצִיא אֶת הָרַבִּים יְדֵי חוֹבָתָן:
phrases.en: This is the principle with regard to similar matters: Whoever is not obligated to do a certain matter cannot discharge the obligation on behalf of the community.

phrases.he: יוֹם טוֹב שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה שֶׁחָל לִהְיוֹת בְּשַׁבָּת, בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ הָיוּ תוֹקְעִים, אֲבָל לֹא בַמְּדִינָה.
phrases.en: Festival day of Rosh HaShana that occurs on Shabbat, in the Temple they would sound the shofar as usual. However, they would not sound it in the rest of the country outside the Temple.

phrases.he: מְשֶּׁחָרַב בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, הִתְקִין רַבָּן יוֹחָנָן בֶּן זַכַּאי, שֶׁיְּהוּ תּוֹקְעִין בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ בֵית דִּין.
phrases.en: After the Temple was destroyed, Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai instituted that the people should sound the shofar on Shabbat in every place where there is a court of twenty-three judges.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר, לֹא הִתְקִין רַבָּן יוֹחָנָן בֶּן זַכַּאי אֶלָּא בְיַבְנֶה בִּלְבָד.
phrases.en: Rabbi Elazar said: Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai instituted only in Yavne,

phrases.he: אָמְרוּ לוֹ, אֶחָד יַבְנֶה וְאֶחָד כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ בֵית דִּין:
phrases.en: They said to him: He instituted the practice both in Yavne and in any place where there is a court.

phrases.he: וְעוֹד זֹאת הָיְתָה יְרוּשָׁלַיִם יְתֵרָה עַל יַבְנֶה,
phrases.en: And Jerusalem had this additional superiority over Yavne

phrases.he: שֶׁכָּל עִיר שֶׁהִיא רוֹאָה וְשׁוֹמַעַת וּקְרוֹבָה וִיכוֹלָה לָבֹא, תּוֹקְעִין.
phrases.en: for in any city whose residents could see Jerusalem and hear the sounding of the shofar from there, and which was near to Jerusalem and people could come to Jerusalem from there, they would sound the shofar there as well

phrases.he: וּבְיַבְנֶה לֹא הָיוּ תוֹקְעִין אֶלָּא בְּבֵית דִּין בִּלְבָד:
phrases.en: But in Yavne they would sound the shofar only in the court itself

phrases.he: בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה הָיָה הַלּוּלָב נִטָּל בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ שִׁבְעָה, וּבַמְּדִינָה יוֹם אֶחָד.
phrases.en: At first, during the Temple era, the lulav was taken in the Temple all seven days of Sukkot, and in the rest of the country outside the Temple, it was taken only one day, on the first day of the Festival.

phrases.he: מִשֶּׁחָרַב בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, הִתְקִין רַבָּן יוֹחָנָן בֶּן זַכַּאי שֶׁיְהֵא לוּלָב נִטָּל בַּמְּדִינָה שִׁבְעָה זֵכֶר לַמִּקְדָּשׁ.
phrases.en: After the Temple was destroyed, Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai instituted that the lulav should be taken even in the rest of the country all seven days, in commemoration of the Temple.

phrases.he: וְשֶׁיְּהֵא יוֹם הָנֵף כֻּלּוֹ אָסוּר.
phrases.en: And that for the entire day of waving the omer offering, i.e., the sixteenth of Nisan, eating the grain of the new crop is prohibited.

phrases.he: בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה הָיוּ מְקַבְּלִין עֵדוּת הַחֹדֶשׁ כָּל הַיּוֹם.
phrases.en: Initially, they would accept testimony to determine the start of the month throughout the entire day.

phrases.he: פַּעַם אַחַת נִשְׁתַּהוּ הָעֵדִים מִלָּבֹא, וְנִתְקַלְקְלוּ הַלְוִיִּם בַּשִּׁיר.
phrases.en: Once, the witnesses tarried coming and the Levites erred with regard to the song.

phrases.he: הִתְקִינוּ שֶׁלֹּא יְהוּ מְקַבְּלִין אֶלָּא עַד הַמִּנְחָה.
phrases.en: They instituted that they would accept testimony only until minḥa time.

phrases.he: וְאִם בָּאוּ עֵדִים מִן הַמִּנְחָה וּלְמַעְלָה, נוֹהֲגִין אוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם קֹדֶשׁ וּלְמָחָר קֹדֶשׁ.
phrases.en: And if witnesses came from minḥa time onward, they observe that day sacred, and the following day sacred.

phrases.he: מִשֶּׁחָרַב בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הִתְקִין רַבָּן יוֹחָנָן בֶּן זַכַּאי, שֶׁיְּהוּ מְקַבְּלִין עֵדוּת הַחֹדֶשׁ כָּל הַיּוֹם.
phrases.en: After the Temple was destroyed Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai instituted that they would accept testimony to determine the start of the month the entire day.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֶּן קָרְחָה, וְעוֹד זֹאת הִתְקִין רַבָּן יוֹחָנָן בֶּן זַכַּאי, שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ רֹאשׁ בֵּית דִּין בְּכָל מָקוֹם, שֶׁלֹּא יְהוּ הָעֵדִים הוֹלְכִין אֶלָּא לִמְקוֹם הַוָּעַד.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korḥa said: And this, too, Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai instituted, that even the head of the court is in any place, the witnesses should go only to the place where the Great Sanhedrin gathers.

phrases.he: סֵדֶר בְּרָכוֹת, אוֹמֵר אָבוֹת וּגְבוּרוֹת וּקְדֻשַּׁת הַשֵּׁם, וְכוֹלֵל מַלְכוּיוֹת עִמָּהֶן, וְאֵינוֹ תוֹקֵעַ.
phrases.en: The order of the blessings of the additional prayer on Rosh HaShana is as follows: One recites the blessing of the Patriarchs, the blessing of God's Mighty Deeds, and the blessing of the Sanctification of God's Name, all of which are recited all year long. And one includes the blessing of Kingship, containing many biblical verses on that theme, with them, i.e., in the blessing of the Sanctification of God's Name, and he does not sound the shofar after it.

phrases.he: קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם, וְתוֹקֵעַ.
phrases.en: Next, one adds a special blessing for the Sanctification of the Day, and sounds the shofar after it;

phrases.he: זִכְרוֹנוֹת, וְתוֹקֵעַ.
phrases.en: followed by the blessing of Remembrances, which contains many biblical verses addressing that theme, and sounds the shofar after it;

phrases.he: שׁוֹפָרוֹת, וְתוֹקֵעַ.
phrases.en: and recites the blessing of Shofarot, which includes verses that mention the shofar, and sounds the shofar after it.

phrases.he: וְאוֹמֵר עֲבוֹדָה וְהוֹדָאָה וּבִרְכַּת כֹּהֲנִים, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי.
phrases.en: And he then returns to the regular Amida prayer and recites the blessing of God's Service and the blessing of Thanksgiving and the Priestly Blessing. This is the statement of Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri.

phrases.he: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, אִם אֵינוֹ תוֹקֵעַ לַמַּלְכוּיוֹת, לָמָּה הוּא מַזְכִּיר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva said to him: If one does not sound the shofar for the blessing of Kingship, why does he mention it?

phrases.he: אֶלָּא אוֹמֵר אָבוֹת וּגְבוּרוֹת וּקְדֻשַּׁת הַשֵּׁם, וְכוֹלֵל מַלְכוּיוֹת עִם קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם, וְתוֹקֵעַ.
phrases.en: Rather, the order of the blessings is as follows: One recites the blessing of the Patriarchs and that of God's Mighty Deeds and that of the Sanctification of God's Name. He subsequently includes the blessing of Kingship in the blessing of the Sanctification of the Day, and sounds the shofar.

phrases.he: זִכְרוֹנוֹת, וְתוֹקֵעַ.
phrases.en: Next he recites the blessing of Remembrances, and sounds the shofar after it,

phrases.he: שׁוֹפָרוֹת, וְתוֹקֵעַ.
phrases.en: and the blessing of Shofarot and sounds the shofar after it.

phrases.he: וְאוֹמֵר עֲבוֹדָה וְהוֹדָאָה וּבִרְכַּת כֹּהֲנִים:
phrases.en: He then recites the blessing of God's Service and the blessing of Thanksgiving and the Priestly Blessing.

phrases.he: אֵין פּוֹחֲתִין מֵעֲשָׂרָה מַלְכוּיוֹת, מֵעֲשָׂרָה זִכְרוֹנוֹת, מֵעֲשָׂרָה שׁוֹפָרוֹת.
phrases.en: One does not recite fewer than ten verses in the blessing of Kingship, or fewer than ten verses in the blessing of Remembrances, or fewer than ten verses in the blessing of Shofarot.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי אוֹמֵר, אִם אָמַר שָׁלשׁ שָׁלשׁ מִכֻּלָּן, יָצָא.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri says: If one recited three from each of them, he has fulfilled his obligation.

phrases.he: אֵין מַזְכִּירִין זִכָּרוֹן מַלְכוּת וְשׁוֹפָר שֶׁל פֻּרְעָנוּת.
phrases.en: One does not mention verses of Remembrance, Kingship, and Shofar that have a theme of punishment.

phrases.he: מַתְחִיל בַּתּוֹרָה וּמַשְׁלִים בַּנָּבִיא.
phrases.en: One begins with verses from the Torah and concludes with verses from the Prophets.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, אִם הִשְׁלִים בַּתּוֹרָה, יָצָא:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: If he concluded with a verse from the Torah, he has fulfilled his obligation.

phrases.he: הָעוֹבֵר לִפְנֵי הַתֵּבָה בְּיוֹם טוֹב שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, הַשֵּׁנִי מַתְקִיעַ.
phrases.en: one who is passing before the ark, on the festival of Rosh HaShana, it is the second prayer leader who sounds the shofar

phrases.he: וּבִשְׁעַת הַהַלֵּל, רִאשׁוֹן מַקְרֵא אֶת הַהַלֵּל:
phrases.en: And when the hallel is recited, the first prayer leader recites the hallel

phrases.he: שׁוֹפָר שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, אֵין מַעֲבִירִין עָלָיו אֶת הַתְּחוּם, וְאֵין מְפַקְּחִין עָלָיו אֶת הַגַּל.
phrases.en: the shofar of Rosh HaShana, one may not pass the Shabbat limit for it, nor may one clear a pile

phrases.he: לֹא עוֹלִין בְּאִילָן, וְלֹא רוֹכְבִין עַל גַּבֵּי בְהֵמָה, וְלֹא שָׁטִין עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם.
phrases.en: One may not climb a tree, nor may one ride on an animal, nor may one swim in water,

phrases.he: וְאֵין חוֹתְכִין אוֹתוֹ בֵּין בְּדָבָר שֶׁהוּא מִשּׁוּם שְׁבוּת, וּבֵין בְּדָבָר שֶׁהוּא מִשּׁוּם לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה.
phrases.en: And one may not cut the shofar to prepare it for use, neither with an object that is prohibited due to a rabbinic decree nor with an object that may not be used due to a prohibition by Torah law.

phrases.he: אֲבָל אִם רָצָה לִתֵּן לְתוֹכוֹ מַיִם אוֹ יַיִן, יִתֵּן.
phrases.en: However, if one wishes to place water or wine into the shofar on Rosh HaShana so that it emits a clear sound, he may place it,

phrases.he: אֵין מְעַכְּבִין אֶת הַתִּינוֹקוֹת מִלִּתְקוֹעַ, אֲבָל מִתְעַסְּקִין עִמָּהֶן עַד שֶׁיִּלְמְדוּ.
phrases.en: One need not prevent children from sounding the shofar on Rosh HaShana, despite the fact that they are not obligated in mitzvot. Rather, one occupies himself with them, encouraging and instructing them, until they learn how to sound it properly.

phrases.he: וְהַמִּתְעַסֵּק, לֹא יָצָא.
phrases.en: One who acts unawares and sounds the shofar without any intention to perform the mitzva has not fulfilled his obligation.

phrases.he: וְהַשּׁוֹמֵעַ מִן הַמִּתְעַסֵּק, לֹא יָצָא:
phrases.en: And, similarly, one who hears the shofar blasts from one who acts unawares has not fulfilled his obligation.

phrases.he: סֵדֶר תְּקִיעוֹת, שָׁלשׁ, שֶׁל שָׁלשׁ שָׁלשׁ.
phrases.en: The order of the blasts is three sets of three blasts each,

phrases.he: שִׁעוּר תְּקִיעָה כְּשָׁלשׁ תְּרוּעוֹת.
phrases.en: The length of a tekia is equal to the length of three teruot,

phrases.he: שִׁעוּר תְּרוּעָה כְּשָׁלשׁ יְבָבוֹת.
phrases.en: and the length of a terua is equal to the length of three whimpers.

phrases.he: תָּקַע בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה, וּמָשַׁךְ בַּשְּׁנִיָּה כִשְׁתַּיִם, אֵין בְּיָדוֹ אֶלָּא אֶחָת.
phrases.en: If one sounded the first tekia of the initial series of tekia, terua, tekia, and then extended the second tekia of that series to the length of two tekiot, so that it should count as both the second tekia of the first set and the first tekia of the second set, he has in his hand the fulfillment of only one tekia, and he must begin the second set with a new tekia.

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁבֵּרַךְ וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִתְמַנָּה לוֹ שׁוֹפָר, תּוֹקֵעַ וּמֵרִיעַ וְתוֹקֵעַ שָׁלשׁ פְּעָמִים.
phrases.en: With regard to one who recited the blessings of the additional prayer, and only afterward a shofar became available to him, he sounds a tekia, sounds a terua, and sounds a tekia, an order he repeats three times.

phrases.he: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁשְּׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר חַיָּב, כָּךְ כָּל יָחִיד וְיָחִיד חַיָּב.
phrases.en: Just as the prayer leader is obligated in the prayer of Rosh HaShana, so too, each and every individual is obligated in these prayers.

phrases.he: רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר, שְׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר מוֹצִיא אֶת הָרַבִּים יְדֵי חוֹבָתָן:
phrases.en: Rabban Gamliel disagrees and says: Individuals are not obligated, as the prayer leader fulfills the obligation on behalf of the many.

phrases.he: מֵאֵימָתַי מַזְכִּירִין גְּבוּרוֹת גְּשָׁמִים.
phrases.en: From when does one begin to mention the might of the rains

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר, מִיּוֹם טוֹב הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל חָג.
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer says: The phrase is inserted from the first Festival day of the festival of Sukkot.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר, מִיּוֹם טוֹב הָאַחֲרוֹן שֶׁל חָג.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehoshua says: From the last Festival day of the festival of Sukkot.

phrases.he: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehoshua said to

phrases.he: הוֹאִיל וְאֵין הַגְּשָׁמִים אֶלָּא סִימַן קְלָלָה בֶּחָג, לָמָּה מַזְכִּיר.
phrases.en: Since rain is nothing other than a sign of a curse during the festival of Sukkot, why should one mention the might of rain during this period?

phrases.he: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר, אַף אֲנִי לֹא אָמַרְתִּי לִשְׁאוֹל, אֶלָּא לְהַזְכִּיר מַשִּׁיב הָרוּחַ וּמוֹרִיד הַגֶּשֶׁם בְּעוֹנָתוֹ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer said to him: I too did not say that it is proper to request rain at this time, but it is proper only to mention the phrase: He makes the wind blow and rain fall, in its due time.

phrases.he: אָמַר לוֹ, אִם כֵּן, לְעוֹלָם יְהֵא מַזְכִּיר:
phrases.en: said to him: If so, one should always mention rain, even in the summer.

phrases.he: אֵין שׁוֹאֲלִין אֶת הַגְּשָׁמִים אֶלָּא סָמוּךְ לַגְּשָׁמִים.
phrases.en: One requests rain only immediately preceding the rainy season.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר,
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says:

phrases.he: הָעוֹבֵר לִפְנֵי הַתֵּבָה בְּיוֹם טוֹב הָאַחֲרוֹן שֶׁל חַג,
phrases.en: the one who passes before the ark on the concluding Festival day of the festival

phrases.he: הָאַחֲרוֹן מַזְכִּיר,
phrases.en: The last mentions

phrases.he: הָרִאשׁוֹן אֵינוֹ מַזְכִּיר.
phrases.en: the first does not mention

phrases.he: בְּיוֹם טוֹב הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל פֶּסַח,
phrases.en: on the first Festival day of Passover:

phrases.he: הָרִאשׁוֹן מַזְכִּיר,
phrases.en: the first mentions

phrases.he: הָאַחֲרוֹן אֵינוֹ מַזְכִּיר.
phrases.en: the last does not mention

phrases.he: עַד אֵימָתַי שׁוֹאֲלִין אֶת הַגְּשָׁמִים,
phrases.en: Until when does one request rain?

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר,
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says:

phrases.he: עַד שֶׁיַּעֲבֹר הַפָּסַח.
phrases.en: until Passover has passed.

phrases.he: רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר,
phrases.en: Rabbi Meir says:

phrases.he: עַד שֶׁיֵּצֵא נִיסָן,
phrases.en: Until the month of Nisan has ended,

phrases.he: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (יואל ב) וַיּוֹרֶד לָכֶם גֶּשֶׁם, מוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ בָּרִאשׁוֹן:
phrases.en: as it is stated: "And He causes to come down for you the rain, the first rain and the last rain, in the first month"

phrases.he: בִּשְׁלשָׁה בְמַרְחֶשְׁוָן שׁוֹאֲלִין אֶת הַגְּשָׁמִים.
phrases.en: On the third of Marḥeshvan one starts to request rain

phrases.he: רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר,
phrases.en: Rabban Gamliel says:

phrases.he: בְּשִׁבְעָה בוֹ,
phrases.en: on the seventh of

phrases.he: חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם אַחַר הֶחָג,
phrases.en: fifteen days after the festival

phrases.he: כְּדֵי שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ אַחֲרוֹן שֶׁבְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לִנְהַר פְּרָת:
phrases.en: so that the last pilgrim of the Jewish people can reach the Euphrates River

phrases.he: הִגִּיעַ שִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּמַרְחֶשְׁוָן וְלֹא יָרְדוּ גְשָׁמִים, הִתְחִילוּ הַיְחִידִים מִתְעַנִּין שָׁלשׁ תַּעֲנִיּוֹת.
phrases.en: seventeenth of Marḥeshvan arrived and rain has not fallen, individuals, but not the entire community, begin to fast three fasts

phrases.he: אוֹכְלִין וְשׁוֹתִין מִשֶּׁחֲשֵׁכָה, וּמֻתָּרִין בִּמְלָאכָה וּבִרְחִיצָה וּבְסִיכָה וּבִנְעִילַת הַסַּנְדָּל וּבְתַשְׁמִישׁ הַמִּטָּה.
phrases.en: may eat and drink after dark, and one is permitted in the performance of work, in bathing, in smearing oil on one's body, in wearing shoes, and in conjugal relations.

phrases.he: הִגִּיעַ רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ כִּסְלֵו וְלֹא יָרְדוּ גְשָׁמִים, בֵּית דִּין גּוֹזְרִין שָׁלשׁ תַּעֲנִיוֹת עַל הַצִּבּוּר.
phrases.en: New Moon of Kislev arrived and rain has still not fallen, the court decrees three fasts on the entire community.

phrases.he: אוֹכְלִין וְשׁוֹתִין מִשֶּׁחֲשֵׁכָה, וּמֻתָּרִין בִּמְלָאכָה וּבִרְחִיצָה וּבְסִיכָה וּבִנְעִילַת הַסַּנְדָּל וּבְתַשְׁמִישׁ הַמִּטָּה:
phrases.en: may eat and drink after dark, and they are permitted to engage in the performance of work, in bathing, in smearing one's body with oil, in wearing shoes, and in conjugal relations.

phrases.he: עָבְרוּ אֵלּוּ וְלֹא נַעֲנוּ, בֵּית דִּין גּוֹזְרִין שָׁלשׁ תַּעֲנִיּוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עַל הַצִּבּוּר.
phrases.en: If these three regular fasts have passed and they have not been answered with rain, the court decrees three other fasts upon the community.

phrases.he: אוֹכְלִין וְשׁוֹתִין מִבְּעוֹד יוֹם, וַאֲסוּרִין בִּמְלָאכָה וּבִרְחִיצָה וּבְסִיכָה וּבִנְעִילַת הַסַּנְדָּל וּבְתַשְׁמִישׁ הַמִּטָּה, וְנוֹעֲלִין אֶת הַמֶּרְחֲצָאוֹת.
phrases.en: They may eat and drink while it is still day, before the beginning of the night of the fast, and on the day of the fast itself they are prohibited to engage in the performance of work, in bathing, in smearing with oil, in wearing shoes, and in marital relations; and they lock the bathhouses so that no one should come to bathe on that day.

phrases.he: עָבְרוּ אֵלּוּ וְלֹא נַעֲנוּ, בֵּית דִּין גּוֹזְרִין עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹד שֶׁבַע, שֶׁהֵן שְׁלשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה תַּעֲנִיּוֹת עַל הַצִּבּוּר.
phrases.en: If these three fasts have passed and they still have not been answered, the court decrees on them another seven fasts, which are a total of thirteen fasts, upon the community, not including the first three fasts observed by individuals.

phrases.he: הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ יְתֵרוֹת עַל הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת, שֶׁבָּאֵלּוּ מַתְרִיעִין וְנוֹעֲלִין אֶת הַחֲנוּיוֹת, בַּשֵּׁנִי מַטִּין עִם חֲשֵׁכָה, וּבַחֲמִישִׁי מֻתָּרִין מִפְּנֵי כְבוֹד הַשַּׁבָּת:
phrases.en: These seven fast days are more severe than the first ones, as on these days, in addition to all the earlier stringencies, they sound the alarm, and they lock the stores. Although shops must remained closed most of the time on these days, on Monday they open them a little at nightfall to allow people to purchase food for breaking their fast, and on Thursday they are permitted to open the stores all day in deference to Shabbat, so that people may purchase food for the sacred day.

phrases.he: עָבְרוּ אֵלּוּ וְלֹא נַעֲנוּ,
phrases.en: If these fasts have passed and they have not been answered

phrases.he: מְמַעֲטִין בְּמַשָּׂא וּמַתָּן, בְּבִנְיָן וּבִנְטִיעָה, בְּאֵרוּסִין וּבְנִשּׂוּאִין וּבִשְׁאֵלַת שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ,
phrases.en: They decrease their engagement in business transactions, in building and planting, in betrothals and marriages, and in greetings between each person and his fellow

phrases.he: כִּבְנֵי אָדָם הַנְּזוּפִין לַמָּקוֹם.
phrases.en: like people who have been rebuked by God.

phrases.he: הַיְחִידִים חוֹזְרִים וּמִתְעַנִּים עַד שֶׁיֵּצֵא נִיסָן.
phrases.en: The individuals, i.e., Torah scholars, resume fasting every Monday and Thursday until the month of Nisan ends.

phrases.he: יָצָא נִיסָן וְלֹא יָרְדוּ גְשָׁמִים, סִימַן קְלָלָה,
phrases.en: After this date they no longer pray for rain, since if Nisan has ended and rains subsequently fall, they are a sign of a curse

phrases.he: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (שמואל א יז) הֲלוֹא קְצִיר חִטִּים הַיּוֹם, וְגוֹ':
phrases.en: as it is stated: "Is not the wheat harvest today? I will call to the Lord that He may send thunder and rain, and you will know and see that your wickedness is great" (I Samuel 12:17).

phrases.he: סֵדֶר תַּעֲנִיּוֹת כֵּיצַד,
phrases.en: What is the customary order of fast days?

phrases.he: מוֹצִיאִין אֶת הַתֵּבָה לִרְחוֹבָהּ שֶׁל עִיר,
phrases.en: they remove the ark to the main city square

phrases.he: וְנוֹתְנִין אֵפֶר מִקְלֶה עַל גַּבֵּי הַתֵּבָה,
phrases.en: and place burnt ashes upon the ark,

phrases.he: וּבְרֹאשׁ הַנָּשִׂיא וּבְרֹאשׁ אַב בֵּית דִּין,
phrases.en: And on the head of the Nasi, and on the head of the deputy Nasi,

phrases.he: וְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד נוֹתֵן בְּרֹאשׁוֹ.
phrases.en: and each and every member of the community likewise places ashes upon his head.

phrases.he: הַזָּקֵן שֶׁבָּהֶן אוֹמֵר לִפְנֵיהֶם דִּבְרֵי כִבּוּשִׁין,
phrases.en: The eldest member of the community says to the congregation statements of reproof,

phrases.he: אַחֵינוּ, לֹא נֶאֱמַר בְּאַנְשֵׁי נִינְוֵה, וַיַּרְא הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת שַׂקָּם וְאֶת תַּעֲנִיתָם,
phrases.en: Our brothers, it is not stated with regard to the people of Nineveh: And God saw their sackcloth and their fasting.

phrases.he: אֶלָּא וַיַּרְא הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם, כִּי שָׁבוּ מִדַּרְכָּם הָרָעָה.
phrases.en: Rather, the verse says: "And God saw their deeds, that they had turned from their evil way".

phrases.he: וּבַקַּבָּלָה הוּא אוֹמֵר וְקִרְעוּ לְבַבְכֶם וְאַל בִּגְדֵיכֶם:
phrases.en: And in the Prophets it says: "And rend your hearts and not your garments,

phrases.he: עָמְדוּ בִתְפִלָּה,
phrases.en: They stood for prayer.

phrases.he: מוֹרִידִין לִפְנֵי הַתֵּבָה זָקֵן וְרָגִיל,
phrases.en: The congregation appoints an elder, who is experienced in leading prayer, to descend before the ark

phrases.he: וְיֶשׁ לוֹ בָנִים, וּבֵיתוֹ רֵיקָם,
phrases.en: And this prayer leader must have children and must have an empty house,

phrases.he: כְּדֵי שֶׁיְּהֵא לִבּוֹ שָׁלֵם בַּתְּפִלָּה,
phrases.en: so that his heart will be fully concentrated on the prayer

phrases.he: וְאוֹמֵר לִפְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע בְּרָכוֹת,
phrases.en: And he recites twenty-four blessings before the congregation:

phrases.he: שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם,
phrases.en: The eighteen blessings of the everyday Amida prayer,

phrases.he: וּמוֹסִיף עֲלֵיהֶן עוֹד שֵׁשׁ:
phrases.en: to which he adds another six blessings,

phrases.he: וְאֵלּוּ הֵן, זִכְרוֹנוֹת, וְשׁוֹפָרוֹת,
phrases.en: and they are as follows: The special series of blessings recited on Rosh HaShana, the Remembrances and Shofarot;

phrases.he: אֶל ה' בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי (תהילים ק״כ:א׳),
phrases.en: and the sections of Psalms that begin with the verses: "In my distress I called to the Lord and He answered me" (Psalms 120:1),

phrases.he: אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל הֶהָרִים וְגוֹ' (שם קכא),
phrases.en: "I will lift up my eyes to the mountains; from where will my help come" (Psalms 121:1),

phrases.he: מִמַּעֲמַקִּים קְרָאתִיךָ ה' (שם קל),
phrases.en: "Out of the depths I have called You, O Lord" (Psalms 130:1),

phrases.he: תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי כִי יַעֲטֹף (שם קב).
phrases.en: and "A prayer of the afflicted, when he faints" (Psalms 102:1).

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר,
phrases.en: Rabbi Yehuda says:

phrases.he: לֹא הָיָה צָרִיךְ לוֹמַר זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְשׁוֹפָרוֹת,
phrases.en: The prayer leader did not need to recite the Remembrances and Shofarot passages.

phrases.he: אֶלָּא אוֹמֵר תַּחְתֵּיהֶן,
phrases.en: Rather, he recites instead of them

phrases.he: רָעָב כִּי יִהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ (מלכים א ח׳, ל"ז),
phrases.en: the passage beginning with: "If there be famine in the land, if there be pestilence" (I Kings 8:37),

phrases.he: דֶּבֶר כִּי יִהְיֶה וְגוֹ',
אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר ה' אֶל יִרְמְיָהוּ עַל דִּבְרֵי הַבַּצָּרוֹת (ירמיה יד).
phrases.en: followed by the verse "The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the droughts" (Jeremiah 14:1).

phrases.he: וְאוֹמֵר חוֹתְמֵיהֶן:
phrases.en: And he recites at the end of all of these six blessing their unique conclusions.

phrases.he: עַל הָרִאשׁוֹנָה הוּא אוֹמֵר, מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת אַבְרָהָם בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה' גּוֹאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
phrases.en: For the first he recites: He Who answered Abraham on Mount Moriah, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day. Blessed are You, Lord, Redeemer of Israel.

phrases.he: עַל הַשְּׁנִיָּה הוּא אוֹמֵר, מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת אֲבוֹתֵינוּ עַל יַם סוּף, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע קוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה' זוֹכֵר הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת.
phrases.en: For the second he recites: He Who answered our forefathers at the Red Sea, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day. Blessed are You, Lord, Who remembers the forgotten.

phrases.he: עַל הַשְּׁלִישִׁית הוּא אוֹמֵר, מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע קוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה' שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּרוּעָה.
phrases.en: For the third he recites: He Who answered Joshua at Gilgal, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day. Blessed are You, Lord, Who hears the terua.

phrases.he: עַל הָרְבִיעִית הוּא אוֹמֵר, מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת שְׁמוּאֵל בַּמִּצְפָּה, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה' שׁוֹמֵעַ צְעָקָה.
phrases.en: For the fourth he recites: He Who answered Samuel in Mizpah, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day. Blessed are You, Lord, Who hears cries.

phrases.he: עַל הַחֲמִישִׁית הוּא אוֹמֵר, מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ בְּהַר הַכַּרְמֶל, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה' שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה.
phrases.en: For the fifth he recites: He Who answered Elijah on Mount Carmel, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day. Blessed are You, Lord, Who hears prayer.

phrases.he: עַל הַשִּׁשִּׁית הוּא אוֹמֵר, מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת יוֹנָה מִמְּעֵי הַדָּגָה, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה' הָעוֹנֶה בְּעֵת צָרָה.
phrases.en: For the sixth he recites: He Who answered Jonah from within the innards of the fish, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day. Blessed are You, Lord, Who answers in a time of trouble.

phrases.he: עַל הַשְּׁבִיעִית הוּא אוֹמֵר, מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת דָּוִד וְאֶת שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה' הַמְרַחֵם עַל הָאָרֶץ:
phrases.en: For the seventh he recites: He Who answered David and Solomon his son in Jerusalem, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day. Blessed are You, Lord, Who has mercy on the Land.

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה בִימֵי רַבִּי חֲלַפְתָּא וְרַבִּי חֲנַנְיָה בֶן תְּרַדְיוֹן, שֶׁעָבַר אֶחָד לִפְנֵי הַתֵּבָה וְגָמַר אֶת הַבְּרָכָה כֻלָּהּ, וְלֹא עָנוּ אַחֲרָיו אָמֵן.
phrases.en: An incident occurred in the days of Rabbi Ḥalafta and Rabbi Ḥananya ben Teradyon, that someone passed before the ark as prayer leader and finished the entire blessing of the fast day, but the congregation did not answer amen after him.

phrases.he: תִּקְעוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים תְּקָעוּ.
phrases.en: Sound the priests, blow the shofar.

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה.
phrases.en: He Who answered Abraham on Mount Moriah, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day.

phrases.he: הָרִיעוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הָרִיעוּ.
phrases.en: Blast the sons of Aaron, blast.

phrases.he: מִי שֶׁעָנָה אֶת אֲבוֹתֵינוּ עַל יַם סוּף, הוּא יַעֲנֶה אֶתְכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל צַעֲקַתְכֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה.
phrases.en: He Who answered our forefathers by the Red Sea, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry on this day,

phrases.he: וּכְשֶׁבָּא דָבָר אֵצֶל חֲכָמִים, אָמְרוּ, לֹא הָיִינוּ נוֹהֲגִין כֵּן אֶלָּא בְשַׁעַר מִזְרָח וּבְהַר הַבָּיִת:
phrases.en: And when this matter came before the Sages, they said: They would act in accordance with this custom only at the Eastern Gate of the Temple and on the Temple Mount.

phrases.he: שָׁלשׁ תַּעֲנִיּוֹת הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת, אַנְשֵׁי מִשְׁמָר מִתְעַנִּין וְלֹא מַשְׁלִימִין,
phrases.en: On the first three fasts, the members of the priestly watch fast but do not complete

phrases.he: וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית אָב לֹא הָיוּ מִתְעַנִּין כְּלָל.
phrases.en: And the members of the patrilineal family did not fast at all.

phrases.he: שָׁלשׁ שְׁנִיּוֹת, אַנְשֵׁי מִשְׁמָר מִתְעַנִּין וּמַשְׁלִימִין,
phrases.en: On the second three fast days, the members of the priestly watch fast and complete

phrases.he: וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית אָב מִתְעַנִּין וְלֹא מַשְׁלִימִין.
phrases.en: and the members of the patrilineal family fast but do not complete their fasts.

phrases.he: שֶׁבַע אַחֲרוֹנוֹת, אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ מִתְעַנִּין וּמַשְׁלִימִין,
phrases.en: On the final seven fasts, both groups fast and complete the fasts.

phrases.he: דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ.
phrases.en: This is the statement of Rabbi Yehoshua.

phrases.he: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים,
phrases.en: And the Rabbis say:

phrases.he: שָׁלשׁ תַּעֲנִיּוֹת הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת, אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ לֹא הָיוּ מִתְעַנִּין כְּלָל.
phrases.en: On the first three fasts, the members of both groups do not fast at all.

phrases.he: שָׁלשׁ שְׁנִיּוֹת, אַנְשֵׁי מִשְׁמָר מִתְעַנִּין וְלֹא מַשְׁלִימִין,
phrases.en: On the second three fast days, the members of the priestly watch fast and do not complete their fast,

phrases.he: וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית אָב לֹא הָיוּ מִתְעַנִּין כְּלָל.
phrases.en: and the members of the patrilineal family do not fast at all.

phrases.he: שֶׁבַע אַחֲרוֹנוֹת, אַנְשֵׁי מִשְׁמָר מִתְעַנִּין וּמַשְׁלִימִין,
phrases.en: On the final seven, the members of the priestly watch fast and complete the fast,

phrases.he: וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית אָב מִתְעַנִּין וְלֹא מַשְׁלִימִין:
phrases.en: and the members of the patrilineal family fast but do not complete their fast.

phrases.he: אַנְשֵׁי מִשְׁמָר מֻתָּרִים לִשְׁתּוֹת יַיִן בַּלֵּילוֹת, אֲבָל לֹא בַיָּמִים.
phrases.en: The members of the priestly watch were permitted to drink wine during the nights, but not during the days,

phrases.he: וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית אָב, לֹא בַיּוֹם וְלֹא בַלָּיְלָה.
phrases.en: And the members of the patrilineal family, neither at night nor during the day,

phrases.he: אַנְשֵׁי מִשְׁמָר וְאַנְשֵׁי מַעֲמָד אֲסוּרִין מִלְּסַפֵּר וּמִלְּכַבֵּס,
phrases.en: It is prohibited for both the members of the priestly watch and the members of the non-priestly watch to cut their hair or launder their garments throughout the week,

phrases.he: וּבַחֲמִישִׁי מֻתָּרִין מִפְּנֵי כְבוֹד הַשַּׁבָּת:
phrases.en: but on Thursday it is permitted for them to cut their hair and launder their clothes in deference to Shabbat.

phrases.he: כֹּל הַכָּתוּב בִּמְגִלַּת תַּעֲנִית דְּלֹא לְמִסְפַּד, לְפָנָיו אָסוּר, לְאַחֲרָיו מֻתָּר.
phrases.en: Any day concerning which it is written in Megillat Ta'anit not to eulogize on that day, it is also prohibited to eulogize on the day before, but it is permitted to do so on the following day.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, לְפָנָיו וּלְאַחֲרָיו אָסוּר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: It is prohibited to eulogize both on the day before and on the following day.

phrases.he: דְּלֹא לְהִתְעַנָּאָה בְהוֹן, לְפָנָיו וּלְאַחֲרָיו מֻתָּר.
phrases.en: With regard to those days concerning which it is written only not to fast, it is permitted to fast on the day before and on the following day.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, לְפָנָיו אָסוּר, לְאַחֲרָיו מֻתָּר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: Fasting the day before is prohibited, but on the following day it is permitted to fast.

phrases.he: אֵין גּוֹזְרִין תַּעֲנִית עַל הַצִּבּוּר בַּתְּחִלָּה בַּחֲמִישִׁי, שֶׁלֹּא לְהַפְקִיעַ הַשְּׁעָרִים.
phrases.en: One may not decree a fast on the community starting on a Thursday, so as not to cause an increase in prices.

phrases.he: אֶלָּא שָׁלשׁ תַּעֲנִיּוֹת הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת שֵׁנִי וַחֲמִישִׁי וְשֵׁנִי.
phrases.en: Rather, the first set of three fasts is on a Monday, Thursday, and the following Monday,

phrases.he: וְשָׁלשׁ שְׁנִיּוֹת חֲמִישִׁי שֵׁנִי וַחֲמִישִׁי.
phrases.en: and the second set of three is on a Thursday, Monday, and the following Thursday.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאֵין הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת בַּחֲמִישִׁי, כָּךְ לֹא שְׁנִיּוֹת וְלֹא אַחֲרוֹנוֹת.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: Just as the first three fasts do not begin on Thursday, so too, neither the second set nor the last set starts on a Thursday.

phrases.he: אֵין גּוֹזְרִין תַּעֲנִית עַל הַצִּבּוּר בְּרֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ, בַּחֲנֻכָּה וּבְפוּרִים, וְאִם הִתְחִילוּ, אֵין מַפְסִיקִין, דִּבְרֵי רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל.
phrases.en: One may not decree a fast on the community on New Moons, on Hanukkah, or on Purim. And if they decreed and began a set of fasts, and only afterward realized that one of the fasts would occur on one of these days, they do not interrupt the sequence. This is the statement of Rabban Gamliel.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי מֵאִיר, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמַר רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אֵין מַפְסִיקִין, מוֹדֶה הָיָה שֶׁאֵין מַשְׁלִימִין.
phrases.en: Rabbi Meir said: Although Rabban Gamliel said that they do not interrupt the sequence, he concedes that on these days, which are days with special observances, they do not complete the fast.

phrases.he: וְכֵן תִּשְׁעָה בְאָב שֶׁחָל לִהְיוֹת בְּעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת:
phrases.en: And similarly, when the Ninth of Av occurs on Shabbat eve, the fast is not completed and one eats before the start of Shabbat, so as not to enter Shabbat while fasting.

phrases.he: סֵדֶר תַּעֲנִיּוֹת אֵלוּ הָאָמוּר, בִּרְבִיעָה רִאשׁוֹנָה.
phrases.en: The order of these fasts is stated in the first rainfall.

phrases.he: אֲבָל צְמָחִים שֶׁשָּׁנוּ, מַתְרִיעִין עֲלֵיהֶם מִיָּד.
phrases.en: However, if there is vegetation that changed due to disease, they cry out about it immediately.

phrases.he: וְכֵן שֶׁפָּסְקוּ גְשָׁמִים בֵּין גֶּשֶׁם לְגֶשֶׁם אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם, מַתְרִיעִין עֲלֵיהֶם מִיָּד, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהִיא מַכַּת בַּצֹּרֶת.
phrases.en: And likewise, if rain ceased for forty days between one rainfall and another, they cry out about it because it is a plague of drought.

phrases.he: יָרְדוּ לַצְּמָחִין אֲבָל לֹא יָרְדוּ לָאִילָן,
phrases.en: fell for the vegetation but not enough fell for the trees;

phrases.he: לָאִילָן וְלֹא לַצְּמָחִים,
phrases.en: for the trees but not for the vegetation;

phrases.he: לָזֶה וְלָזֶה אֲבָל לֹא לַבּוֹרוֹת לַשִּׁיחִין וְלַמְּעָרוֹת,
phrases.en: for both this and that, but not to fill the cisterns, ditches, and caves with water to last the summer,

phrases.he: מַתְרִיעִין עֲלֵיהֶן מִיָּד:
phrases.en: they cry out about it immediately.

phrases.he: וְכֵן עִיר שֶׁלֹּא יָרְדוּ עָלֶיהָ גְשָׁמִים,
phrases.en: And likewise, if there is a particular city upon which it did not rain,

phrases.he: דִּכְתִיב (עמוס ד) וְהִמְטַרְתִּי עַל עִיר אֶחָת וְעַל עִיר אַחַת לֹא אַמְטִיר, חֶלְקָה אַחַת תִּמָּטֵר וְגוֹ',
phrases.en: as it is written: "And I caused it to rain upon one city, but caused it not to rain upon another city; one piece was rained upon,

phrases.he: אוֹתָהּ הָעִיר מִתְעַנָּה וּמַתְרַעַת,
phrases.en: that city fasts and cries out

phrases.he: וְכָל סְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ, מִתְעַנּוֹת וְלֹא מַתְרִיעוֹת.
phrases.en: and all of its surrounding areas join them in their fast, but they do not cry out.

phrases.he: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר, מַתְרִיעוֹת וְלֹא מִתְעַנּוֹת:
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva says: They cry out but they do not fast.

phrases.he: וְכֵן עִיר שֶׁיֶּשׁ בָּהּ דֶּבֶר אוֹ מַפֹּלֶת, אוֹתָהּ הָעִיר מִתְעַנָּה וּמַתְרַעַת, וְכָל סְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ מִתְעַנּוֹת וְלֹא מַתְרִיעוֹת.
phrases.en: And likewise, if a city is afflicted by pestilence or collapsing buildings, that city fasts and cries out, and all of its surrounding areas fast but they do not cry out.

phrases.he: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר, מַתְרִיעוֹת וְלֹא מִתְעַנּוֹת.
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva says: They cry out but they do not fast.

phrases.he: אֵיזֶהוּ דֶבֶר, עִיר הַמּוֹצִיאָה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת רַגְלִי, וְיָצְאוּ מִמֶּנָּה שְׁלשָׁה מֵתִים בִּשְׁלשָׁה יָמִים זֶה אַחַר זֶה, הֲרֵי זֶה דֶבֶר.
phrases.en: What is considered a plague of pestilence? If a city that sends out five hundred infantrymen, and three dead are taken out of it on three consecutive days, this is a plague of pestilence.

phrases.he: פָּחוֹת מִכָּאן, אֵין זֶה דֶבֶר:
phrases.en: If the death rate is lower than that, this is not pestilence.

phrases.he: עַל אֵלּוּ מַתְרִיעִין בְּכָל מָקוֹם,
phrases.en: For the following they cry out in every place:

phrases.he: עַל הַשִּׁדָּפוֹן וְעַל הַיֵּרָקוֹן, עַל הָאַרְבֶּה וְעַל הֶחָסִיל,
phrases.en: For blight; for mildew; for locusts; for caterpillars,

phrases.he: וְעַל הַחַיָּה רָעָה וְעַל הַחֶרֶב,
phrases.en: for dangerous beasts and for the sword,

phrases.he: מַתְרִיעִין עָלֶיהָ,
phrases.en: they cry out about these

phrases.he: מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהִיא מַכָּה מְהַלֶּכֶת:
phrases.en: because these are calamities that spread.

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁיָּרְדוּ זְקֵנִים מִירוּשָׁלַיִם לְעָרֵיהֶם, וְגָזְרוּ תַעֲנִית עַל שֶׁנִּרְאָה כִמְלֹא פִי תַנּוּר שִׁדָּפוֹן בְּאַשְׁקְלוֹן.
phrases.en: An incident occurred in which Elders descended from Jerusalem to their cities and decreed a fast because there was seen in the city of Ashkelon a small amount of blight, enough to fill the mouth of an oven.

phrases.he: וְעוֹד גָּזְרוּ תַעֲנִית עַל שֶׁאָכְלוּ זְאֵבִים שְׁנֵי תִינוֹקוֹת בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן.
phrases.en: And furthermore, they decreed a fast because wolves had eaten two children in Transjordan.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, לֹא עַל שֶׁאָכְלוּ, אֶלָּא עַל שֶׁנִּרְאָה:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei says: not because they ate, but because they were seen:

phrases.he: עַל אֵלּוּ מַתְרִיעִין בְּשַׁבָּת, עַל עִיר שֶׁהִקִּיפוּהָ גוֹיִם אוֹ נָהָר, וְעַל הַסְּפִינָה הַמִּטָּרֶפֶת בַּיָּם.
phrases.en: For the following calamities they cry out even on Shabbat: For a city that is surrounded by gentile troops, or for a place in danger of being flooded by a river that has swelled its banks, or for a ship tossed about at sea.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, לְעֶזְרָה וְלֹא לִצְעָקָה.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yosei said: One may cry out on Shabbat to summon help, but it may not be sounded for crying out to God.

phrases.he: שִׁמְעוֹן הַתִּמְנִי אוֹמֵר, אַף עַל הַדֶּבֶר, וְלֹא הוֹדוּ לוֹ חֲכָמִים.
phrases.en: Shimon the Timnite says: One may cry out on Shabbat even for pestilence, but the Rabbis did not agree with him.

phrases.he: עַל כָּל צָרָה שֶׁלֹּא תָבֹא עַל הַצִּבּוּר, מַתְרִיעִין עֲלֵיהֶן, חוּץ מֵרוֹב גְּשָׁמִים.
phrases.en: on account of any trouble that should not befall the community, except for an overabundance of rain.

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁאָמְרוּ לוֹ לְחוֹנִי הַמְעַגֵּל, הִתְפַּלֵּל שֶׁיֵּרְדוּ גְשָׁמִים.
phrases.en: An incident occurred in which the people said to Ḥoni HaMe'aggel: Pray that rain should fall.

phrases.he: אָמַר לָהֶם, צְאוּ וְהַכְנִיסוּ תַנּוּרֵי פְסָחִים, בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁלֹּא יִמּוֹקוּ.
phrases.en: He said to them: Go out and bring in the clay ovens used to roast the Paschal lambs, so that they will not dissolve in the water.

phrases.he: הִתְפַּלֵּל, וְלֹא יָרְדוּ גְשָׁמִים.
phrases.en: He prayed, and no rain fell.

phrases.he: מֶה עָשָׂה, עָג עוּגָה וְעָמַד בְּתוֹכָהּ, וְאָמַר לְפָנָיו, רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, בָּנֶיךָ שָׂמוּ פְנֵיהֶם עָלַי, שֶׁאֲנִי כְבֶן בַּיִת לְפָנֶיךָ.
phrases.en: What did he do? He drew a circle on the ground and stood inside it and said before God: Master of the Universe, Your children have turned their faces toward me, as I am like a member of Your household.

phrases.he: נִשְׁבָּע אֲנִי בְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל שֶׁאֵינִי זָז מִכָּאן, עַד שֶׁתְּרַחֵם עַל בָּנֶיךָ.
phrases.en: I take an oath by Your great name that I will not move from here until You have mercy upon Your children.

phrases.he: הִתְחִילוּ גְּשָׁמִים מְנַטְּפִין.
phrases.en: Rain began to trickle down.

phrases.he: אָמַר, לֹא כָךְ שָׁאַלְתִּי, אֶלָּא גִּשְׁמֵי בוֹרוֹת שִׁיחִין וּמְעָרוֹת.
phrases.en: He said: I did not ask for this, but for rain to fill the cisterns, ditches, and caves.

phrases.he: הִתְחִילוּ לֵירֵד בְּזָעַף.
phrases.en: Rain began to fall furiously.

phrases.he: אָמַר, לֹא כָךְ שָׁאַלְתִּי, אֶלָּא גִּשְׁמֵי רָצוֹן, בְּרָכָה וּנְדָבָה.
phrases.en: He said: I did not ask for this but for rain of benevolence, blessing, and generosity.

phrases.he: יָרְדוּ כְתִקְנָן, עַד שֶׁיָּצְאוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִירוּשָׁלַיִם לְהַר הַבַּיִת מִפְּנֵי הַגְּשָׁמִים.
phrases.en: The rains fell in their standard manner until all of the Jews exited Jerusalem and went to the Temple Mount due to the rain.

phrases.he: בָּאוּ וְאָמְרוּ לוֹ, כְּשֵׁם שֶׁהִתְפַּלַלְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶם שֶׁיֵּרְדוּ כָּךְ הִתְפַּלֵּל שֶׁיֵּלְכוּ לָהֶן.
phrases.en: They came and said to him: Just as you prayed over the rains that they should fall, so too, pray that they should stop.

phrases.he: אָמַר לָהֶן, צְאוּ וּרְאוּ אִם נִמְחֵת אֶבֶן הַטּוֹעִים.
phrases.en: He said to them: Go out and see if the Claimants' Stone has been washed away.

phrases.he: שָׁלַח לוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן שָׁטָח, אִלְמָלֵא חוֹנִי אַתָּה, גּוֹזְרַנִי עָלֶיךָ נִדּוּי.
phrases.en: Shimon ben Shetaḥ relayed to Ḥoni HaMe'aggel: Were you not Ḥoni, I would have decreed that you be ostracized.

phrases.he: אֲבָל מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לְּךָ, שֶׁאַתָּה מִתְחַטֵּא לִפְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם וְעוֹשֶׂה לְךָ רְצוֹנְךָ כְּבֵן שֶׁהוּא מִתְחַטֵּא עַל אָבִיו וְעוֹשֶׂה לוֹ רְצוֹנוֹ.
phrases.en: but what can I do to you? You nag God and He does your bidding, like a son who nags his father and his father does his bidding.

phrases.he: וְעָלֶיךָ הַכָּתוּב אוֹמֵר (משלי כג), יִשְׂמַח אָבִיךָ וְאִמֶּךָ וְתָגֵל יוֹלַדְתֶּךָ:
phrases.en: About you, the verse states: "Let your father and your mother be glad, and let her who bore you rejoice"

phrases.he: הָיוּ מִתְעַנִּין וְיָרְדוּ לָהֶם גְּשָׁמִים קֹדֶם הָנֵץ הַחַמָּה, לֹא יַשְׁלִימוּ.
phrases.en: they were fasting and rain fell for them before sunrise, they need not complete

phrases.he: לְאַחַר הָנֵץ הַחַמָּה, יַשְׁלִימוּ.
phrases.en: after sunrise, they must complete

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר, קֹדֶם חֲצוֹת לֹא יַשְׁלִימוּ, לְאַחַר חֲצוֹת יַשְׁלִימוּ.
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer says: If rain fell before midday, they need not complete their fast; but if it rains after midday, they must complete

phrases.he: מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁגָּזְרוּ תַעֲנִית בְּלוֹד, וְיָרְדוּ לָהֶם גְּשָׁמִים קֹדֶם חֲצוֹת.
phrases.en: An incident occurred in which the court decreed a fast in Lod due to a lack of rain, and rain fell for them before midday.

phrases.he: אָמַר לָהֶם רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן, צְאוּ וְאִכְלוּ וּשְׁתוּ וַעֲשׂוּ יוֹם טוֹב.
phrases.en: Rabbi Tarfon said to the people: Go out, and eat, and drink, and treat this day as a Festival.

phrases.he: וְיָצְאוּ וְאָכְלוּ וְשָׁתוּ וְעָשׂוּ יוֹם טוֹב, וּבָאוּ בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם וְקָרְאוּ הַלֵּל הַגָּדוֹל.
phrases.en: And they went out, and ate, and drank, and treated the day as a Festival, and in the afternoon they came to the synagogue and recited the great hallel

phrases.he: בִּשְׁלשָׁה פְרָקִים בַּשָּׁנָה כֹּהֲנִים נוֹשְׂאִין אֶת כַּפֵּיהֶן
phrases.en: At three times in the year priests raise their hands

phrases.he: אַרְבַּע פְּעָמִים בַּיּוֹם
phrases.en: four times in a single day

phrases.he: בַּשַּׁחֲרִית
phrases.en: in the morning prayer

phrases.he: בַּמּוּסָף
phrases.en: in the additional prayer

phrases.he: וּבַמִּנְחָה
phrases.en: in the afternoon prayer

phrases.he: וּבִנְעִילַת שְׁעָרִים
phrases.en: and in the closing of the gates

phrases.he: בַּתַּעֲנִיּוֹת
phrases.en: During communal fasts

phrases.he: וּבַמַּעֲמָדוֹת
phrases.en: and during non-priestly watches [ma'amadot]

phrases.he: וּבְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים
phrases.en: and on Yom Kippur

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ הֵן מַעֲמָדוֹת,
phrases.en: These are the non-priestly watches:

phrases.he: לְפִי שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (במדבר כח), צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֶת קָרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי,
phrases.en: Since it is stated: "Command the children of Israel and say to them: My offering of food,"

phrases.he: וְכִי הֵיאַךְ קָרְבָּנוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם קָרֵב, וְהוּא אֵינוֹ עוֹמֵד עַל גַּבָּיו,
phrases.en: But how can a person's offering be sacrificed when he is not standing next to it?

phrases.he: הִתְקִינוּ נְבִיאִים הָרִאשׁוֹנִים עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע מִשְׁמָרוֹת.
phrases.en: the early prophets instituted the division of the priests into twenty-four priestly watches,

phrases.he: עַל כָּל מִשְׁמָר וּמִשְׁמָר הָיָה מַעֲמָד בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם שֶׁל כֹּהֲנִים, שֶׁל לְוִיִּם, וְשֶׁל יִשְׂרְאֵלִים.
phrases.en: For each and every priestly watch there was a corresponding non-priestly watch in Jerusalem of priests, Levites, and Israelites

phrases.he: הִגִּיעַ זְמַן הַמִּשְׁמָר לַעֲלוֹת, כֹּהֲנִים וּלְוִיִּם עוֹלִים לִירוּשָׁלַיִם,
phrases.en: When the time arrived for the members of a certain priestly watch to ascend, the priests and Levites of that watch would ascend to Jerusalem

phrases.he: וְיִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבְּאוֹתוֹ מִשְׁמָר מִתְכַּנְּסִין לְעָרֵיהֶן וְקוֹרְאִין בְּמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:
phrases.en: And as for the Israelites assigned to that priestly watch, some of them went up to Jerusalem, while the rest of them assembled in their towns and read the act of Creation.

phrases.he: וְאַנְשֵׁי הַמַּעֲמָד הָיוּ מִתְעַנִּין אַרְבָּעָה יָמִים בַּשָּׁבוּעַ, מִיּוֹם שֵׁנִי וְעַד יוֹם חֲמִישִׁי.
phrases.en: would fast four days a week, from Monday until Thursday.

phrases.he: וְלֹא הָיוּ מִתְעַנִּין עֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, מִפְּנֵי כְבוֹד הַשַּׁבָּת.
phrases.en: And they would not fast on Shabbat eve, in deference to Shabbat,

phrases.he: וְלֹא בְאֶחָד בַּשַּׁבָּת, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יֵצְאוּ מִמְּנוּחָה וָעֹנֶג לִיגִיעָה וְתַעֲנִית וְיָמוּתוּ.
phrases.en: And they did not fast on Sunday, so as not to go from rest and delight to exertion and fasting, and run the risk that they might die as a result of the abrupt change.

phrases.he: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן, בְּרֵאשִׁית, וִיְהִי רָקִיעַ.
phrases.en: On Sunday they would read the portions starting with: "In the beginning" and "Let there be a firmament"

phrases.he: בַּשֵּׁנִי, יְהִי רָקִיעַ, וְיִקָּווּ הַמַּיִם.
phrases.en: On Monday they would read: "Let there be a firmament" and "Let the waters be gathered"

phrases.he: בַּשְּׁלִישִׁי, יִקָּווּ הַמַּיִם, וִיְהִי מְאֹרֹת.
phrases.en: On Tuesday they would read: "Let the waters be gathered" and "Let there be lights"

phrases.he: בָּרְבִיעִי, יְהִי מְאֹרֹת, וְיִשְׁרְצוּ הַמַּיִם.
phrases.en: On Wednesday: "Let there be lights" and "Let the waters swarm"

phrases.he: בַּחֲמִישִׁי, יִשְׁרְצוּ הַמַּיִם, וְתּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ.
phrases.en: On Thursday: "Let the waters swarm" and "Let the earth bring forth"

phrases.he: בַּשִּׁשִּׁי, תּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ, וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם.
phrases.en: On Friday: "Let the earth bring forth" and "And the heaven and the earth were finished"

phrases.he: פָּרָשָׁה גְדוֹלָה, קוֹרִין אוֹתָהּ בִּשְׁנַיִם, וְהַקְּטַנָּה בְּיָחִיד.
phrases.en: A long passage, consisting of six verses or more, is read by two people, and a short passage is read by one,

phrases.he: בַּשַּׁחֲרִית וּבַמּוּסָף.
phrases.en: in the morning prayer and in the additional prayer.

phrases.he: וּבַמִּנְחָה נִכְנָסִין וְקוֹרִין עַל פִּיהֶן, כְּקוֹרִין אֶת שְׁמַע.
phrases.en: In the afternoon prayer the members of the non-priestly watch enter the synagogue and read the daily portion by heart, just as one recites Shema every day.

phrases.he: עֶרֶב שַׁבָּת בַּמִּנְחָה לֹא הָיוּ נִכְנָסִין, מִפְּנֵי כְבוֹד הַשַּׁבָּת:
phrases.en: On Shabbat eve at the afternoon prayer, they would not enter the synagogue for the communal Torah readings, in deference to Shabbat.

phrases.he: כָּל יוֹם שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ הַלֵּל, אֵין בּוֹ מַעֲמָד בַּשַּׁחֲרִית.
phrases.en: On any day that has the recitation of hallel, there is no reading of the Torah by the non-priestly watch in the morning prayer.

phrases.he: קָרְבַּן מוּסָף, אֵין בּוֹ בַנְּעִילָה.
phrases.en: On days that have both hallel and an additional offering, such as Festivals, the non-priestly watch would also not read from the Torah at the closing prayer.

phrases.he: קָרְבַּן עֵצִים, אֵין בּוֹ בַמִּנְחָה, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא.
phrases.en: When a wood offering was brought, there was no non-priestly watch in the afternoon prayer. This is the statement of Rabbi Akiva.

phrases.he: אָמַר לוֹ בֶן עַזַּאי, כָּךְ הָיָה רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שׁוֹנֶה, קָרְבַּן מוּסָף, אֵין בּוֹ בַמִּנְחָה.
phrases.en: Ben Azzai said to Rabbi Akiva that this is how Rabbi Yehoshua would teach this halakha: On days when an additional offering was sacrificed, there was no non-priestly watch in the afternoon prayer.

phrases.he: קָרְבַּן עֵצִים, אֵין בּוֹ בַנְּעִילָה.
phrases.en: When a wood offering was brought, there was no non-priestly watch in the closing prayer.

phrases.he: חָזַר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא לִהְיוֹת שׁוֹנֶה כְבֶן עַזַּאי:
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva retracted his ruling and began to teach in accordance with the opinion of ben Azzai.

phrases.he: זְמַן עֲצֵי כֹהֲנִים וְהָעָם, תִּשְׁעָה.
phrases.en: times for the wood offering of priests and the people. These were nine such days and families

phrases.he: בְּאֶחָד בְּנִיסָן, בְּנֵי אָרַח בֶּן יְהוּדָה.
phrases.en: On the first of Nisan, the descendants of Araḥ ben Yehuda

phrases.he: בְּעֶשְׂרִים בְּתַמּוּז, בְּנֵי דָוִד בֶּן יְהוּדָה.
phrases.en: on the twentieth of Tammuz, the descendants of David ben Yehuda

phrases.he: בַּחֲמִשָּׁה בְאָב, בְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ בֶּן יְהוּדָה.
phrases.en: on the fifth of Av, the descendants of Parosh ben Yehuda

phrases.he: בְּשִׁבְעָה בוֹ, בְּנֵי יוֹנָדָב בֶּן רֵכָב.
phrases.en: on the seventh of Av, the descendants of Jonadab ben Rechab

phrases.he: בַּעֲשָׂרָה בוֹ, בְּנֵי סְנָאָה בֶן בִּנְיָמִין.
phrases.en: on the tenth of Av, the descendants of Sena'a ben Binyamin

phrases.he: בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בּוֹ, בְּנֵי זַתּוּא בֶן יְהוּדָה, וְעִמָּהֶם כֹּהֲנִים וּלְוִיִּם וְכָל מִי שֶׁטָּעָה בְשִׁבְטוֹ, וּבְנֵי גוֹנְבֵי עֱלִי בְּנֵי קוֹצְעֵי קְצִיעוֹת.
phrases.en: on the fifteenth of Av, the descendants of Zattu ben Yehuda. And included with this group of Zattu ben Yehuda's descendants were other priests; and Levites; and anyone who erred with regard to his tribe, and the descendants of those who deceived the authorities with a pestle; and the descendants of those who packed dried figs.

phrases.he: בְּעֶשְׂרִים בּוֹ, בְּנֵי פַחַת מוֹאָב בֶּן יְהוּדָה.
phrases.en: On the twentieth of Av, the descendants of Paḥat Moav ben Yehuda

phrases.he: בְּעֶשְׂרִים בֶּאֱלוּל, בְּנֵי עָדִין בֶּן יְהוּדָה.
phrases.en: on the twentieth of Elul, the descendants of Adin ben Yehuda

phrases.he: בְּאֶחָד בְּטֵבֵת שָׁבוּ בְנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ שְׁנִיָּה.
phrases.en: on the first of Tevet, the descendants of Parosh returned to bring wood for a second time

phrases.he: בְּאֶחָד בְּטֵבֵת לֹא הָיָה בוֹ מַעֲמָד, שֶׁהָיָה בוֹ הַלֵּל וְקָרְבַּן מוּסָף וְקָרְבַּן עֵצִים:
phrases.en: on the first of Tevet, there was no non-priestly watch, as on which hallel is recited, and it is the New Moon, on which an additional offering is sacrificed, and there was also a wood offering.

phrases.he: חֲמִשָּׁה דְבָרִים אֵרְעוּ אֶת אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְּתִשְׁעָה בְאָב.
phrases.en: Five calamitous matters occurred to our forefathers on the seventeenth of Tammuz, and five other disasters happened on the Ninth of Av.

phrases.he: בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז נִשְׁתַּבְּרוּ הַלּוּחוֹת, וּבָטַל הַתָּמִיד, וְהֻבְקְעָה הָעִיר, וְשָׂרַף אַפּוֹסְטֹמוֹס אֶת הַתּוֹרָה, וְהֶעֱמִיד צֶלֶם בַּהֵיכָל.
