phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon says: it does not protect unless it put up in the usual manner of erecting tents.

phrases.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר, אֵינוֹ מַצִּיל, עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא נָטוּי כִּנְטִיַּת הָאֹהֶל:
הַמֵּת בַּבַּיִת וּבוֹ פְתָחִין הַרְבֵּה, כֻּלָּן טְמֵאִין.
phrases.en: If a corpse is in a house in which there are many doors, they all become unclean.

phrases.he: נִפְתַּח אַחַד מֵהֶן, הוּא טָמֵא וְכֻלָּן טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: If one of them was opened, that one becomes unclean but all the rest remain clean.

phrases.he: חָשַׁב לְהוֹצִיאוֹ בְאַחַד מֵהֶן, אוֹ בְחַלּוֹן שֶׁהוּא אַרְבָּעָה עַל אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים, הִצִּיל עַל כָּל הַפְּתָחִים.
phrases.en: If he intended to carry out the corpse through one of them or through a window of four hand breadths square, he protects all the other doors.

phrases.he: בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, יַחְשֹׁב עַד שֶׁלֹּא יָמוּת הַמֵּת.
phrases.en: Bet Shammai says: the intention must have been formed before the person died.

phrases.he: בֵּית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, אַף מִשֶּׁמֵּת.
phrases.en: Bet Hillel say: even after he died.

phrases.he: הָיָה סָתוּם וְנִמְלַךְ לְפָתְחוֹ,
phrases.en: If [a door] was blocked up and it was decided to open it: Bet Shammai says: [it is effective] as soon he opens a [a space] four handbreadths square.

phrases.he: בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, כְּשֶׁיִּפְתַּח אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים.
phrases.en: Bet Hillel says: as soon as [the process] has begun.

phrases.he: וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, כְּשֶׁיַּתְחִיל.
phrases.en: They agree, however, that when making an opening for the first time, four handbreadths must be opened up.

phrases.he: וּמוֹדִים בְּפוֹתֵחַ בַּתְּחִלָּה, שֶׁיִּפְתַּח אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים
הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁהִיא מַקְשָׁה לֵילֵד וְהוֹצִיאוּהָ מִבַּיִת לְבַיִת, הָרִאשׁוֹן טָמֵא בְסָפֵק, וְהַשֵּׁנִי בְּוַדָּאי.
phrases.en: If a woman was having great difficulty giving birth and they carried her out from one house to another, the first house is doubtfully unclean and the second is certainly unclean.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, אֵימָתַי, בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא נִטֶּלֶת בַּגַּפַּיִם.
phrases.en: Rabbi Judah said: When is this so? When she is carried out [supported] by the armpits, but if she was able to walk, the first house remains clean, for after the "tomb" has been opened there is no possibility of walking, For stillborn children are not [deemed to have] opened the "tomb" until they present a head rounded like a spindle-knob.

phrases.he: אֲבָל אִם הָיְתָה מְהַלֶּכֶת, הָרִאשׁוֹן טָהוֹר, שֶׁמִּשֶּׁנִּפְתַּח הַקֶּבֶר אֵין פְּנַאי לְהַלֵּךְ.
אֵין לַנְּפָלִים פְּתִיחַת הַקֶּבֶר, עַד שֶׁיַּעְגִּילוּ רֹאשׁ כְּפִיקָה
יָצָא הָרִאשׁוֹן מֵת וְהַשֵּׁנִי חַי, טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If [at the birth of twins] the first came out dead and the second came out alive, the [live one] is clean.

phrases.he: הָרִאשׁוֹן חַי וְהַשֵּׁנִי מֵת, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If the first was alive and the second dead, the [live child] is unclean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר, בְּשָׁפִיר אֶחָד, טָמֵא. בִּשְׁנֵי שְׁפִירִים, טָהוֹר:
phrases.en: Rabbi Meir says: if they were in one sac, [the live child] is unclean, but if there were two sacs, it remains clean.

phrases.he: הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁהִיא מַקְשָׁה לֵילֵד, מְחַתְּכִין אֶת הַוָּלָד בְּמֵעֶיהָ וּמוֹצִיאִין אוֹתוֹ אֵבָרִים אֵבָרִים, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁחַיֶּיהָ קוֹדְמִין לְחַיָּיו.
phrases.en: If a woman is having trouble giving birth, they cut up the child in her womb and brings it forth limb by limb, because her life comes before the life of [the child].

phrases.he: יָצָא רֻבּוֹ, אֵין נוֹגְעִין בּוֹ, שֶׁאֵין דּוֹחִין נֶפֶשׁ מִפְּנֵי נָפֶשׁ
phrases.en: But if the greater part has come out, one may not touch it, for one may not set aside one person's life for that of another.

phrases.he: יֵשׁ מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה וְחוֹצְצִין, מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה וְלֹא חוֹצְצִין, חוֹצְצִין וְלֹא מְבִיאִין, לֹא מְבִיאִין וְלֹא חוֹצְצִין.
phrases.en: Some things bring forth uncleanness and [also] a protect [against it]; [Some things] bring forth uncleanness but do not protect against it; [Some things] protect but do not bring forth; [Some things] do not bring forth nor do they protect.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ מְבִיאִין וְחוֹצְצִין, הַשִּׁדָּה וְהַתֵּבָה וְהַמִּגְדָּל, כַּוֶּרֶת הַקַּשׁ, כַּוֶּרֶת הַקָּנִים, וּבוֹר סְפִינָה אֲלֶכְּסַנְדְּרִית, שֶׁיֶּשׁ לָהֶן שׁוּלַיִם וְהֵן מַחֲזִיקִים אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה בְלַח, שֶׁהֵם כּוֹרַיִם בְּיָבֵשׁ.
phrases.en: The following bring forth and protect against [impurity]: A chest, a box, a cupboard, a beehive of straw, a beehive of reeds, or the water-tank of an Alexandrian ship, such of which [objects] have [flat] bottoms and can contain [at least] forty seahs liquid measure or two kors dry measure.

phrases.he: וִירִיעָה, וּסְקוֹרְטְיָא, וּקְטָבֹלְיָא, וְסָדִין, וּמַפָּץ, וּמַחֲצֶלֶת, שֶׁהֵן עֲשׂוּיִין אֹהָלִים, וְעֵדֶר בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה וּטְהוֹרָה, וּמְכוֹנוֹת חַיָּה וָעוֹף, וְהָעוֹף שֶׁשָּׁכַן, וְהָעוֹשֶׂה מָקוֹם לְבֵנָה בַּשִּׁבֳּלִים, הָאֵירוּס וְהַקִּסּוֹם, וְיַרְקוֹת חֲמוֹר, וּדְלַעַת יְוָנִית, וְאֳכָלִים טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: [Also] a curtain, a leather apron, a leather bedspread, a sheet, a matting underlay or a mat when made into tents. A herd of cattle, unclean or clean, packs of wild animals or birds, a resting bird, a [shady] place that [a woman] makes for her son among the ears of corn; The iris, the ivy, squirting cucumber, Greek gourds and clean foodstuffs.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי לֹא הָיָה מוֹדֶה בְּאֳכָלִים טְהוֹרִין, חוּץ מִן הָעִגּוּל שֶׁל דְּבֵלָה
phrases.en: Rabbi Yohanan ben Nuri did not agree with regard to clean foodstuffs except in the case of a cake of dried figs.

phrases.he: הַזִּיזִין, וְהַגִּזְרִיּוֹת, וְהַשּׁוֹבָכוֹת, וְהַשְּׁקִיפִים, וְהַסְּלָעִים, וְהַגְּהָרִים, וְהַשְּׁנָנִים, וְהַסְּכָכוֹת, וְהַפְּרָעוֹת, שֶׁהֵן יְכוֹלִים לְקַבֵּל מַעֲזִיבָה רַכָּה, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
phrases.en: Projections from a wall, balconies, dovecotes, crevices and crags, grottoes, [overhanging] pinnacles, interlaced boughs and protruding stones as long as they are cable of sustaining thin plasterwork, the words of Rabbi Meir.

phrases.he: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים, מַעֲזִיבָה בֵינוֹנִית.
phrases.en: But the sages say a medium plasterwork.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ הֵן הַסְּכָכוֹת, אִילָן שֶׁהוּא מֵסֵךְ עַל הָאָרֶץ.
phrases.en: What are interlaced boughs? A tree which casts shade over the ground.

phrases.he: וְהַפְּרָעוֹת, הַיּוֹצְאוֹת מִן הַגָּדֵר
phrases.en: Protruding stones? [Stones] that project from a wall.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ מְבִיאִין וְלֹא חוֹצְצִין.
phrases.en: The following bring [impurity] but do not protect against it: A chest, a box, a cupboard, a beehive of straw, a beehive of reeds, or the water tank of an Alexandrian ship, such of which [objects] have [flat] bottoms but cannot contain forty se'ahs of liquid measure or two kors dry measure.

phrases.he: הַשִּׁדָּה, וְהַתֵּבָה, וְהַמִּגְדָּל, כַּוֶּרֶת הַקַּשׁ, כַּוֶּרֶת הַקָּנִים, וּבוֹר סְפִינָה אֲלֶכְּסַנְדְּרִית, שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם שׁוּלַיִם וְאֵינָן מַחֲזִיקִים אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה בְלַח, שֶׁהֵם כּוֹרַיִם בְּיָבֵשׁ.
phrases.en: A curtain, a leather apron, a leather undercover, a sheet, a matting underlay or a mat when not made into tents.

phrases.he: וִירִיעָה, וּסְקוֹרְטְיָא, וּקְטָבֹלְיָא, וְסָדִין, וּמַפָּץ, וּמַחֲצֶלֶת, שֶׁאֵין עֲשׂוּיִין אֹהָלִים, וּבְהֵמָה וְחַיָּה שֶׁמֵּתוּ, וְאֳכָלִים טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: Cattle or wild animals when they are dead, and foodstuffs that are [liable to become] unclean.

phrases.he: מוּסָף עֲלֵיהֶם, הָרֵחַיִם שֶׁל אָדָם
phrases.en: In addition to these, a human-powered mill.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ חוֹצְצִים וְלֹא מְבִיאִין.
phrases.en: The following protect [against impurity] but do not bring it: A loom [with the woof] spread out, the ropes of a bed, waste baskets, and window-lattices.

phrases.he: מַסֶּכֶת פְּרוּסָה, וַחֲבִילֵי הַמִּטָּה, וְהַמִּשְׁפָּלוֹת וְהַסְּרִיגוֹת שֶׁבַּחֲלוֹנוֹת
אֵלּוּ לֹא מְבִיאִין וְלֹא חוֹצְצִין.
phrases.en: The following neither bring [impurity] nor protect against it:Seeds, plants [still] attached to the ground, except for the plants mentioned above, A lump of hail, snow, frost, ice and salt.

phrases.he: הַזְּרָעִים וְהַיְרָקוֹת הַמְחֻבָּרִים לַקַּרְקַע, חוּץ מִן הַיְרָקוֹת שֶׁמָּנוּ, וְכִפַּת הַבָּרָד, וְהַשֶּׁלֶג, וְהַכְּפוֹר, וְהַגְּלִיד, וְהַמֶּלַח, וְהַדּוֹלֵג מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם, וְהַקּוֹפֵץ מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם, וְהָעוֹף הַפּוֹרֵחַ, וְטַלִּית הַמְנַפְנֶפֶת, וּסְפִינָה שֶׁהִיא שָׁטָה עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם.
phrases.en: [Anything] that hops from one place to another, or leaps from one place to another, a flying bird. A loosely-flapping garment, or a ship floating [freely] on the water.

phrases.he: קָשַׁר אֶת הַסְּפִינָה בְּדָבָר שֶׁהוּא יָכוֹל לְהַעֲמִידָהּ, כָּבַשׁ אֶת הָאֶבֶן עַל גַּבֵּי הַטַּלִּית, מְבִיאָה אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: If the ship were tied with something that can keep it steady, or a stone were [placed so as] to hold down the garment, it can bring uncleanness.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, הַבַּיִת שֶׁבַּסְּפִינָה אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose says: a house on a ship cannot bring uncleanness.

phrases.he: שְׁתֵּי חָבִיּוֹת וּבָהֶן כִּשְׁנֵי חֲצָיֵי זֵיתִים, מֻקָּפוֹת צָמִיד פָּתִיל וּמֻנָּחוֹת בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת, הֵן טְהוֹרוֹת, וְהַבַּיִת טָמֵא.
phrases.en: Two [earthenware] jars in which there are two pieces of corpse the size of half an olive, sealed with tightly fitting lids, lying in a house, they remain clean, but the house becomes unclean.

phrases.he: נִפְתְּחָה אַחַת מֵהֶן, הִיא וְהַבַּיִת טְמֵאִים וַחֲבֶרְתָּהּ טְהוֹרָה.
phrases.en: If one of them was opened, that [jar] and the house become unclean, but the other remains clean.

phrases.he: וְכֵן שְׁנֵי חֲדָרִים שֶׁהֵן פְּתוּחִין לַבָּיִת
phrases.en: And similarly with two rooms that open into a house.

phrases.he: כַּוֶּרֶת שֶׁהִיא בְתוֹךְ הַפֶּתַח וּפִיהָ לַחוּץ, כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן תַּחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ מִבַּחוּץ, כֹּל שֶׁהוּא כְנֶגֶד הַזַּיִת, תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְגַבָּהּ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: A beehive [lying] in the doorway with its mouth [pointing] outside:If an olive-sized [portion] of a corpse were placed below the [part of the hive] which is outside [the house], Everything directly below or above that olive-sized [portion] becomes unclean; But everything that is not directly [below or above] that olive-sized [portion], or that which is within [the hive] or within the house, remains clean.

phrases.he: וְכֹל שֶׁאֵינוֹ כְנֶגֶד הַזַּיִת, תּוֹכָהּ, וְהַבַּיִת, טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] within the house, nothing becomes unclean except that which is within the house.

phrases.he: בַּבַּיִת, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא הַבַּיִת. בְּתוֹכָהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] within [the hive] everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ בַבַּיִת אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא, אֶלָּא תוֹכָהּ. בְּתוֹכָהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא:
phrases.en: [In the case of the hive] being one handbreadth high off the ground, If there is uncleanness below it or in the house or above it, everything becomes unclean except that which is within [the hive]. [If the uncleanness is] within the hive everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא כְלִי מְחֻלְחָלֶת.
phrases.en: When do these rules apply? When the hive is a vessel and it is loosely placed in the door.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה פְחוּתָה וּפְקוּקָה בְקַשׁ אוֹ אֲפוּצָה, אֵיזוֹ הִיא אֲפוּצָה, כֹּל שֶׁאֵין לָהּ טֶפַח מִמָּקוֹם אֶחָד, כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן תַּחְתֶּיהָ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הַתְּהוֹם טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it is defective, although [it may be] stopped up with straw or it is stuck to the side of the door What is "stuck? Anything which has no opening of one handbreadth : Then, if an olive-sized [portion] of a corpse is placed below it, [everything] directly [below the portion] to the depths becomes unclean; [If placed] above [the hive everything] directly above to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבָּהּ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] in the house, nothing becomes unclean except the house.

phrases.he: בַּבַּיִת, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא הַבַּיִת.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] within [the hive] nothing becomes unclean except that which is within [the hive].

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא תוֹכָהּ
הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ בַבַּיִת, תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְהַבַּיִת טָמֵא, תּוֹכָהּ וְגַבָּהּ טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: [In the case of such a hive] being [placed] one handbreadth high off the ground:If there is uncleanness below it or in the house, [the space] below it and the house become unclean, but [the space] above and within remains clean.

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא תוֹכָהּ.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] in the hive, nothing is unclean except what is within; If above [the hive] what is directly above up to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבָּהּ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא
בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּזְמַן שֶׁפִּיהָ לַחוּץ.
phrases.en: When do these rules apply? When the mouth [of the hive is pointing] outwards If the mouth is [pointing] inwards [towards the house]: If an olive-sized portion of the corpse is placed below or above [that part of the hive which is] outside, everything directly below or above that olive-sized portion becomes unclean, and everything not directly [below or above it] and whatever is within [the hive] and the house, remains clean.

phrases.he: הָיָה פִיהָ לִפְנִים, וְכַזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן תַּחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ מִבַּחוּץ, כֹּל שֶׁהוּא כְנֶגֶד הַזַּיִת, תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְגַבָּהּ וְתוֹכָהּ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] within the hive or the house, everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: וְכֹל שֶׁאֵינוֹ כְנֶגֶד הַזַּיִת, תּוֹכָהּ וְהַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ בַבַּיִת, הַכֹּל טָמֵא
הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ בַבַּיִת אוֹ בְתוֹכָהּ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא:
phrases.en: [In the case of the hive] being one handbreadth high off the ground, If there is uncleanness below it or in the house or above it, everything becomes unclean .

phrases.he: בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא כְלִי מְחֻלְחָלֶת.
phrases.en: When do these rules apply? When the hive is a vessel and it is loosely placed in the door.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה פְחוּתָה וּפְקוּקָה בְקַשׁ אוֹ אֲפוּצָה, אֵיזוֹהִי אֲפוּצָה, כֹּל שֶׁאֵין לָהּ טֶפַח מִמָּקוֹם אֶחָד, כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן תַּחְתֶּיהָ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הַתְּהוֹם טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it is defective, although [it may be] stopped up with straw or it is stuck to the side of the door What is "stuck? Anything which has no opening of one handbreadth : Then, if an olive-sized [portion] of a corpse is placed below it, [everything] directly [below the portion] to the depths becomes unclean; [If placed] above [the hive everything] directly above to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבָּהּ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] in the house or in the hive, whatever is in the house or hive becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ בַבַּיִת, תּוֹכָהּ וְהַבַּיִת טְמֵאִים
הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ בַבַּיִת אוֹ בְתוֹכָהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא, אֶלָּא גַבָּהּ.
phrases.en: [In the case of such a hive] being [placed] one handbreadth high off the ground:If there is uncleanness below it, in the house or inside the hive everything is impure except for above it.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבָּהּ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא
phrases.en: If above [the hive] what is directly above up to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה מְמַלְּאָה אֶת כָּל הַבַּיִת וְאֵין בֵּינָהּ לְבֵין הַקּוֹרוֹת פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה בְתוֹכָהּ, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [In the case when the hive] was entirely within the house and there is not a space of a handbreadth between it and the roof beams, if there is uncleanness within [the hive], the house becomes unclean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכָהּ טָהוֹר, שֶׁדֶּרֶךְ טֻמְאָה לָצֵאת וְאֵין דַּרְכָּהּ לְהִכָּנֵס, בֵּין עוֹמֶדֶת בֵּין מֻטָּה עַל צִדָּהּ, בֵּין אַחַת בֵּין שְׁתָּיִם
phrases.en: But if there is uncleanness in the house, what is within [the hive] remains clean, for the manner of the uncleanness is to go out and not to go in. [Whether [the hive] is standing upright, or lying on its side, whether there is one [hive] or two.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה עוֹמֶדֶת בְּתוֹךְ הַפֶּתַח וְאֵין בֵּינָהּ לְבֵין הַמַּשְׁקוֹף פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה בְתוֹכָהּ, הַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If it was standing upright in the doorway and there was not a space of one handbreadth between it and the lintel: If there is uncleanness within it, the house remains clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכָהּ טָמֵא, שֶׁדֶּרֶךְ הַטֻּמְאָה לָצֵאת וְאֵין דַּרְכָּהּ לְהִכָּנֵס
phrases.en: But if there is uncleanness in the house, what is within [the hive] becomes unclean, for the manner of the uncleanness is to go out and not to go in.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה מֻטָּה עַל צִדָּהּ בָּאֲוִיר וְכַזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן תַּחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, כֹּל שֶׁהוּא כְנֶגֶד הַזַּיִת, תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְגַבָּהּ, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it was lying on its side in the open air: If an olive-sized [portion] of a corpse was placed below it or above it, everything directly below or above the olive-sized [portion] becomes unclean; but everything that is not directly below or above, and what is within [the hive] remains clean.

phrases.he: וְכֹל שֶׁאֵינוֹ כְנֶגֶד הַזַּיִת, תּוֹכָהּ, טָהוֹר. בְּתוֹכָהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] within [the hive] everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא, אֶלָּא תוֹכָהּ. בְּתוֹכָהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [In the case where the hive is in the open air] and is one handbreadth high off the ground, if there is uncleanness below it or above it, everything becomes unclean except the inside. [If the uncleanness is] within, everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא כֶלִי.
phrases.en: When do these rules apply? When [the hive is] a vessel.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה פְחוּתָה וּפְקוּקָה בְקַשׁ, אוֹ מַחֲזֶקֶת אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה, כְּדִבְרֵי חֲכָמִים, כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן תַּחְתֶּיהָ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הַתְּהוֹם טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it is defective, although [it may be] stopped up with straw or according to the sages, it contains forty seahs Then if an olive-sized [portion] of a corpse is placed below it, [everything] directly [below] to the depths becomes unclean; [If placed] above, [everything] directly above to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבָּהּ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] is within [the hive] nothing is unclean except that which is within.

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא תוֹכָהּ.
phrases.en: [If] it was one handbreadth high off the ground, if there was uncleanness below it, what is below becomes unclean; [If the uncleanness] was within it, what is within becomes unclean; Above it, [everything] directly [above] to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, טָמֵא. בְּתוֹכָהּ, תּוֹכָהּ טָמֵא.
עַל גַּבָּהּ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא
הָיְתָה יוֹשֶׁבֶת עַל שׁוּלֶיהָ וְהִיא כְלִי, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, בְּתוֹכָהּ, אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת.
phrases.en: If it was resting on its bottom and it [retained the status of] a vessel: If there is uncleanness below it, within it or above it, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, אוֹ מְכֻסָּה, אוֹ כְפוּיָה עַל פִּיהָ, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, בְּתוֹכָהּ, אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא
phrases.en: [In the case where] it was one handbreadth high off the ground or covered or inverted [so as to stand] upon its mouth, if there is uncleanness below it, within it or above it, everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא כֶלִי.
phrases.en: When do these rules apply? When [the hive retains the status of] a vessel.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה פְחוּתָה וּפְקוּקָה בְקַשׁ, אוֹ מַחֲזֶקֶת אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה כְּדִבְרֵי חֲכָמִים, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, בְּתוֹכָהּ, אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר
phrases.en: [In the case of its] being defective, although [the deficiency may be] stopped up with straw, or according to the sages, [in the case of it] containing forty se'ahs, If the uncleanness is below it, within it or above it, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמְרִים, אֵין טֻמְאָה עוֹלָה לָהּ, אַף לֹא יוֹרֶדֶת מִמֶּנָּה.
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Shimon say: uncleanness can neither ascend into [the defective hive] nor descend from it.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, תַּחְתֶּיהָ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [In the case where] it was one handbreadth high off the ground, If there is uncleanness below it, what is below becomes unclean; Within it or above it, [everything] directly [above] it to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ, אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא
אָרוֹן שֶׁהִיא רְחָבָה מִלְּמַטָּן וְצָרָה מִלְמַעְלָן וְהַמֵּת בְּתוֹכָהּ, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהּ מִלְּמַטָּן, טָהוֹר. וּמִלְמַעְלָן, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: A coffin which is broad below and narrow above, and has a corpse within it: A person touching it below remains clean; But above becomes unclean.

phrases.he: רְחָבָה מִלְמַעְלָן וְצָרָה מִלְּמַטָּן, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהּ מִכָּל מָקוֹם, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it is broad above and narrow below, a person touching it anywhere becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה שָׁוָה, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהּ מִכָּל מָקוֹם, טָמֵא, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר.
phrases.en: If it was the same [above and below], a person touching it anywhere becomes unclean, the words of Rabbi Eliezer.

phrases.he: וְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר, מִטֶּפַח וּלְמַטָּן, טָהוֹר. מִטֶּפַח וּלְמַעְלָן, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: But Rabbi Joshua says: a handbreadth and more below is clean, but from that handbreadth upwards is unclean.

phrases.he: הָעֲשׂוּיָה כְמִין קַמְטְרָא, הַנּוֹגֵע בָּהּ מִכָּל מָקוֹם, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it was made like a clothes-chest, a person touching it anywhere becomes unclean.

phrases.he: כְּמִין גְּלוֹסְקוֹס, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהּ מִכָּל מָקוֹם, טָהוֹר, חוּץ מִמְּקוֹם פְּתִיחָתָהּ
phrases.en: If it was made like a case, a person touching it anywhere remains clean, except at the place where it opens.

phrases.he: חָבִית שֶׁהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת עַל שׁוּלֶיהָ בָאֲוִיר וְכַזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן תַּחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ בְתוֹכָהּ כְּנֶגֶד קוּרְקוּרָתָהּ, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרֶדֶת, וְהֶחָבִית טְמֵאָה.
phrases.en: A jar resting on its bottom in the open air: If an olive-sized [portion] of a corpse is placed beneath it or within it directly [above] its bottom, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards, and the jar becomes unclean. [If the uncleanness is] outside below a [protruding] side, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards, but the jar remains clean.

phrases.he: תַּחַת דָּפְנָהּ מִבַּחוּץ, טֻמְאָה בּוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרֶדֶת, וְהֶחָבִית טְהוֹרָה.
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] within [the jar] and underneath the protruding sides, If there is within the [cavity of] the side a space of a cubic handbreadth everything [within the cavity] becomes unclean, but what lies directly [below] the mouth remains clean.

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ וְתַחַת דָּפְנָהּ, אִם יֵשׁ בַּדְּפָנוֹת פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, הַכֹּל טָמֵא, וּכְנֶגֶד פִּיהָ, טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If there is not [a space of a cubic handbreadth] the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת.
phrases.en: When do these rules apply? When the jar is clean.

phrases.he: בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּטְהוֹרָה.
phrases.en: If it was unclean, or if it was one handbreadth high off the ground, or covered, or inverted [so as to stand] on its mouth, if there is uncleanness beneath it, within it or above it, everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: אֲבָל אִם הָיְתָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח אוֹ מְכֻסָּה אוֹ כְפוּיָה עַל פִּיהָ, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא
אֲרֻבָּה שֶׁהִיא בְתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת וְיֶשׁ בָּהּ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כְּנֶגֶד אֲרֻבָּה טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: A hatchway in a house, which has an opening of a [square] handbreadth, If there is uncleanness in the house, what is directly [below] the hatchway remains clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה כְנֶגֶד אֲרֻבָּה, הַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If the uncleanness is directly [below] the hatchway, the house remains clean.

phrases.he: הַטֻּמְאָה בֵּין בַּבַּיִת וּבֵין כְּנֶגֶד אֲרֻבָּה, נָתַן אֶת רַגְלוֹ מִלְמַעְלָן, עֵרֵב אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: If the uncleanness is either in the house or directly [below] the hatchway, and a person placed his foot above [the hatchway] he has combined [with the roof to bring] uncleanness.

phrases.he: מִקְצָת טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת וּמִקְצָתָהּ כְּנֶגֶד אֲרֻבָּה, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא, וּכְנֶגֶד הַטֻּמְאָה טָמֵא
phrases.en: If part of the uncleanness is in the room and part of it directly [below] the hatchway, the house becomes unclean and what is directly [above] the uncleanness becomes unclean.

phrases.he: אֵין בָּאֲרֻבָּה פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כְּנֶגֶד אַרֻבָּה טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If the hatchway does not have an opening of a square handbreadth: If there is uncleanness in the house, what is directly [below] the hatchway remains clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה כְנֶגֶד אֲרֻבָּה, הַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If the uncleanness is directly [below] the hatchway, the house remains clean.

phrases.he: הַטֻּמְאָה בַבַּיִת, נָתַן אֶת רַגְלוֹ מִלְמַעְלָן, טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: When the uncleanness is in the house, if he placed his leg above [the hatchway], he remains clean.

phrases.he: הַטֻּמְאָה כְנֶגֶד אֲרֻבָּה, נָתַן אֶת רַגְלוֹ מִלְמַעְלָן, רַבִּי מֵאִיר מְטַמֵּא.
וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים, אִם טֻמְאָה קָדְמָה אֶת רַגְלוֹ, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [When] the uncleanness is directly [below] the hatchway, if he placed his leg above it, Rabbi Meir declares [him] unclean, But the sages say: if the uncleanness was [in position] before his leg, he becomes unclean, but if his leg was [in position] before the uncleanness, he remains clean.

phrases.he: אִם רַגְלוֹ קָדְמָה אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, טָהוֹר.

רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר, שְׁתֵּי רַגְלַיִם, זוֹ עַל גַּב זוֹ, שֶׁקָּדְמוּ אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, מָשַׁךְ הָרִאשׁוֹן אֶת רַגְלוֹ וְנִמְצָא רַגְלוֹ שֶׁל שֵׁנִי שָׁם, טָהוֹר, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁקָּדְמָה רַגְלוֹ שֶׁל רִאשׁוֹן אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה:
phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon says: [in the case where] two [men's] legs, one above the other, were [in position] before the uncleanness, if the first person withdrew his leg and the other person's leg was still there, [the second] remains clean, because the first person's leg was [in position] before the uncleanness.

phrases.he: מִקְצָת טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת וּמִקְצָתָהּ כְּנֶגֶד אֲרֻבָּה, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא, וּכְנֶגֶד הַטֻּמְאָה טָמֵא, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
phrases.en: If part of the uncleanness is in the house and part directly [below] the hatchway, the house becomes unclean, and what is directly [above] the uncleanness becomes unclean, the words of Meir.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא, כְּנֶגֶד הַטֻּמְאָה טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Judah says: the house becomes unclean but what is directly [above] the uncleanness remains clean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, אִם יֵשׁ בַּטֻּמְאָה כְדֵי שֶׁתֵּחָלֵק וּתְטַמֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת וּתְטַמֵּא כְנֶגֶד הַטֻּמְאָה, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose says: if there is sufficient of the uncleanness for it to be divided so that [one part] defiles the house and [the other part] defiles what is directly [above] the uncleanness, [both spaces] become unclean; if not, the house becomes unclean but what is directly [above] the uncleanness remains clean.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא, כְּנֶגֶד הַטֻּמְאָה טָהוֹר
אֲרֻבּוֹת זוֹ עַל גַּב זוֹ, וְיֵשׁ בָּהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כְּנֶגֶד אֲרֻבּוֹת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If there are multiple hatchways, one above the other, and they each have an opening of one handbreadth [square], if there is uncleanness in the house, what is directly [below] the hatchways remains clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה כְנֶגֶד אֲרֻבּוֹת, הַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If the uncleanness is directly [below] the hatchways, the house remains clean.

phrases.he: הַטֻּמְאָה בֵּין בַּבַּיִת בֵּין כְּנֶגֶד אֲרֻבּוֹת, נָתַן דָּבָר שֶׁהוּא מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, בֵּין מִלְמַעְלָן בֵּין מִלְּמַטָּן, הַכֹּל טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [In the case] where the uncleanness is either in the house or directly [below] the hatchways, if something susceptible to uncleanness was placed either in the upper or the lower [hatchway], everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: וְדָבָר שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, מִמֶּנּוּ וּלְמַטָּן, טָמֵא. מִמֶּנּוּ וּלְמַעְלָן, טָהוֹר
phrases.en: If the article is insusceptible to uncleanness, what is below becomes unclean, but what is above remains clean.

phrases.he: אֵין בָּאֲרֻבּוֹת פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כְּנֶגֶד אֲרֻבּוֹת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: In a case where the hatchways do not have an opening of a square handbreadth:If there is uncleanness in the house, what is directly [below] the hatchways remains clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה כְנֶגֶד אֲרֻבּוֹת, הַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If there is uncleanness directly [below] the hatchways, the house remains clean.

phrases.he: הַטֻּמְאָה בַבַּיִת, נָתַן בֵּין דָּבָר שֶׁהוּא מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, בֵּין דָּבָר שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, בֵּין מִלְמַעְלָן בֵּין מִלְּמַטָּן, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא הַתַּחְתּוֹן.
phrases.en: [In the case] where the uncleanness is in the house, if an article whether susceptible to uncleanness or insusceptible to uncleanness was placed either in the upper or the lower [hatchway], nothing becomes unclean except the lower story.

phrases.he: הַטֻּמְאָה כְנֶגֶד אֲרֻבּוֹת, נָתַן דָּבָר שֶׁהוּא מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, בֵּין מִלְמַעְלָן בֵּין מִלְּמַטָּן, הַכֹּל טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [In the case] where the uncleanness is directly [below] the hatchways, if an article susceptible to uncleanness was placed either in the upper or lower [hatchway], everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: וְדָבָר שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, בֵּין מִלְמַעְלָן בֵּין מִלְּמַטָּן, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא תַחְתּוֹן
phrases.en: If the article is insusceptible to uncleanness, whether [it is placed] in the upper or lower [hatchway], nothing becomes unclean except the lower story.

phrases.he: אֲרֻבָּה שֶׁהִיא בְתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת וּקְדֵרָה נְתוּנָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, שֶׁאִם תַּעֲלֶה, אֵין שִׂפְתוֹתֶיהָ נוֹגְעוֹת בָּאֲרֻבָּה, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת.
phrases.en: In the case of a hatchway in a house with a pot placed below it that, if it was raised, its rims would not touch the [edges of the] hatchway: If there is uncleanness below, within or above [the pot], the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, אוֹ בַבַּיִת, תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְהַבַּיִת, טָמֵא. תּוֹכָהּ וְגַבָּהּ, טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: In the case where [the pot] was one handbreadth high off the ground, if there is uncleanness below it or in the house, what is below it and in the house becomes unclean, but what is within [the pot] or above it, remains clean.

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא
phrases.en: [If the uncleanness is] within or above [the pot], everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיְתָהּ נְתוּנָה בְצַד הָאַסְקֻפָּה שֶׁאִם תַּעֲלֶה הִיא נוֹגַעַת בַּמַּשְׁקוֹף פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת.
phrases.en: [In the case where the pot was] placed on the side of the threshold [of the house] such that if it was raised it would touch the lintel over a [space of a square] handbreadth: If there is uncleanness below, within or above [the pot], the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: הָיְתָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ אוֹ בַבַּיִת, תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְהַבַּיִת טָמֵא, תּוֹכָהּ וְגַבָּהּ טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: [In the case] where it was one handbreadth high off the ground: If there is uncleanness below it or in the house, what is below it and in the house becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ, הַכֹּל טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If the uncleanness is within or above [the pot], everything becomes unclean.

phrases.he: שֶׁאִם תַּעֲלֶה אֵינָהּ נוֹגַעַת בַּשְּׁקוֹף פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, אוֹ מֻדְבֶּקֶת בַּשְּׁקוֹף, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא תַחְתֶּיהָ
phrases.en: [In the case where the pot] if raised would not touch the lintel over a [space of a square] handbreadth, or is joined to the lintel, if there is uncleanness below it, nothing is unclean except what is below [the pot].

phrases.he: הַבַּיִת שֶׁנִּסְדַּק, טֻמְאָה בַחוּץ, כֵּלִים שֶׁבִּפְנִים טְהוֹרִין.
phrases.en: A house, which has been split [into two]: If there is uncleanness in the outer [part], vessels in the inner [part] remain clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה בִפְנִים, כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּחוּץ,
בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בַסֶּדֶק אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים.
phrases.en: If the uncleanness is in the inner [part], vessels in the outer [are clean]: Bet Shammai says: when the split is four handbreadths wide; But Bet Hillel says: [when the split is of] any size.

phrases.he: בֵּית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, כָּל שֶׁהוּא.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose says in the name of Bet Hillel: [when it is] one handbreadth wide.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם בֵּית הִלֵּל, פּוֹתֵחַ טָפַח:
אַכְסַדְרָה שֶׁנִּסְדְּקָה, טֻמְאָה בְצַד זֶה, כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּצַּד הַשֵּׁנִי טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: A portico which has been split [into two]: If there is uncleanness on the one side, vessels on the other side remain clean.

phrases.he: נָתַן אֶת רַגְלוֹ אוֹ קָנֶה מִלְמַעְלָן, עֵרֵב אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: If a person placed his leg or a reed above [the split], he has combined [with the roof to bring the] uncleanness.

phrases.he: נָתַן אֶת הַקָּנֶה בָאָרֶץ, אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה גָבֹהַּ מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טָפַח
phrases.en: If he placed the reed on the ground, it does not form a passage for the uncleanness until it is one handbreadth off the ground.

phrases.he: סָגוֹס עָבֶה וְכֹפֶת עָבֶה אֵינָן מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה עַד שֶׁיִּהְיוּ גְבוֹהִים מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: A thick woolen jacket or a thick wooden block does not bring uncleanness until they are one handbreadth high off the ground.

phrases.he: קְפוּלִים, זוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי זוֹ, אֵינָן מְבִיאוֹת אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה עַד שֶׁתְּהֵא הָעֶלְיוֹנָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: If [garments] are folded one above the other they do not bring uncleanness until the uppermost is one handbreadth high off the ground.

phrases.he: הָיָה אָדָם נָתוּן שָׁם,
בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: If a person were placed there [under the split in the portico]: Bet Shammai says: he does not bring the uncleanness.

phrases.he: וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, אָדָם חָלוּל הוּא, וְהַצַּד הָעֶלְיוֹן מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה:
phrases.en: But Bet Hillel says: a person is hollow and his uppermost side brings the uncleanness.

phrases.he: הָיָה מַשְׁקִיף בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וְהֶאֱהִיל עַל קוֹבְרֵי הַמֵּת,
phrases.en: If a person was looking out of a window and overshadowed a funeral procession: Bet Shammai says: he does not bring uncleanness.

phrases.he: בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: But Bet Hillel says: he does bring the uncleanness.

phrases.he: וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: They agree that if he was dressed in his clothes or if there were two persons, one above the other, they bring the uncleanness.

phrases.he: וּמוֹדִים, שֶׁאִם הָיָה לָבוּשׁ בְּכֵלָיו, אוֹ שֶׁהָיוּ שְׁנַיִם זֶה עַל גַּבֵּי זֶה, שֶׁהֵם מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה
הָיָה מֻטָּל עַל הָאַסְקֻפָּה וְהֶאֱהִילוּ עָלָיו קוֹבְרֵי הַמֵּת,
phrases.en: If a person was lying on the threshold and the funeral procession overshadowed him: Bet Shammai says: he does not bring the uncleanness.

phrases.he: בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: But Bet Hillel says: he does bring the uncleanness.

phrases.he: וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה:
הַטֻּמְאָה בַבַּיִת וְהֶאֱהִילוּ עָלָיו טְהוֹרִין, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי מְטַהֲרִין, וּבֵית הִלֵּל מְטַמְּאִין:
phrases.en: [In the case] where the uncleanness was in the house and clean persons overshadowed him: Bet Shammai declares them clean, But Bet Hillel declares them unclean.

phrases.he: כֶּלֶב שֶׁאָכַל בְּשַׂר הַמֵּת וּמֵת הַכֶּלֶב וּמֻטָּל עַל הָאַסְקֻפָּה,
phrases.en: A dog which had eaten the flesh of a corpse and then died and was lying over the threshold:Rabbi Meir says: if its neck has a thickness of one handbreadth it can bring the uncleanness, but if not, it does not bring the uncleanness.

phrases.he: רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר, אִם יֵשׁ בְּצַוָּארוֹ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose says: we [examine to] see where the uncleanness is.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, רוֹאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, מִכְּנֶגֶד הַמַּשְׁקוֹף וְלִפְנִים, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it is beneath the lintel and inwards, the house becomes unclean; if from the lintel and outwards, the house remains clean.

phrases.he: מִכְּנֶגֶד הַמַּשְׁקוֹף וְלַחוּץ, הַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר, פִּיו לִפְנִים, הַבַּיִת טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Eliezer says: if its mouth [points] inwards, the house remains clean; if its mouth [points] outwards, the house becomes unclean, since the uncleanness goes out through its hind.

phrases.he: פִּיו לַחוּץ, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא, שֶׁהַטֻּמְאָה יוֹצֵאת דֶּרֶךְ שׁוּלָיו.
phrases.en: Rabbi Judah ben Batera says: in either case the house becomes unclean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶן בְּתֵירָא אוֹמֵר, בֵּין כָּךְ וּבֵין כָּךְ, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא. כַּמָּה תִשְׁהֶה בְמֵעָיו.
phrases.en: How long can [the uncleanness] remain in its entrails? Three whole days.

phrases.he: שְׁלשָׁה יָמִים מֵעֵת לְעֵת.
phrases.en: [If in the entrails] of fishes or birds, as long as [it takes for the uncleanness] to fall in the fire and be consumed, the words of Rabbi Shimon.

phrases.he: בְּעוֹפוֹת וּבְדָגִים, כְּדֵי שֶׁתִּפֹּל לָאוּר וְתִשָּׂרֵף, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן.
phrases.en: Rabbi Judah ben Batera says: in the case of fishes or birds, twenty-four hours.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶן בְּתֵירָא אוֹמֵר, בְּעוֹפוֹת וּבְדָגִים, מֵעֵת לְעֵת
הֶחָדוּת שֶׁבַּבַּיִת וּמְנוֹרָה בְתוֹכוֹ, וְהַפֶּרַח שֶׁלָּהּ יוֹצֵא וּכְפִישָׁה נְתוּנָה עָלָיו, שֶׁאִם תִּנָּטֵל הַמְּנוֹרָה וּכְפִישָׁה עוֹמֶדֶת עַל פִּי הֶחָדוּת,
phrases.en: A cellar in a house with a candlestick in it, whose calyx protrudes and an olive-basket is placed such that if the candlestick was taken away the olive-basket would still remain over the mouth of the cellar: Bet Shammai says: the cellar remains clean but the candlestick becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים, הֶחָדוּת טָהוֹר, וּמְנוֹרָה טְמֵאָה.
phrases.en: Bet Hillel says: the candlestick also remains clean.

phrases.he: בֵּית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, אַף הַמְּנוֹרָה טְהוֹרָה.
phrases.en: But they agree that if the olive-basket would fall [into the cellar] if the candlestick was removed, all would become unclean.

phrases.he: וּמוֹדִים, שֶׁאִם תִּנָּטֵל הַמְּנוֹרָה וּכְפִישָׁה נוֹפֶלֶת, הַכֹּל טָמֵא
כֵּלִים שֶׁבֵּין שִׂפְתֵי כְפִישָׁה לְבֵין שִׂפְתֵי הֶחָדוּת, אֲפִלּוּ עַד הַתְּהוֹם, טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: Vessels [that are] between the rims of the olive-basket and the rims of the cellar, even to the depths, remain clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה שָׁם, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If there is uncleanness in the cellar, the house becomes unclean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כֵּלִים שֶׁבְּכָתְלֵי הֶחָדוּת, אִם יֵשׁ בִּמְקוֹמָן טֶפַח עַל טֶפַח עַל רוּם טֶפַח, טְהוֹרִים. וְאִם לָאו, טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: If there is uncleanness in the house, vessels in the walls of the cellar remain clean, if the place where they are has a content of one cubic handbreadth; if not, they become unclean.

phrases.he: אִם הָיוּ כָתְלֵי הֶחָדוּת רְחָבִים מִשֶּׁל בַּיִת, בֵּין כָּךְ וּבֵין כָּךְ טְהוֹרִים
phrases.en: If the walls of the cellar are wider [apart] than those of the house, in either case the vessels remain clean.

phrases.he: נֶסֶר שֶׁהוּא נָתוּן עַל פִּי תַנּוּר חָדָשׁ וְעוֹדֵף מִכָּל צְדָדָיו בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתָּיו, כֵּלִים שֶׁעַל גַּבָּיו טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: A board placed over the mouth of a new oven, overlapping it on all sides to the extent of a handbreadth, If there is uncleanness beneath [the board], vessels above it remain clean; If there is uncleanness above it, vessels beneath it remain clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה עַל גַּבָּיו, כֵּלִים שֶׁתַּחְתָּיו טְהוֹרִים. וּבְיָשָׁן, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: In the case of an old oven, they become unclean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי מְטַהֵר.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yohanan ben Nuri declares them clean.

phrases.he: נָתוּן עַל פִּי שְׁנֵי תַנּוּרִים, טֻמְאָה בֵינֵיהֶם, הֵם טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: [If the board] is placed over the mouth of two ovens, if there is uncleanness between them, they become unclean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי מְטַהֵר
phrases.en: Rabbi Yohanan ben Nuri declares them clean.

phrases.he: סְרֵידָה שֶׁהִיא נְתוּנָה עַל פִּי הַתַּנּוּר מֻקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל, טֻמְאָה תַחְתָּיו אוֹ עַל גַּבָּיו, הַכֹּל טָמֵא.
phrases.en: Netting placed over the mouth of an oven, [so that it is] closed with a sealed lid: If there is uncleanness below [the netting] or above it, everything becomes unclean; But what is directly [above] the air-space of the oven remains clean.

phrases.he: כְּנֶגֶד אֲוִירוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר, טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: If there is uncleanness directly [above] the air-space of the oven, everything directly above it even to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה כְנֶגֶד אֲוִירוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא
נֶסֶר שֶׁהוּא נָתוּן עַל פִּי תַנּוּר יָשָׁן, יוֹצֵא מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה טֶפַח אֲבָל לֹא מִן הַצְּדָדִים, טֻמְאָה בְצַד זֶה, כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּצַּד הַשֵּׁנִי טְהוֹרִים. רַבִּי יוֹסֵי מְטַמֵּא.
phrases.en: [In a case where] the board is placed over the mouth of an old oven projects from either [end] to the extent of one handbreadth but not from the sides: If there is uncleanness under one end [of the board], vessels [under] the other end remain clean.

phrases.he: הַבְּטַח אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה. הָיָה בוֹ זִיז,
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose declares them unclean. A betach does not bring uncleanness.

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר, אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: If there was a projection in it: Rabbi Eliezer says: it [still] does not bring uncleanness.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר, רוֹאִים אֶת הַבְּטַח כְּאִלּוּ אֵינוֹ, וְהַזִּיז הָעֶלְיוֹן מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה:
phrases.en: Rabbi Joshua says: we look at the betach as if it is not there, and the projection above brings uncleanness.

phrases.he: סַנְדָּל שֶׁל עֲרִיסָה שֶׁפְּחָתוֹ בְתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת, אִם יֶשׁ בּוֹ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, הַכֹּל טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [With regard to] the shoe of a cradle, for which a hole had been made [in the ceiling to bring it] into the house [below], If [the hole] is one handbreadth square, everything becomes unclean; But if it was not [one handbreadth square] its [uncleanness] is reckoned as one reckons with [cases of contact with] a corpse.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, מוֹנִין בּוֹ כְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁמּוֹנִין בְּמֵת
קוֹרוֹת הַבַּיִת וְהָעֲלִיָּה שֶׁאֵין עֲלֵיהֶן מַעֲזִיבָה וְהֵן מְכֻוָּנוֹת, טֻמְאָה תַחַת אַחַת מֵהֶן, תַּחְתֶּיהָ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [With regard to] the roof beams of a house and of the upper story which have no plaster ceiling upon them and are in a line, [the upper ones exactly above the lower]: If there is uncleanness beneath one of them, all beneath that one becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בֵּין הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה לָעֶלְיוֹנָה, בֵּינֵיהֶן טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it is between a lower and an upper [beam] what is between them becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבֵּי הָעֶלְיוֹנָה, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it is above the upper [roof beams], what is directly above to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיוּ הָעֶלְיוֹנוֹת כְּבֵין הַתַּחְתּוֹנוֹת, טֻמְאָה תַחַת אַחַת מֵהֶן, תַּחַת כֻּלָּם טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [In the case] where the upper [roof beams] were [over the gaps] between the lower [roof beams]: If there is uncleanness beneath one of them, what is beneath all of them becomes unclean; If above them, what is directly above to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבֵּיהֶן, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא
קוֹרָה שֶׁהִיא נְתוּנָה מִכֹּתֶל לְכֹתֶל וְטֻמְאָה תַחְתֶּיהָ, אִם יֶשׁ בָּהּ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, מְבִיאָה אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה תַחַת כֻּלָּהּ.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a beam which is placed across from one wall to another and which has uncleanness beneath it: If it is one handbreadth wide, it conveys uncleanness to everything beneath it; If it is not [one handbreadth wide], the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת.
phrases.en: How much must its circumference be so that its width should be one handbreadth? If it is round, its circumference must be three handbreadths; If square, four handbreadths, since a square has a [circumference] one quarter greater than [that of] a circle.

phrases.he: כַּמָּה יִהְיֶה בְהֶקֵּפָהּ וִיהֵא בָהּ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא עֲגֻלָּה, הֶקֵּפָהּ שְׁלשָׁה טְפָחִים.
בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא מְרֻבַּעַת, אַרְבָּעָה, שֶׁהַמְרֻבָּע יָתֵר עַל הֶעָגוֹל רְבִיעַ
עַמּוּד שֶׁהוּא מֻטָּל לָאֲוִיר, אִם יֵשׁ בְּהֶקֵּפוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה תַחַת דָּפְנוֹ.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a pillar lying [on its side] in the open air, If its circumference is twenty-four handbreadths, it brings uncleanness to everything under its side; But if it is not, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת
כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת מֻדְבָּק לָאַסְקֻפָּה, רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מְטַמֵּא אֶת הַבָּיִת. רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מְטַהֵר.
phrases.en: If an olive-sized portion of a corpse is stuck to the threshold: Rabbi Eliezer declares the house unclean. Rabbi Joshua declares it clean.

phrases.he: הָיָה נָתוּן תַּחַת הָאַסְקֻפָּה, יִדּוֹן מֶחֱצָה לְמֶחֱצָה.
phrases.en: If it was placed beneath the threshold, the [case] is judged by the half [in which the uncleanness is found].

phrases.he: מֻדְבָּק לַמַּשְׁקוֹף, הַבַּיִת טָמֵא. רַבִּי יוֹסֵי מְטַהֵר.
phrases.en: If it is stuck to the lintel, the house becomes unclean. Rabbi Yose declares it clean.

phrases.he: הָיָה נָתוּן בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בַּמַּשְׁקוֹף, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If it was in the house, a person touching the lintel becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּאַסְקֻפָּה, רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מְטַמֵּא.
phrases.en: [As for] a person touching the threshold: Rabbi Eliezer declares him unclean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר, מִטֶּפַח וּלְמַטָּן, טָהוֹר. מִטֶּפַח וּלְמַעְלָן, טָמֵא:
phrases.en: Rabbi Joshua says: [if he touches it at a point] below a handbreadth [from the surface] he remains clean; above that handbreadth he becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָעוֹשֶׂה מָאוֹר בַּתְּחִלָּה, שִׁעוּרוֹ מְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ גָּדוֹל שֶׁל לִשְׁכָּה.
phrases.en: One who makes a new light hole, its minimum size is that of a hole made by the large drill of the Temple chamber.

phrases.he: שְׁיָרֵי הַמָּאוֹר, רוּם אֶצְבָּעַיִם עַל רֹחַב הַגּוּדָל.
phrases.en: The remains of a light-hole [the size is] two fingerbreadths high by a thumb-breadth broad.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ הֵן שְׁיָרֵי הַמָּאוֹר, חַלּוֹן שֶׁסְּתָמָהּ וְלֹא הִסְפִּיק לְגָמְרָהּ.
phrases.en: The following is considered the remains of a light-hole: a window that a person had blocked up but had not been able to finish [being blocked up].

phrases.he: חֲרָרוּהוּ מַיִם אוֹ שְׁרָצִים אוֹ שֶׁאֲכָלַתּוּ מַלַּחַת, שִׁעוּרוֹ מְלֹא אֶגְרוֹף.
phrases.en: [A hole] that was bored by water, or by reptiles or eaten away by salt: the minimum size is that of a fist.

phrases.he: חָשַׁב עָלָיו לְתַשְׁמִישׁ, שִׁעוּרוֹ פוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: If he intended to use it, its minimum size is one handbreadth square; For lighting its minimum size is that of a hole made by the drill.

phrases.he: לְמָאוֹר, שִׁעוּרוֹ מְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ.
phrases.en: The holes in grating or lattice-work may be joined together to form [an opening] the size of a hole made by the drill, according to the opinion of Bet Shammai.

phrases.he: הַסְּרִיגוֹת וְהָרְפָפוֹת מִצְטָרְפוֹת כִּמְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ, כְּדִבְרֵי בֵית שַׁמַּאי.
בֵּית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בְמָקוֹם אֶחָד מְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ.
phrases.en: Bet Hillel says: unless there is a hole of the size made by the drill in one place.

phrases.he: לְהָבִיא הַטֻּמְאָה וּלְהוֹצִיא הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: [The above applies] for purposes of allowing the uncleanness to come in or to go out.

phrases.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר, לְהָבִיא הַטֻּמְאָה, אֲבָל לְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה בְּפוֹתֵחַ טָפַח:
phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon says: only for allowing the uncleanness to come in; but for allowing the uncleanness to go out [the minimum size] is one handbreadth square.

phrases.he: חַלּוֹן שֶׁהִיא לַאֲוִיר, שִׁעוּרָהּ מְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a window made for letting in air, its minimum size is that of a hole made by the drill.

phrases.he: בָּנָה בַיִת חוּצָה לָהּ, שִׁעוּרָהּ בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: If a house was built outside it, its minimum size becomes one handbreadth square.

phrases.he: נָתַן אֶת הַתִּקְרָה בְאֶמְצַע הַחַלּוֹן, הַתַּחְתּוֹן בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, וְהָעֶלְיוֹן מְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ
phrases.en: If a roof was placed at the height of the middle of the window, the minimum size of the lower part is one handbreadth square and of the upper part that of a hole made by the drill.

phrases.he: הַחוֹר שֶׁבַּדֶּלֶת, שִׁעוּרוֹ מְלֹא אֶגְרוֹף, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a hole in the door: Its minimum size is that of a fist, the words of Rabbi Akiva.

phrases.he: רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן אוֹמֵר, בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: Rabbi Tarfon says: one handbreadth square.

phrases.he: שִׁיֵּר בָּהּ הֶחָרָשׁ מִלְּמַטָּן אוֹ מִלְמַעְלָן, הֱגִיפָהּ וְלֹא מֵרְקָהּ, אוֹ שֶׁפְּתָחַתּוּ הָרוּחַ, שִׁעוּרוֹ מְלֹא אֶגְרוֹף
phrases.en: If the carpenter had left a space at the bottom or the top [of the door] or if one had shut [the door] but not closed it tightly, or if the wind blew it open, the minimum size is that of a fist.

phrases.he: הָעוֹשֶׂה מָקוֹם לְקָנֶה, וּלְאִסְפָּתִי, וּלְנֵר, שִׁעוּרוֹ כָּל שֶׁהוּא, כְּדִבְרֵי בֵית שַׁמַּאי.
phrases.en: One who makes a place for a rod, for tongs, or a lamp, the minimum size is whatever is needful, according to the word of Bet Shammai.

phrases.he: בֵּית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: Bet Hillel says: one handbreadth square.

phrases.he: לָזוּן אֶת עֵינָיו, וּלְדַבֵּר עִם חֲבֵרוֹ, וּלְתַשְׁמִישׁ, בְּפוֹתֵחַ טָפַח
phrases.en: [If it was made] for a peep-hole, for speaking through to his fellow, or for [human] use, the minimum size is one handbreadth square.

phrases.he: אֵלּוּ מְמַעֲטִין אֶת הַטֶּפַח.
phrases.en: The following [objects serve to] reduce [the area of a square] handbreadth:[A portion] of less than an olive-size of flesh [of a corpse] reduces [the opening for uncleanness that is] caused by a quarter of a kav of bones [from a corpse]; [A portion] of less than a barley-corn size of bone reduces [the opening for uncleanness that is] caused by an olive-sized portion of flesh; Less than an olive-sized portion of a corpse, Less than an olive-sized portion of carrion, Less than a lentil-sized portion of sheretz; Less than an egg-sized portion of food; Produce growing next to the window, A cobweb having substance; The carcass of a clean bird that he did not intend to eat, And the carcass of an unclean bird that had been intended [for food] that had not been rendered susceptible [to uncleanness], or which had been rendered susceptible [to uncleanness] but had not been intended [for food].

phrases.he: פָּחוֹת מִכַּזַּיִת בָּשָׂר מְמַעֵט עַל יְדֵי רֹבַע עֲצָמוֹת, וּפָחוֹת מֵעֶצֶם כַּשְּׂעֹרָה מְמַעֵט עַל יְדֵי כַזַּיִת בָּשָׂר.

פָּחוֹת מִכַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת, פָּחוֹת מִכַּזַּיִת מִן הַנְּבֵלָה, פָּחוֹת מִכָּעֲדָשָׁה מִן הַשֶּׁרֶץ, פָּחוֹת מִכַּבֵּיצָה אֳכָלִים, הַתְּבוּאָה שֶׁבַּחַלּוֹן, וְכָכַי שֶׁיֶּשׁ בָּהּ מַמָּשׁ, וְנִבְלַת הָעוֹף הַטָּהוֹר שֶׁלֹּא חִשַּׁב עָלֶיהָ, וְנִבְלַת עוֹף הַטָּמֵא שֶׁחִשַּׁב עָלֶיהָ וְלֹא הִכְשִׁירָהּ, אוֹ הִכְשִׁירָהּ וְלֹא חִשַּׁב עָלֶיהָ

אֵלּוּ שֶׁאֵינָן מְמַעֲטִים. אֵין הָעֶצֶם מְמַעֵט עַל יְדֵי עֲצָמוֹת, וְלֹא בָשָׂר עַל יְדֵי בָשָׂר, וְלֹא כַזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת, וְלֹא כַזַּיִת מִן הַנְּבֵלָה, וְלֹא כָעֲדָשָׁה מִן הַשֶּׁרֶץ, וְלֹא כַבֵּיצָה אֳכָלִים, וְלֹא תְבוּאָה שֶׁבַּחַלּוֹנוֹת, וְלֹא כָכַי שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ מַמָּשׁ, וְלֹא נִבְלַת הָעוֹף הַטָּהוֹר שֶׁחִשַּׁב עָלֶיהָ, וְלֹא נִבְלַת עוֹף הַטָּמֵא שֶׁחִשַּׁב עָלֶיהָ וְהִכְשִׁירָהּ, וְלֹא הַשְּׁתִי וְהָעֵרֶב הַמְנֻגָּעִים, וְלֹא לְבֵנָה מִבֵּית הַפְּרָס, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
phrases.en: The following do not reduce [the area of the window]: Bone does not reduce [the area] for [other] bones; Nor [corpse] flesh for [other] flesh; Nor an olive-sized [portion] of a corpse; Nor an olive-sized portion of carrion; Nor a lentil-sized portion of reptile; Nor an egg-sized portion of food; Nor produce growing in the windows; Nor a cobweb having no substance; Nor the carcass of a clean bird which had been intended [for food]; Nor the carcass of an unclean bird which had been intended [for food] and had been rendered susceptible to uncleanness; Nor warp and woof threads that have negaim; Nor a brick from a bet haperas, the words of Rabbi Meir.

phrases.he: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים, הַלְּבֵנָה מְמַעֶטֶת, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁעֲפָרָהּ טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: But the sages say: the brick can reduce, because the dust [of the bet haperas] is clean.

phrases.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל, הַטָּהוֹר מְמַעֵט, וְהַטָּמֵא אֵינוֹ מְמַעֵט
phrases.en: This is the general rule: what is clean reduces [the area], and what is unclean does not reduce it.

phrases.he: הַזִּיז מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה כָּל שֶׁהוּא.
phrases.en: A projection brings uncleanness, whatever width it may be; But a balcony or rounded balcony when they are one handbreadth wide.

phrases.he: הַגִּזְרָה וְהַגַּבְלִית, בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: What is a projection? That [projection] whose surface slopes downwards, And a balcony's surface slopes upwards.

phrases.he: אֵיזֶהוּ הַזִּיז, שֶׁפָּנָיו לְמַטָּה. וְהַגִּזְרָה, שֶׁפָּנֶיהָ לְמָעְלָה.
phrases.en: In what [circumstances] did they say that a projection brings uncleanness whatever width it may be? With regard to a projection which is three rows of stones, or twelve handbreadths, above the doorway.

phrases.he: וּבַמָּה אָמְרוּ הַזִּיז מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה כָל שֶׁהוּא, בְּזִיז שֶׁהוּא גָבוֹהַּ מִן הַפֶּתַח שְׁלשָׁה נִדְבָּכִין, שֶׁהֵם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר טֶפַח.
phrases.en: When higher than that, it brings uncleanness only if it is one handbreadth wide.

phrases.he: יָתֵר מִכָּאן, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה בְפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: Cornices and carvings bring uncleanness when they are one handbreadth wide.

phrases.he: הָעֲטָרוֹת וְהַפִּתּוּחִים מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה בְפוֹתֵחַ טָפַח
זִיז שֶׁעַל גַּבֵּי הַפֶּתַח, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה בְפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: A projection that is above a doorway forms a passage for the uncleanness when it is one handbreadth wide; If above a window two fingerbreadths high or the size of a hole made by a drill, when of any width whatsoever.

phrases.he: שֶׁעַל גַּבֵּי הַחַלּוֹן, רוּם אֶצְבָּעַיִם, שֶׁעַל גַּבֵּי מְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ, כָּל שֶׁהוּא.
רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, מְלֹאוֹ:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose says: when of equal size [to the particular window].

phrases.he: קָנֶה שֶׁעַל גַּבֵּי הַפֶּתַח, אֲפִלּוּ גָבֹהַּ מֵאָה אַמָּה, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה כָל שֶׁהוּא, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ.
phrases.en: A rod above a doorway, even if one hundred cubits higher, forms a passage for the uncleanness no matter its width, the words of Rabbi Joshua.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי אוֹמֵר, אַל יַחְמוֹר זֶה מִן הַזִּיז
phrases.en: Rabbi Yohanan ben Nuri says: don't be more stringent than the case of a projection.

phrases.he: זִיז שֶׁהוּא סוֹבֵב אֶת כָּל הַבַּיִת וְאוֹכֵל בַּפֶּתַח שָׁלשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת, טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כֵּלִים שֶׁתַּחְתָּיו טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: [In the case of] a projection which goes all round the house, occupying space above the doorway to the extent of three fingerbreadths, if there is uncleanness in the house, vessels beneath [the projection] become unclean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה תַחְתָּיו, רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מְטַמֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת, וְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מְטַהֵר.
phrases.en: If the uncleanness is beneath [the projection]: Rabbi Eliezer declares the house unclean, But Rabbi Joshua declares it clean.

phrases.he: וְכֵן בְּחָצֵר שֶׁהִיא מֻקֶּפֶת אַכְסַדְרָה
phrases.en: A similar [rule applies] to a courtyard surrounded by a portico.

phrases.he: שְׁנֵי זִיזִין זֶה עַל גַּבֵּי זֶה וְיֵשׁ בָּהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח וּבֵינֵיהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֵּיהֶן, תַּחְתֵּיהֶן טָמֵא. בֵּינֵיהֶם, בֵּינֵיהֶן טָמֵא.
phrases.en: [With regard to] two projections, one [directly] above the other, each having a width of one handbreadth and a space of one handbreadth between them: If there is uncleanness beneath them, what is beneath them becomes unclean; If it is between them, what is between them becomes unclean; Above them, everything directly [above] to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבֵּיהֶן, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד לָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If the upper [projection] overlapped the lower to the extent of one handbreadth: If there is uncleanness beneath or between them, what is beneath and between them becomes unclean; If it is above them, what is directly [above] to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הָיָה הָעֶלְיוֹן עוֹדֵף עַל הַתַּחְתּוֹן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֵּיהֶן אוֹ בֵינֵיהֶן, תַּחְתֵּיהֶן וּבֵינֵיהֶן טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If the upper [projection] overlapped the lower to an extent of less than a handbreadth: If there is uncleanness beneath them, what is beneath and between them becomes unclean; If it is between them or beneath the overlapping [part]: Rabbi Eliezer says: what is beneath them and between them becomes unclean.

phrases.he: עַל גַּבֵּיהֶן, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד לָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא.
הָיָה הָעֶלְיוֹן עוֹדֵף עַל הַתַּחְתּוֹן פָּחוֹת מִטֶּפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֵּיהֶן, תַּחְתֵּיהֶן וּבֵינֵיהֶן טָמֵא.
בֵּינֵיהֶן אוֹ תַחַת הַמּוֹתָר,
רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר, תַּחְתֵּיהֶן וּבֵינֵיהֶן טָמֵא.
phrases.en: Rabbi Joshua says: what is between them and beneath the overlapping [part] becomes unclean, but what is beneath [the lower one] remains clean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר, בֵּינֵיהֶן וְתַחַת הַמּוֹתָר, טָמֵא, וְתַחְתֵּיהֶן, טָהוֹר:
יֵשׁ בָּהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח וְאֵין בֵּינֵיהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֵּיהֶן, תַּחְתֵּיהֶן טָמֵא.
phrases.en: If they had a width of a handbreadth but there was not a space of a handbreadth between them: If there is uncleanness beneath them, what is beneath becomes unclean; If it is between them or above them, everything directly [above] to the sky becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בֵּינֵיהֶן אוֹ עַל גַּבֵּיהֶן, כְּנֶגְדּוֹ עַד הָרָקִיעַ טָמֵא

אֵין בָּהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, בֵּין שֶׁיֵּשׁ בֵּינֵיהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח בֵּין שֶׁאֵין בֵּינֵיהֶן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחְתֵּיהֶן, בֵּינֵיהֶן אוֹ עַל גַּבֵּיהֶן, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת.
phrases.en: If they did not have a width of a handbreadth, whether there is a space of a handbreadth between them or whether there is not, if there is uncleanness beneath, between or above them, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: וְכֵן שְׁתֵּי יְרִיעוֹת שֶׁהֵן גְּבוֹהוֹת מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טָפַח
phrases.en: A similar [rule applies] to two curtains, [the lower one of which is] one handbreadth high off the ground.

phrases.he: סָגוֹס עָבֶה וְכֹפֶת עָבֶה, אֵינָן מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, עַד שֶׁיְּהוּ גְבוֹהִין מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: A thick woolen jacket or a thick wooden block does not bring uncleanness until they are one handbreadth high off the ground.

phrases.he: קְפוּלִין זוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי זוֹ, אֵינָן מְבִיאוֹת אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, עַד שֶׁתְּהֵא הָעֶלְיוֹנָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: If [garments] are folded one above the other they do not bring uncleanness until the uppermost is one handbreadth high off the ground.

phrases.he: טַבְלָיוֹת שֶׁל עֵץ זוֹ עַל גַּב זוֹ אֵינָן מְבִיאוֹת אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, עַד שֶׁתְּהֵא הָעֶלְיוֹנָה גְבוֹהָה מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.
phrases.en: Tablets of wood [placed] one above the other do not bring uncleanness unless the uppermost is one handbreadth high off the ground; But if they were of marble, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: וְאִם הָיוּ שֶׁל שַׁיִשׁ, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת

טַבְלָיוֹת שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁהֵן נוֹגְעוֹת זוֹ בָזוֹ בְקַרְנוֹתֵיהֶם וְהֵן גְּבוֹהוֹת מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחַת אַחַת מֵהֶן, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בַּשְּׁנִיָּה, טָמֵא טֻמְאַת שִׁבְעָה, כֵּלִים שֶׁתַּחַת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה טְמֵאִים, וְשֶׁתַּחַת הַשְּׁנִיָּה טְהוֹרִין.
phrases.en: [With regard to] wooden tablets which touch each other at their corners, and are one handbreadth high off the ground: If there is uncleanness beneath one of them, [a person] touching the second [tablet] becomes defiled with seven-day defilement. Vessels under the first [tablet] become unclean; but those under the second remain clean.

phrases.he: הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה, עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בוֹ רִבּוּעַ בְּפוֹתֵחַ טָפַח
phrases.en: A table does not bring uncleanness unless it contains a square of at least one handbreadth.

phrases.he: חָבִיּוֹת שֶׁהֵן יוֹשְׁבוֹת עַל שׁוּלֵיהֶן אוֹ מֻטּוֹת עַל צִדֵּיהֶן, בָּאֲוִיר, וְהֵן נוֹגְעוֹת זוֹ בָזוֹ בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחַת אַחַת מֵהֶן, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת.
phrases.en: [With regard to] jars standing on their bottoms or lying on their sides in the open air and touching one another to the extent of a handbreadth: If there is uncleanness beneath one of them, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים, בִּטְהוֹרוֹת.
phrases.en: When does this rule apply? When the [jars] are clean.

phrases.he: אֲבָל אִם הָיוּ טְמֵאוֹת אוֹ גְבוֹהוֹת מִן הָאָרֶץ פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה תַחַת אַחַת מֵהֶן, תַּחַת כֻּלָּם טָמֵא
phrases.en: But in the case where they were unclean or one handbreadth high off the ground, if there is uncleanness beneath one of them, what is beneath all becomes unclean.

phrases.he: בַּיִת שֶׁחֲצָצוֹ בִנְסָרִים אוֹ בִירִיעוֹת, מִן הַצְּדָדִים אוֹ מִן הַקּוֹרוֹת, טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּחֲצָץ טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a house, sectioned off by boards or curtains from the sides or from the roof beams: If there is uncleanness in the house, vessels beyond the partition remain clean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה בַחֲצָץ, כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּבַּיִת טְמֵאִין.
phrases.en: If there is uncleanness beyond the partition, vessels in the house become unclean.

phrases.he: כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּחֲצָץ, אִם יֶשׁ שָׁם פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טְמֵאִים. וְאִם לָאו, טְהוֹרִים
phrases.en: [With regard to] the vessels beyond the partition: If there is a space of a [cubic] handbreadth there, they become unclean, But if not, they are clean.

phrases.he: חֲצָצוֹ מֵאַרְצוֹ, טֻמְאָה בַחֲצָץ, כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּבַּיִת טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: [In the case where] it was partitioned off from the floor: If there is uncleanness beneath the partition, vessels in the house become unclean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כֵּלִים שֶׁבַּחֲצָץ, אִם יֵשׁ בִּמְקוֹמָן טֶפַח עַל טֶפַח עַל רוּם טֶפַח, טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: [In the case where] the uncleanness is in the house, vessels beneath the partition, If there is a space there of one cubic hand breadth, remain clean; But if not, they become unclean, since the floor of the house is reckoned as the house even to the nethermost deep.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, טְמֵאִין, שֶׁאַרְצוֹ שֶׁל בַּיִת כָּמוֹהוּ עַד הַתְּהוֹם
בַּיִת שֶׁהוּא מָלֵא תֶבֶן וְאֵין בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין הַקּוֹרוֹת פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טֻמְאָה בִפְנִים, כֵּלִים שֶׁכְּנֶגֶד יְצִיאָה טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a house filled with straw, without a space of a handbreadth [being left] between [the straw] and the roof beams: If there is uncleanness within [the straw], vessels at the exit become unclean.

phrases.he: טֻמְאָה בַחוּץ, כֵּלִים שֶׁבִּפְנִים, אִם יֵשׁ בִּמְקוֹמָם טֶפַח עַל טֶפַח עַל רוּם טֶפַח, טְהוֹרִים. וְאִם לָאו, טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: [In the case where] the uncleanness was outside [the area of the straw], with regard to the vessels within: If they are in a space of a cubic handbreadth, they remain clean, But if not they become unclean.

phrases.he: אִם יֵשׁ בֵּין תֶּבֶן לַקּוֹרוֹת פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, בֵּין כָּךְ וּבֵין כָּךְ טְמֵאִים
phrases.en: If there is a space of a handbreadth between the straw and the roof beams, in either case the vessels become unclean.

phrases.he: בַּיִת שֶׁמִּלְאוֹ עָפָר אוֹ צְרוֹרוֹת, וּבִטְּלוֹ, וְכֵן כְּרִי שֶׁל תְּבוּאָה, אוֹ גַל שֶׁל צְרוֹרוֹת, אֲפִלּוּ כְגַלּוֹ שֶׁל עָכָן, וַאֲפִלּוּ טֻמְאָה בְצַד הַכֵּלִים, טֻמְאָה בוֹקַעַת וְעוֹלָה, בּוֹקַעַת וְיוֹרָדֶת:
phrases.en: [With regard to] a house filled with earth or pebbles which he [decided] to leave there, or similarly a heap of produce or a mound of pebbles even such as Akhan's mound, and even if the uncleanness is by the side of the vessels, the uncleanness cleaves upwards and downwards.

phrases.he: חֲצַר הַקֶּבֶר, הָעוֹמֵד בְּתוֹכָהּ טָהוֹר, עַד שֶׁיְהֵא בָהּ אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת, כְּדִבְרֵי בֵית שַׁמַּאי.
phrases.en: [With regard to] the courtyard of a tomb: A person standing in it remains clean as long as there is a space of four cubits square, according to the words of Bet Shammai.

phrases.he: בֵּית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים, אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים.
phrases.en: Bet Hillel says: four handbreadths.

phrases.he: קוֹרָה שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ גּוֹלֵל לְקֶבֶר, בֵּין עוֹמֶדֶת בֵּין מֻטָּה עַל צִדָּהּ, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא כְנֶגֶד הַפֶּתַח.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a roof beam which had been used as a covering stone for a tomb, whether it is standing upright or lying on its side, nothing becomes unclean except what [touches] opposite the opening of the grave.

phrases.he: עָשָׂה רֹאשָׁהּ גּוֹלֵל לְקֶבֶר, אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא עַד אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים.
phrases.en: If the end [of the beam] were made the covering stone of a grave, only [that part] up to four handbreadths [from the grave] becomes unclean.

phrases.he: וּבִזְמַן שֶׁהוּא עָתִיד לָגֹד,
phrases.en: [This applies] when [the beam] is going to be cut.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, כֻּלָּהּ חִבּוּר:
phrases.en: Rabbi Judah says: all the beam is connected.

phrases.he: חָבִית שֶׁהִיא מְלֵאָה מַשְׁקִים טְהוֹרִים וּמֻקֶּפֶת צָמִיד פָּתִיל, וַעֲשָׂאָהּ גּוֹלֵל לְקֶבֶר, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהּ, טָמֵא טֻמְאַת שִׁבְעָה, וְהֶחָבִית וְהַמַּשְׁקִין טְהוֹרִין.
phrases.en: A jar full of clean liquid and sealed with a tightly fitting lid, which had been made the covering stone of a tomb, a person touching it contracts seven-day uncleanness but the jar and the liquid remain clean.

phrases.he: בְּהֵמָה שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ גּוֹלֵל לְקֶבֶר, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהּ, טָמֵא טֻמְאַת שִׁבְעָה.
phrases.en: An animal that had been used as a covering stone, a person touching it contracts seven-day uncleanness.

phrases.he: רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר, כֹּל שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ רוּחַ חַיִּים אֵינוֹ מְטַמֵּא מִשּׁוּם גּוֹלֵל:
phrases.en: Rabbi Meir says: anything possessing the breath of life does convey uncleanness on account of [its being used as] a covering stone.

phrases.he: הַנּוֹגֵעַ בְּמֵת וְהַנּוֹגֵעַ בְּכֵלִים, הַמַּאֲהִיל עַל הַמֵּת וְהַנּוֹגֵעַ בְּכֵלִים, טְמֵאִין.
phrases.en: One who touches a corpse and touches vessels, one who overshadows a corpse and touches vessels, they [the vessels] are unclean.

phrases.he: מַאֲהִיל עַל הַמֵּת וּמַאֲהִיל עַל הַכֵּלִים, הַנוֹגֵעַ בְּמֵת וּמַאֲהִיל עַל הַכֵּלִים, טְהוֹרִים.
phrases.en: One who overshadows a corpse and overshadows vessels, one who touches a corpse and overshadows vessels, they [the vessels] are clean.

phrases.he: אִם יֵשׁ בְּיָדוֹ פוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טְמֵאִין.
phrases.en: If his hands are a handbreadth wide, they are unclean.

phrases.he: שְׁנֵי בָתִּים וּבָהֶן כִּשְׁנֵי חֲצָאֵי זֵיתִים, פָּשַׁט אֶת שְׁתֵּי יָדָיו לָהֶן, אִם יֵשׁ בְּיָדָיו פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה.
phrases.en: Two houses, and in each there is a half an olive's worth of corpse and he puts one hand into each house: If his hands are a handbreadth wide, he brings uncleanness; But if not, he does not bring uncleanness.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, אֵינוֹ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה
כָּל הַמִּטַּלְטְלִין מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה כָּעֳבִי הַמַּרְדֵּעַ.
phrases.en: All movable things convey uncleanness when they are of the thickness of an ox-goad.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן, אֲקַפַּח אֶת בָּנַי שֶׁזּוֹ הֲלָכָה מְקֻפַּחַת, שֶׁשָּׁמַע הַשּׁוֹמֵעַ, וְטָעָה, שֶׁהָאִכָּר עוֹבֵר וְהַמַּרְדֵּעַ עַל כְּתֵפוֹ, וְהֶאֱהִיל צִדּוֹ אֶחָד עַל הַקֶּבֶר, וְטִמְּאוּהוּ מִשּׁוּם כֵּלִים הַמַּאֲהִילִים עַל הַמֵּת.
phrases.en: Rabbi Tarfon said: May I [see the] demise of my sons if this is [not] a demised halakhah which someone heard and misunderstood. For a farmer was passing by and over his shoulder was an ox-goad, and one end overshadowed a grave. He was declared unclean on account of vessels that were overshadowing a corpse.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, אֲנִי אֲתַקֵּן שֶׁיְּהוּ דִבְרֵי חֲכָמִים קַיָּמִין, שֶׁיְּהוּ כָל הַמִּטַּלְטְלִין מְבִיאִין אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה עַל אָדָם הַנּוֹשְׂאָן בָּעֳבִי הַמַּרְדֵּעַ, וְעַל עַצְמָן בְּכָל שֶׁהֵן, וְעַל שְׁאָר אָדָם וְכֵלִים בְּפוֹתֵחַ טָפַח:
phrases.en: Rabbi Akiva said: I can fix [the halakhah] so that the words of the sages can exist [as they are]: All movable things convey uncleanness to come upon a person carrying them, when they are of the thickness of an ox-goad; Upon themselves when they are of whatever thickness; And upon other men or vessels [which they overshadow] when they are one handbreadth wide.

phrases.he: כֵּיצַד. כּוּשׁ שֶׁהוּא תָחוּב בַּכֹּתֶל, כַּחֲצִי זַיִת מִתַּחְתָּיו וְכַחֲצִי זַיִת מֵעַל גַּבָּיו, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינָן מְכֻוָּנִין, טָמֵא.
phrases.en: How so? A spindle stuck into the wall, with [a portion of corpse] of half an olive-size above it and [a portion of corpse] of half an olive-size below it.

phrases.he: נִמְצָא מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה לְעַצְמוֹ בְּכָל שֶׁהוּא.
phrases.en: Even though one [portion] is not directly [above] the other, [the spindle] becomes unclean.

phrases.he: הַקַּדָּר שֶׁהוּא עוֹבֵר וְהַסַּל עַל כְּתֵפוֹ וְהֶאֱהִיל צִדּוֹ אַחַת עַל הַקֶּבֶר, הַכֵּלִים שֶׁבַּצַּד הַשֵּׁנִי טְהוֹרִין.
phrases.en: Hence it is found that [a movable object] conveys uncleanness to come upon itself whatever its thickness. A pot seller passes by a grave with a yoke over his shoulder, one end of which overshadows a grave, vessels on the other side remain clean.

phrases.he: אִם יֵשׁ בַּסַּל פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח, טְמֵאִים.
phrases.en: If the yoke is one handbreadth wide, they become unclean.

phrases.he: הַתְּלוּלִיּוֹת הַקְּרוֹבוֹת בֵּין לָעִיר בֵּין לַדֶּרֶךְ, אֶחָד חֲדָשׁוֹת וְאֶחָד יְשָׁנוֹת, טְמֵאוֹת.
phrases.en: Mounds which are near to a city or to a road, whether they are new or old, are unclean.

phrases.he: הָרְחוֹקוֹת, חֲדָשׁוֹת טְהוֹרוֹת וִישָׁנוֹת טְמֵאוֹת.
phrases.en: [As for those that are] far away, new ones are clean but old ones are unclean.

phrases.he: אֵיזוֹ הִיא קְרוֹבָה, חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה.
phrases.en: What counts as near? Fifty cubits.

phrases.he: וִישָׁנָה, שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
phrases.en: And old? Sixty years old, the words of Rabbi Meir.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר, קְרוֹבָה, שֶׁאֵין קְרוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה.
phrases.en: R. Judah says: Near means there is none nearer than it, and old means that no one remembers [when it was made].

phrases.he: וִישָׁנָה, שֶׁאֵין אָדָם זוֹכְרָהּ
הַמּוֹצֵא מֵת בַּתְּחִלָּה מֻשְׁכָּב כְּדַרְכּוֹ, נוֹטְלוֹ וְאֶת תְּבוּסָתוֹ.
phrases.en: If one finds a corpse unexpectedly lying in its natural position, he may remove it along with the [blood-] saturated earth around it.

phrases.he: מָצָא שְׁנַיִם, נוֹטְלָן וְאֶת תְּבוּסָתָן.
phrases.en: If he finds two, he may remove them along with the [blood-] saturated earth around it.

phrases.he: מָצָא שְׁלשָׁה, אִם יֵשׁ בֵּין זֶה לָזֶה מֵאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת וְעַד שְׁמֹנֶה כִּמְלֹא מִטָּה וְקוֹבְרֶיהָ, הֲרֵי זוֹ שְׁכוּנַת קְבָרוֹת.
phrases.en: If he finds three, if there is a space of from four to eight cubits between the first and the last, that is, the space of a bier and its bearers, then it must be accounted a graveyard. He must search [the ground] for twenty cubits from that point.

phrases.he: בּוֹדֵק מִמֶּנּוּ וּלְהַלָּן עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה.
phrases.en: If he found [another corpse] at the end of those twenty cubits, he must search for a further twenty cubits from that place, since there are already grounds for belief [that this is a graveyard], in spite of the fact that if he had found this [lone grave] in the first case, he could have removed it with the [blood-] saturated earth around it.

phrases.he: מָצָא אֶחָד בְּסוֹף עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה, בּוֹדֵק מִמֶּנּוּ וּלְהַלָּן עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה, שֶׁרַגְלַיִם לַדָּבָר.
שֶׁאִלּוּ מִתְּחִלָּה מְצָאוֹ, נוֹטְלוֹ וְאֶת תְּבוּסָתוֹ
הַבּוֹדֵק, בּוֹדֵק אַמָּה עַל אַמָּה וּמַנִּיחַ אַמָּה, עַד שֶׁהוּא מַגִּיעַ לְסֶלַע אוֹ לִבְתוּלָה.
phrases.en: One who searches, must search over a square cubit and then leave a cubit, [digging down] until he reaches rock or virgin soil.

phrases.he: הַמוֹצִיא אֶת הֶעָפָר מִמְּקוֹם טֻמְאָה, אוֹכֵל בְּדִמְעוֹ.
phrases.en: [A priest] carrying out earth from a place of uncleanness may eat his terumah mixed with hullin.

phrases.he: הַמְפַקֵּחַ בַּגַּל, אֵינוֹ אוֹכֵל בְּדִמְעוֹ
phrases.en: But one who is clearing away a heap of stones, may not eat his terumah mixed with hullin.

phrases.he: הָיָה בוֹדֵק, הִגִּיעַ לְנַחַל אוֹ לִשְׁלוּלִית, אוֹ לְדֶרֶךְ הָרַבִּים, מַפְסִיק.
phrases.en: If he was searching and came to a river bed, or a pool or a public road, he may end [his search].

phrases.he: שָׂדֶה שֶׁנֶּהֶרְגוּ בָהּ הֲרוּגִים, מְלַקֵּט עֶצֶם עֶצֶם וְהַכֹּל טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: A field in which men have been slain, he may gather the bones one by one, and all [the area] may be accounted clean.

phrases.he: הַמְפַנֶּה קִבְרוֹ מִתּוֹךְ שָׂדֵהוּ, מְלַקֵּט עֶצֶם עֶצֶם וְהַכֹּל טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: One who removes a grave from his field, he may gather the bones one by one, and all [the area] may be accounted clean.

phrases.he: בּוֹר שֶׁמַּטִּילִים לְתוֹכוֹ נְפָלִים אוֹ הֲרוּגִים, מְלַקֵּט עֶצֶם עֶצֶם וְהַכֹּל טָהוֹר.
phrases.en: A pit into which they throw fetuses or people that had been slain, he may gather the bones one by one, and all [the area] may be accounted clean.

phrases.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר, אִם הִתְקִינוֹ לְקֶבֶר מִתְּחִלָּה, יֶשׁ לוֹ תְבוּסָה:
phrases.en: Rabbi Shimon says: if it had been prepared as a grave in the first place, there is [blood-] saturated earth.

phrases.he: הַחוֹרֵשׁ אֶת הַקֶּבֶר, הֲרֵי זֶה עוֹשֶׂה בֵית הַפְּרָס.
phrases.en: One who plows a grave [into a field], behold he makes it a bet haperas.

phrases.he: עַד כַּמָּה הוּא עוֹשֶׂה.
phrases.en: To what extent does he make it [a bet haperas]? For the length of a furrow of a hundred cubits, a space in which four se'ahs [can grow].

phrases.he: מְלֹא מַעֲנָה מֵאָה אַמָּה, בֵּית אַרְבַּעַת סְאִים.
רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, בֵּית חָמֵשׁ, בְּמוֹרָד.
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose says: an area of five [se'ahs].

phrases.he: וּבְמַעֲלֶה, נוֹתֵן רֹבַע כַּרְשִׁינִים עַל בֹּרֶךְ הַמַּחֲרֵשָׁה, עַד מְקוֹם שֶׁיִּצְמְחוּ שְׁלשָׁה כַרְשִׁינִין זוֹ בְצַד זוֹ, עַד שָׁם הוּא עוֹשֶׂה בֵית הַפְּרָס.
phrases.en: But when on an upward or downward slope: he puts a quarter [of a kav] of vetch seed on the knee of the plough, and the space where [the last] three vetches grow next to each other is a bet peras.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר, בְּמוֹרָד וְלֹא בְמַעֲלֶה:
phrases.en: Rabbi Yose says: [a bet haperas is only made by a plough going] downwards but not upwards.

phrases.he: הָיָה חוֹרֵשׁ וְהִטִּיחַ בְּסֶלַע אוֹ בְגָדֵר אוֹ שֶׁנִּעֵר הַמַּחֲרֵשָׁה, עַד שָׁם הוּא עוֹשֶׂה בֵית הַפְּרָס.
phrases.en: If a person was plowing and struck against a rock or a fence, or if he shook the plowshare, he only makes a bet peras up until that spot.

phrases.he: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אוֹמֵר, בֵּית פְּרָס עוֹשֶׂה בֵית פְּרָס.
phrases.en: Rabbi Elazar says: one bet peras can form another bet peras.

phrases.he: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר, פְּעָמִים עוֹשֶׂה, פְּעָמִים אֵינוֹ עוֹשֶׂה. כֵּיצַד.
phrases.en: Rabbi Joshua says: sometimes it can, but at other times it cannot.

phrases.he: חָרַשׁ חֲצִי מַעֲנָה, וְחָזַר וְחָרַשׁ חֶצְיָהּ, וְכֵן הַצְּדָדִין, הֲרֵי זֶה עוֹשֶׂה בֵית פְּרָס.
phrases.en: How so? If he plowed for half a furrow's length and then returned and plowed a [further] half, or similarly [if he plowed] to the side, he makes a bet peras.

phrases.he: חָרַשׁ מְלֹא מַעֲנָה, חָזַר וְחָרַשׁ מִמֶּנָּה וְלַחוּץ, אֵינוֹ עוֹשֶׂה בֵית פְּרָס
phrases.en: If he plowed a full furrow's length and then returned and plowed from that point beyond, he does not make this a bet peras.

phrases.he: הַחוֹרֵשׁ מְלָטַמְיָא, מִצְּבִירַת הָעֲצָמוֹת, מִשָּׂדֶה שֶׁאָבַד הַקֶּבֶר בְּתוֹכָהּ, אוֹ שֶׁנִּמְצָא בָהּ קֶבֶר, הַחוֹרֵשׁ אֶת שֶׁאֵינוֹ שֶׁלּוֹ, וְכֵן נָכְרִי שֶׁחָרַשׁ, אֵינוֹ עוֹשֶׂה אוֹתָהּ בֵּית פְּרָס, שֶׁאֵין בֵּית פְּרָס לַכּוּתִיִּים:
phrases.en: If a person plows from a pit full of bones, or from a heap of bones, Or from a field in which a grave had been lost, Or in which a grave was subsequently found, Or if he plows a field which was not his own, Or if a non-Jew plowed, he does not make a bet peras. For the rule of bet peras does not apply [even] to Samaritans.

phrases.he: שְׂדֵה בֵית הַפְּרָס עַל גַּבֵּי טְהוֹרָה, שָׁטְפוּ גְשָׁמִים מִבֵּית פְּרָס לַטְּהוֹרָה, אֲפִלּוּ אֲדֻמָּה וְהִלְבִּינוּהָ אוֹ לְבָנָה וְהֶאְדִּימוּהָ, אֵין עוֹשִׂין אוֹתָהּ בֵּית הַפְּרָס:
phrases.en: [In the case where] there was a bet peras above a pure field, if rain washed down soil from the bet peras to the pure field, even where this was reddish and the [other soil] turned it white, or where this was white and the other turned it red, this does not make it a bet peras.

phrases.he: שָׂדֶה שֶׁאָבַד קֶבֶר בְּתוֹכָהּ, וּבָנָה בָהּ בַּיִת וַעֲלִיָּה עַל גַּבָּיו, אִם הָיְתָה פִתְחָהּ שֶׁל עֲלִיָּה מְכֻוָּן כְּנֶגֶד פִּתְחוֹ שֶׁל בַּיִת, עֲלִיָּה טְהוֹרָה.
phrases.en: [With regard to] a field in which a grave had been lost, and upon which a house had been built with an upper story above it: If the entrance of the upper room was directly above the entrance of the house, the upper story remains clean; But if not the upper story becomes unclean.

phrases.he: וְאִם לָאו, עֲלִיָּה טְמֵאָה.
phrases.en: [With regard to] soil from a bet peras, or soil from a foreign country that came in with vegetables, the pieces of the soil combine together [to transmit impurity if they form a portion] the size of a packing-bag seal, the words of Rabbi Eliezer; But the sages say: there must be one portion of the size of a packing-bag seal.

phrases.he: עֲפַר בֵּית הַפְּרָס וַעֲפַר חוּצָה לָאָרֶץ שֶׁבָּא בְיָרָק, מִצְטָרְפִין כְּחוֹתַם הַמַּרְצוּפִים, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר.
וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים, עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בְמָקוֹם אֶחָד כְּחוֹתַם הַמַּרְצוּפִין.
phrases.en: Rabbi Judah says: It happened once that letters came from overseas for the sons of the high priests and they had on them about a se'ah or two se'ahs of seals [of dirt], but the sages were not concerned on account of uncleanness.

phrases.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה,
